results.query: SELECT s.sid, s.serial#, s.username, s.osuser, s.machine, s.program, t.start_time, ROUND((SYSDATE - TO_DATE(t.start_time, 'MM/DD/YY HH24:MI:SS')) * 86400) AS duration_seconds, TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(t.start_time, 'MM/DD/YY HH24:MI:SS'), 'HH24')) AS start_hour FROM v$session s JOIN v$transaction t ON t.ses_addr = s.saddr WHERE s.type = 'USER' AND (TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(t.start_time, 'MM/DD/YY HH24:MI:SS'), 'HH24')) < 7 OR TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(t.start_time, 'MM/DD/YY HH24:MI:SS'), 'HH24')) >= 19) AND UPPER(s.username) NOT IN ('SYS','SYSTEM','DBSNMP','SYSMAN','XDB','GSMADMIN_INTERNAL','APP_USER','SVC_APP','ETL_SERVICE') AND NOT (UPPER(COALESCE(s.program, '')) LIKE '%JDBC%' OR UPPER(COALESCE(s.program, '')) LIKE 'W3WP%' OR UPPER(COALESCE(s.program, '')) LIKE '%ODBC%' OR UPPER(COALESCE(s.program, '')) LIKE 'PYTHON%' OR UPPER(COALESCE(s.program, '')) LIKE 'NODE%' OR (COALESCE(s.program, '') <> '' AND UPPER(s.username) LIKE '%' || UPPER(s.program) || '%')) ORDER BY t.start_time

SELECT s1.sid AS sid_a, s1.username AS user_a, s2.sid AS sid_b, s2.username AS user_b, s1.event AS wait_event, sq1.sql_text AS query_a, sq2.sql_text AS query_b FROM v$session s1 JOIN v$session s2 ON
  s1.blocking_session = s2.sid AND s2.blocking_session = s1.sid LEFT JOIN v$sqlarea sq1 ON s1.sql_id = sq1.sql_id LEFT JOIN v$sqlarea sq2 ON s2.sql_id = sq2.sql_id WHERE s1.blocking_session IS NOT NULL AND
  s2.blocking_session IS NOT NULL
SELECT value AS isolation_level FROM v$parameter WHERE name = 'transaction_isolation'

SELECT username AS login_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT machine) AS host_count,
       LISTAGG(DISTINCT machine, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY machine) AS hosts,
       COUNT(*) AS session_count,
       LISTAGG(DISTINCT SUBSTR(sql_text, 1, 500), ' | ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY SUBSTR(sql_text, 1, 500)) AS queries
FROM (
    SELECT s.username, s.machine, s.sid, q.sql_text
    FROM gv$session s
    LEFT JOIN gv$sql q ON q.sql_id = s.sql_id AND q.inst_id = s.inst_id
    WHERE s.username IS NOT NULL AND s.type = 'USER' AND s.machine IS NOT NULL
)
GROUP BY username
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT machine) > 1
ORDER BY host_count DESC
SELECT value AS isolation_level FROM v$parameter WHERE name = 'transaction_isolation'

SELECT s.sid AS trx_id, s.status AS trx_state, s.logon_time AS trx_started, s.seconds_in_wait AS wait_seconds, sq.sql_text AS trx_query FROM v$session s LEFT JOIN v$sqlarea sq ON s.sql_id = sq.sql_id
  WHERE s.blocking_session IS NOT NULL AND s.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY s.seconds_in_wait DESC

SELECT o.object_name AS lock_table, c.table_name AS fk_table, c.constraint_name, r.table_name AS referenced_table FROM v$lock l JOIN dba_objects o ON o.object_id = l.id1 JOIN all_constraints c ON
  c.table_name = o.object_name AND c.constraint_type = 'R' JOIN all_constraints r ON r.constraint_name = c.r_constraint_name AND r.owner = c.r_owner WHERE l.block > 0

SELECT
  s.sid AS session_id,
  s.username AS login_name,
  s.machine AS host_name,
  s.program AS program_name,
  SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV','DB_NAME') AS database_name,
  t.xidusn || '.' || t.xidslot || '.' || t.xidsqn AS transaction_id,
  TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(t.start_time,'MM/DD/YY HH24:MI:SS'),'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS transaction_begin_time,
  s.last_call_et AS duration_seconds,
  s.status AS transaction_state,
  SUBSTR(sq.sql_text, 1, 4000) AS query_text
FROM v$session s
LEFT JOIN v$transaction t ON t.ses_addr = s.saddr
LEFT JOIN v$sql sq ON sq.sql_id = s.sql_id
WHERE s.type = 'USER' AND s.username IS NOT NULL
  AND s.username NOT IN ('SYS','SYSTEM','DBSNMP','SYSMAN','XDB')
  AND (s.status = 'ACTIVE' OR t.ses_addr IS NOT NULL OR s.last_call_et <= 120)

SELECT profile, resource_name, limit FROM dba_profiles WHERE profile = 'DEFAULT' AND resource_name IN ('FAILED_LOGIN_ATTEMPTS', 'PASSWORD_LIFE_TIME', 'PASSWORD_LOCK_TIME', 'PASSWORD_VERIFY_FUNCTION') ORDER BY resource_name
SELECT banner FROM v$version WHERE ROWNUM = 1

SELECT DISTINCT machine, program, COUNT(*) AS connection_count FROM v$session WHERE type = 'USER' AND machine != (SELECT host_name FROM v$instance) GROUP BY machine, program ORDER BY connection_count DESC FETCH FIRST 20 ROWS ONLY

SELECT 'default_passwords' AS check_item, COUNT(*) AS issue_count FROM dba_users_with_defpwd UNION ALL SELECT 'unlimited_login_attempts', COUNT(*) FROM dba_profiles WHERE resource_name = 'FAILED_LOGIN_ATTEMPTS' AND limit = 'UNLIMITED' UNION ALL SELECT 'no_password_verify', COUNT(*) FROM dba_profiles WHERE resource_name = 'PASSWORD_VERIFY_FUNCTION' AND (limit = 'NULL' OR limit IS NULL) UNION ALL SELECT 'audit_trail_none', CASE WHEN (SELECT value FROM v$parameter WHERE name = 'audit_trail') = 'NONE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM dual UNION ALL SELECT 'sample_schemas_open', COUNT(*) FROM dba_users WHERE username IN ('SCOTT', 'HR', 'OE', 'SH', 'PM', 'IX', 'BI') AND account_status = 'OPEN'

SELECT username, account_status, profile, TO_CHAR(created, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS created, default_tablespace, oracle_maintained FROM dba_users WHERE oracle_maintained = 'Y' AND account_status = 'OPEN' AND username NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM') ORDER BY username

SELECT 'mixed_audit_modes' AS check_item, CASE WHEN (SELECT value FROM v$parameter WHERE name = 'audit_trail') != 'NONE' AND (SELECT value FROM v$option WHERE parameter = 'Unified Auditing') = 'TRUE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_issue FROM dual UNION ALL SELECT 'non_standard_profiles', COUNT(*) FROM dba_profiles WHERE profile NOT IN ('DEFAULT', 'ORA_STIG_PROFILE') AND resource_type = 'PASSWORD' GROUP BY profile HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'orphaned_db_links', COUNT(*) FROM dba_db_links WHERE owner NOT IN (SELECT username FROM dba_users WHERE account_status = 'OPEN')
SELECT name, guarantee_flashback_database, storage_size, TO_CHAR(time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS created FROM v$restore_point ORDER BY time DESC

SELECT username, account_status, authentication_type, TO_CHAR(last_login, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS last_login, ROUND(SYSDATE - NVL(CAST(last_login AS DATE), created)) AS days_inactive FROM dba_users WHERE oracle_maintained = 'N' AND account_status = 'OPEN' AND (last_login IS NULL OR last_login < SYSDATE - 90) ORDER BY days_inactive DESC
SELECT authentication_type, COUNT(*) AS account_count FROM dba_users WHERE oracle_maintained = 'N' AND account_status = 'OPEN' GROUP BY authentication_type ORDER BY account_count DESC

SELECT u.username, u.created, u.last_login, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dba_sys_privs sp WHERE sp.grantee = u.username) AS sys_priv_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dba_role_privs rp WHERE rp.grantee = u.username) AS role_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dba_tab_privs tp WHERE tp.grantee = u.username) AS obj_priv_count FROM dba_users u WHERE u.oracle_maintained = 'N' AND u.account_status = 'OPEN' ORDER BY (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dba_sys_privs sp WHERE sp.grantee = u.username) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dba_role_privs rp WHERE rp.grantee = u.username) DESC FETCH FIRST 20 ROWS ONLY
SELECT policy_name, audit_option FROM audit_unified_policies WHERE audit_option IN ('CREATE USER', 'ALTER USER', 'DROP USER', 'GRANT', 'REVOKE') ORDER BY policy_name

SELECT username, account_status, authentication_type, TO_CHAR(created, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS created, TO_CHAR(last_login, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS last_login, ROUND(SYSDATE - NVL(CAST(last_login AS DATE), created)) AS days_since_activity FROM dba_users WHERE oracle_maintained = 'N' AND account_status = 'OPEN' AND (last_login IS NULL OR last_login < SYSDATE - 90) ORDER BY days_since_activity DESC

SELECT username, account_status, authentication_type, created FROM dba_users WHERE username IN ('SCOTT', 'HR', 'OE', 'SH', 'PM', 'IX', 'BI', 'DEMO', 'TEST', 'SAMPLE', 'DBSNMP', 'MGMT_VIEW', 'SYSMAN', 'APEX_PUBLIC_USER') AND account_status = 'OPEN' ORDER BY username
SELECT username FROM dba_users_with_defpwd WHERE username IN (SELECT username FROM dba_users WHERE account_status = 'OPEN') ORDER BY username

SELECT username, account_status, authentication_type, created, last_login FROM dba_users WHERE oracle_maintained = 'N' AND (UPPER(username) LIKE '%TEST%' OR UPPER(username) LIKE '%TEMP%' OR UPPER(username) LIKE '%DEV%' OR UPPER(username) LIKE '%QA%' OR UPPER(username) LIKE '%DEMO%' OR UPPER(username) LIKE '%SAMPLE%' OR UPPER(username) LIKE '%TMP%' OR UPPER(username) LIKE '%DEBUG%') AND account_status = 'OPEN' ORDER BY username

SELECT username, account_status, authentication_type, password_versions, external_name, created FROM dba_users WHERE oracle_maintained = 'N' AND account_status = 'OPEN' AND (authentication_type = 'NONE' OR authentication_type = 'EXTERNAL' OR password_versions IS NULL) ORDER BY username

SELECT username, account_status, authentication_type, external_name, TO_CHAR(created, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS created, TO_CHAR(last_login, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS last_login, ROUND(SYSDATE - NVL(CAST(last_login AS DATE), created)) AS days_inactive FROM dba_users WHERE authentication_type IN ('GLOBAL', 'EXTERNAL') AND account_status = 'OPEN' AND (last_login IS NULL OR last_login < SYSDATE - 90) ORDER BY days_inactive DESC
SELECT name, value FROM v$parameter WHERE name IN ('spfile', 'control_files', 'diagnostic_dest', 'audit_file_dest', 'background_dump_dest', 'user_dump_dest') AND value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY name
SELECT username FROM dba_users_with_defpwd WHERE username IN (SELECT username FROM dba_users WHERE account_status = 'OPEN') ORDER BY username
SELECT name, value FROM v$parameter WHERE name IN ('ldap_directory_access', 'ldap_directory_sysauth') ORDER BY name

SELECT TO_CHAR(created, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS creation_window, COUNT(*) AS accounts_created, LISTAGG(username, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY username) AS usernames FROM dba_users WHERE oracle_maintained = 'N' GROUP BY TO_CHAR(created, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') HAVING COUNT(*) > 3 ORDER BY creation_window DESC
SELECT username, account_status FROM dba_users WHERE username IN ('DBSAT_ADMIN', 'DBSAT', 'SECURITY_SCAN', 'AUDIT_ADMIN') AND account_status != 'EXPIRED & LOCKED'
SELECT resource_name, limit FROM dba_profiles WHERE profile = 'DEFAULT' AND resource_type = 'PASSWORD' ORDER BY resource_name
SELECT profile, resource_name, limit FROM dba_profiles WHERE resource_name = 'PASSWORD_VERIFY_FUNCTION' ORDER BY profile

SELECT name, value FROM v$parameter WHERE name IN ('sec_case_sensitive_logon', 'sqlnet.allowed_logon_version_server', 'sqlnet.allowed_logon_version_client') AND (value = 'FALSE' OR value LIKE '%8%' OR value LIKE '%10%') ORDER BY name

SELECT profile, resource_name, limit FROM dba_profiles WHERE resource_name IN ('PASSWORD_LIFE_TIME', 'PASSWORD_REUSE_TIME', 'PASSWORD_REUSE_MAX', 'PASSWORD_LOCK_TIME', 'FAILED_LOGIN_ATTEMPTS', 'PASSWORD_GRACE_TIME', 'PASSWORD_VERIFY_FUNCTION') AND profile = 'DEFAULT' ORDER BY resource_name

SELECT object_name, object_type, status FROM dba_objects WHERE object_name IN (SELECT limit FROM dba_profiles WHERE resource_name = 'PASSWORD_VERIFY_FUNCTION' AND limit NOT IN ('NULL', 'DEFAULT')) AND object_type = 'FUNCTION' ORDER BY object_name

SELECT profile, resource_name, limit FROM dba_profiles WHERE resource_name IN ('PASSWORD_VERIFY_FUNCTION', 'PASSWORD_LIFE_TIME', 'PASSWORD_REUSE_TIME', 'PASSWORD_REUSE_MAX', 'PASSWORD_LOCK_TIME', 'FAILED_LOGIN_ATTEMPTS') AND profile IN (SELECT DISTINCT profile FROM dba_users WHERE account_status = 'OPEN') ORDER BY profile, resource_name

SELECT profile, resource_name, limit FROM dba_profiles WHERE resource_name IN ('PASSWORD_VERIFY_FUNCTION', 'PASSWORD_LIFE_TIME', 'FAILED_LOGIN_ATTEMPTS') AND limit IN ('NULL', 'DEFAULT', 'UNLIMITED') AND profile IN (SELECT DISTINCT profile FROM dba_users WHERE account_status = 'OPEN') ORDER BY profile, resource_name
SELECT profile, resource_name, limit FROM dba_profiles WHERE resource_type = 'PASSWORD' ORDER BY profile, resource_name

SELECT parameter_name, parameter_value FROM dba_audit_mgmt_config_params WHERE parameter_name = 'AUDIT_TRAIL' UNION ALL SELECT 'UNIFIED_AUDIT' AS parameter_name, DECODE((SELECT value FROM v$option WHERE parameter = 'Unified Auditing'), 'TRUE', 'ENABLED', 'DISABLED') AS parameter_value FROM dual
SELECT username, profile, account_status, created, authentication_type FROM dba_users WHERE created > SYSDATE - 30 AND username NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'DBSNMP', 'OUTLN') ORDER BY created DESC
SELECT name, value FROM v$parameter WHERE name = 'remote_os_roles'
SELECT username, authentication_type, account_status, external_name FROM dba_users WHERE authentication_type = 'EXTERNAL' AND account_status = 'OPEN' ORDER BY username
SELECT u.username, u.authentication_type, u.external_name, u.account_status FROM dba_users u WHERE u.authentication_type IN ('EXTERNAL', 'GLOBAL') AND u.account_status = 'OPEN' ORDER BY u.username
SELECT name, value FROM v$parameter WHERE name IN ('remote_os_authent', 'os_authent_prefix', 'remote_os_roles') ORDER BY name

SELECT name, value FROM v$parameter WHERE name IN ('sqlnet.authentication_services', 'sqlnet.crypto_checksum_server', 'sqlnet.encryption_server', 'sqlnet.crypto_checksum_types_server', 'sqlnet.encryption_types_server') ORDER BY name
SELECT username, authentication_type, external_name, account_status FROM dba_users WHERE authentication_type = 'GLOBAL' AND account_status = 'OPEN' ORDER BY username
SELECT name, value FROM v$parameter WHERE name IN ('remote_os_authent', 'remote_os_roles', 'os_authent_prefix') ORDER BY name
SELECT COUNT(*) AS ext_auth_users FROM dba_users WHERE authentication_type = 'EXTERNAL' AND account_status = 'OPEN'
SELECT username, authentication_type, account_status FROM dba_users WHERE authentication_type = 'GLOBAL' AND account_status = 'OPEN'

SELECT policy_name, audit_option, audit_condition FROM audit_unified_policies WHERE audit_option = 'LOGON' UNION ALL SELECT 'TRADITIONAL' AS policy_name, 'AUDIT_TRAIL' AS audit_option, value AS audit_condition FROM v$parameter WHERE name = 'audit_trail'

SELECT username, authentication_type, account_status, profile, created, last_login, common FROM dba_users WHERE authentication_type = 'PASSWORD' AND account_status = 'OPEN' AND username NOT IN ('SYS','SYSTEM','DBSNMP','OUTLN','XDB') AND oracle_maintained = 'N' ORDER BY username

SELECT username, COUNT(DISTINCT machine) AS distinct_machines, COUNT(DISTINCT program) AS distinct_programs, COUNT(*) AS session_count FROM v$session WHERE type = 'USER' AND username IS NOT NULL AND username NOT IN ('SYS','SYSTEM') GROUP BY username HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT machine) > 5 ORDER BY distinct_machines DESC

SELECT grantee, privilege FROM dba_sys_privs WHERE grantee NOT IN ('SYS','SYSTEM','DBA','IMP_FULL_DATABASE','EXP_FULL_DATABASE') AND privilege IN ('SELECT ANY TABLE', 'INSERT ANY TABLE', 'UPDATE ANY TABLE', 'DELETE ANY TABLE', 'CREATE ANY TABLE', 'DROP ANY TABLE', 'ALTER ANY TABLE', 'GRANT ANY PRIVILEGE', 'CREATE ANY PROCEDURE', 'EXECUTE ANY PROCEDURE') AND grantee IN (SELECT username FROM dba_users WHERE oracle_maintained = 'N') ORDER BY grantee, privilege
SELECT authentication_type, COUNT(*) AS account_count FROM dba_users WHERE oracle_maintained = 'N' AND account_status = 'OPEN' GROUP BY authentication_type ORDER BY account_count DESC

SELECT u.username, u.account_status, u.created, u.expiry_date, p.resource_name, p.limit AS password_life_time FROM dba_users u JOIN dba_profiles p ON u.profile = p.profile WHERE p.resource_name = 'PASSWORD_LIFE_TIME' AND (p.limit = 'UNLIMITED' OR p.limit = 'DEFAULT') AND u.oracle_maintained = 'N' AND u.account_status = 'OPEN' ORDER BY u.created

SELECT username, account_status, profile, created, last_login FROM dba_users WHERE oracle_maintained = 'N' AND (username LIKE '%DEV%' OR username LIKE '%TEST%' OR username LIKE '%QA%' OR username LIKE '%DEMO%' OR username LIKE '%SANDBOX%') AND account_status = 'OPEN' ORDER BY username
SELECT username, account_status, profile, authentication_type FROM dba_users WHERE oracle_maintained = 'Y' AND account_status = 'OPEN' AND username NOT IN ('SYS','SYSTEM') ORDER BY username

SELECT username, account_status, profile, authentication_type, created, last_login FROM dba_users WHERE oracle_maintained = 'N' AND authentication_type = 'PASSWORD' AND account_status = 'OPEN' AND (username LIKE '%SVC%' OR username LIKE '%SERVICE%' OR username LIKE '%APP%' OR username LIKE '%BATCH%' OR username LIKE '%ETL%' OR username LIKE '%API%') ORDER BY username

SELECT p.profile, r.resource_name, r.limit FROM dba_profiles r JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT profile FROM dba_users WHERE account_status = 'OPEN' AND oracle_maintained = 'N') p ON r.profile = p.profile WHERE r.resource_name IN ('PASSWORD_REUSE_TIME', 'PASSWORD_REUSE_MAX', 'PASSWORD_VERIFY_FUNCTION') ORDER BY p.profile, r.resource_name
SELECT username, authentication_type, external_name, account_status FROM dba_users WHERE authentication_type = 'EXTERNAL' AND account_status = 'OPEN' ORDER BY username

SELECT s.username, s.program, s.machine, s.osuser, COUNT(*) AS connection_count FROM v$session s WHERE s.type = 'USER' AND s.username IS NOT NULL AND s.username NOT IN ('SYS','SYSTEM','DBSNMP') GROUP BY s.username, s.program, s.machine, s.osuser HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY connection_count DESC
SELECT policy_name, enabled_option, entity_name, entity_type, success, failure FROM audit_unified_enabled_policies ORDER BY policy_name

SELECT username, account_status, TO_CHAR(last_login, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS last_login, TO_CHAR(created, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS created, ROUND(SYSDATE - NVL(CAST(last_login AS DATE), created)) AS days_since_activity FROM dba_users WHERE oracle_maintained = 'N' AND account_status = 'OPEN' ORDER BY days_since_activity DESC NULLS FIRST FETCH FIRST 20 ROWS ONLY

SELECT username, account_status, TO_CHAR(created, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS created, TO_CHAR(last_login, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS last_login, profile, authentication_type, ROUND(SYSDATE - NVL(CAST(last_login AS DATE), created)) AS days_inactive FROM dba_users WHERE oracle_maintained = 'N' AND account_status = 'OPEN' AND (last_login IS NULL OR last_login < SYSDATE - 90) ORDER BY days_inactive DESC NULLS FIRST

SELECT u.username, u.profile, u.created, u.last_login, p.resource_name, p.limit FROM dba_users u JOIN dba_profiles p ON u.profile = p.profile WHERE u.oracle_maintained = 'N' AND u.account_status = 'OPEN' AND p.resource_name = 'PASSWORD_LIFE_TIME' AND (p.limit = 'UNLIMITED' OR CAST(p.limit AS INT) > 365) AND (u.username LIKE '%SVC%' OR u.username LIKE '%SERVICE%' OR u.username LIKE '%APP%' OR u.username LIKE '%BATCH%') ORDER BY u.username

SELECT username, account_status, TO_CHAR(created, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS created, TO_CHAR(last_login, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS last_login, profile, ROUND(SYSDATE - NVL(CAST(last_login AS DATE), created)) AS days_inactive FROM dba_users WHERE oracle_maintained = 'N' AND account_status = 'OPEN' AND (username LIKE '%CONTRACT%' OR username LIKE '%VENDOR%' OR username LIKE '%EXTERN%' OR username LIKE '%TEMP_%' OR username LIKE '%CONSULT%') AND NVL(CAST(last_login AS DATE), created) < SYSDATE - 60 ORDER BY days_inactive DESC

SELECT grantee, privilege, admin_option FROM dba_sys_privs WHERE grantee IN (SELECT username FROM dba_users WHERE oracle_maintained = 'N' AND account_status = 'OPEN') AND privilege IN ('SELECT ANY TABLE', 'INSERT ANY TABLE', 'DELETE ANY TABLE', 'CREATE ANY TABLE', 'DROP ANY TABLE', 'ALTER ANY TABLE', 'EXECUTE ANY PROCEDURE', 'CREATE SESSION', 'DBA') AND grantee NOT IN ('SYS','SYSTEM') ORDER BY grantee, privilege

SELECT username, account_status, profile, created, last_login, authentication_type FROM dba_users WHERE oracle_maintained = 'N' AND account_status = 'OPEN' AND (username LIKE 'TEST%' OR username LIKE '%_TEST' OR username LIKE 'DEV%' OR username LIKE '%_DEV' OR username LIKE 'QA%' OR username LIKE 'UAT%' OR username LIKE 'DEMO%' OR username LIKE 'SAMPLE%' OR username LIKE 'SCOTT' OR username LIKE 'HR') ORDER BY username

SELECT u.username, u.account_status, u.authentication_type, u.profile, u.created, u.last_login, u.expiry_date, u.oracle_maintained, COUNT(DISTINCT sp.privilege) AS sys_privs, COUNT(DISTINCT rp.granted_role) AS roles FROM dba_users u LEFT JOIN dba_sys_privs sp ON u.username = sp.grantee LEFT JOIN dba_role_privs rp ON u.username = rp.grantee WHERE u.account_status = 'OPEN' GROUP BY u.username, u.account_status, u.authentication_type, u.profile, u.created, u.last_login, u.expiry_date, u.oracle_maintained ORDER BY u.oracle_maintained, u.username
SELECT name, value FROM v$parameter WHERE name IN ('ldap_directory_access', 'os_authent_prefix', 'remote_os_authent') ORDER BY name

SELECT u.username, TO_CHAR(u.created, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS created, u.account_status, TO_CHAR(u.last_login, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS last_login, u.profile, ROUND(SYSDATE - NVL(CAST(u.last_login AS DATE), u.created)) AS days_since_activity FROM dba_users u WHERE u.account_status = 'OPEN' AND u.username NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'DBSNMP', 'OUTLN', 'MDSYS', 'XDB') AND (u.last_login IS NULL OR u.last_login < SYSDATE - 90) ORDER BY days_since_activity DESC

SELECT username, COUNT(DISTINCT machine) AS unique_machines, COUNT(DISTINCT program) AS unique_programs, COUNT(*) AS total_sessions FROM v$session WHERE username IS NOT NULL AND type = 'USER' GROUP BY username HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT machine) > 5 OR COUNT(DISTINCT program) > 5 ORDER BY unique_machines DESC

SELECT u.username, u.created, u.account_status, u.profile, u.default_tablespace, u.authentication_type FROM dba_users u WHERE u.account_status = 'OPEN' AND u.username NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT grantee FROM dba_role_privs WHERE granted_role = 'DBA') AND u.username NOT LIKE '%SYS%' AND u.username NOT LIKE 'APEX%' AND u.username NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'DBSNMP', 'OUTLN', 'MDSYS', 'XDB', 'WMSYS', 'APPQOSSYS', 'ANONYMOUS') ORDER BY u.created

SELECT username, TO_CHAR(last_login, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS last_login, account_status, ROUND(SYSDATE - NVL(CAST(last_login AS DATE), created)) AS days_inactive FROM dba_users WHERE account_status = 'OPEN' AND (last_login IS NULL OR last_login < SYSDATE - 90) AND username NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'DBSNMP', 'OUTLN') ORDER BY days_inactive DESC FETCH FIRST 20 ROWS ONLY

SELECT grantee, COUNT(DISTINCT privilege) AS sys_priv_count FROM dba_sys_privs WHERE grantee NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'DBA', 'IMP_FULL_DATABASE', 'EXP_FULL_DATABASE') AND grantee IN (SELECT username FROM dba_users WHERE account_status = 'OPEN') GROUP BY grantee HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT privilege) > 10 ORDER BY sys_priv_count DESC
SELECT name, value FROM v$parameter WHERE name IN ('audit_trail', 'audit_sys_operations', 'unified_audit_sga_queue_size') ORDER BY name

SELECT 'Total users' AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM dba_users WHERE account_status = 'OPEN' AND username NOT LIKE '%SYS%' UNION ALL SELECT 'Users with DBA role', COUNT(*) FROM dba_role_privs WHERE granted_role = 'DBA' AND grantee IN (SELECT username FROM dba_users WHERE account_status = 'OPEN') UNION ALL SELECT 'Direct object grants', COUNT(*) FROM dba_tab_privs WHERE grantee IN (SELECT username FROM dba_users WHERE account_status = 'OPEN') AND grantee NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'PUBLIC') UNION ALL SELECT 'System privilege grants', COUNT(*) FROM dba_sys_privs WHERE grantee IN (SELECT username FROM dba_users WHERE account_status = 'OPEN') AND grantee NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM')
SELECT username, account_status, authentication_type, external_name FROM dba_users WHERE authentication_type = 'EXTERNAL' ORDER BY username
SELECT username FROM dba_users_with_defpwd WHERE username IN (SELECT username FROM dba_users WHERE account_status = 'OPEN')
SELECT username, authentication_type, external_name, account_status FROM dba_users WHERE authentication_type = 'EXTERNAL' AND account_status = 'OPEN' ORDER BY username

SELECT name, value FROM v$parameter WHERE (name = 'remote_os_authent' AND value = 'TRUE') OR (name = 'sec_case_sensitive_logon' AND value = 'FALSE') OR (name = 'remote_login_passwordfile' AND value = 'NONE') OR (name = 'O7_DICTIONARY_ACCESSIBILITY' AND value = 'TRUE') OR (name = 'remote_os_roles' AND value = 'TRUE') ORDER BY name
SELECT name, value FROM v$parameter WHERE name IN ('local_listener', 'remote_listener', 'dispatchers', 'sec_protocol_error_trace_action', 'sec_protocol_error_further_action') ORDER BY name

SELECT name, value FROM v$parameter WHERE (name = 'audit_trail' AND value = 'NONE') OR (name = 'sec_return_server_release_banner' AND value = 'TRUE') OR (name = 'sql92_security' AND value = 'FALSE') OR (name = 'remote_os_authent' AND value = 'TRUE') OR (name = 'O7_DICTIONARY_ACCESSIBILITY' AND value = 'TRUE') ORDER BY name

SELECT name, value FROM v$parameter WHERE name IN ('sqlnet.encryption_server', 'sqlnet.crypto_checksum_server', 'sqlnet.encryption_types_server') OR name LIKE '%encryption%' OR name LIKE '%crypto%' ORDER BY name
SELECT name, value FROM v$parameter WHERE name IN ('remote_login_passwordfile', 'sec_case_sensitive_logon') ORDER BY name

SELECT DISTINCT s.machine, s.program, s.username FROM v$session s WHERE s.type = 'USER' AND (s.machine LIKE '%pod%' OR s.machine LIKE '%container%' OR s.machine LIKE '%docker%' OR s.machine LIKE '%k8s%' OR LENGTH(s.machine) = 12) ORDER BY s.machine
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT machine) AS unique_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT username) AS unique_users FROM v$session WHERE type = 'USER' AND username IS NOT NULL

SELECT username, account_status, lock_date, expiry_date FROM dba_users WHERE username IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM') OR username IN (SELECT grantee FROM dba_role_privs WHERE granted_role = 'DBA') ORDER BY username
SELECT policy_name, enabled_option, entity_name, entity_type, success, failure FROM audit_unified_enabled_policies ORDER BY policy_name

       AND o.OWNER NOT IN ('SYS','SYSTEM','OUTLN','DBSNMP')

SELECT grantee, COUNT(*) AS any_priv_count, LISTAGG(privilege, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY privilege) AS any_privileges FROM dba_sys_privs WHERE privilege LIKE '%ANY%' AND grantee NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'DBA', 'IMP_FULL_DATABASE', 'DATAPUMP_IMP_FULL_DATABASE', 'EXP_FULL_DATABASE') AND grantee IN (SELECT username FROM dba_users WHERE oracle_maintained = 'N') GROUP BY grantee HAVING COUNT(*) > 3 ORDER BY any_priv_count DESC

SELECT owner AS dependent_schema, referenced_owner AS referenced_schema, COUNT(*) AS dependency_count FROM ALL_DEPENDENCIES WHERE owner NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'PUBLIC', 'MDSYS', 'CTXSYS', 'XDB') AND referenced_owner NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'PUBLIC', 'MDSYS', 'CTXSYS', 'XDB') AND owner != referenced_owner GROUP BY owner, referenced_owner ORDER BY dependency_count DESC FETCH FIRST 20 ROWS ONLY

SELECT grantor, grantee, COUNT(*) AS grant_count FROM ALL_TAB_PRIVS WHERE grantor NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM') AND grantee NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'PUBLIC') AND grantor != grantee GROUP BY grantor, grantee HAVING COUNT(*) > 20 ORDER BY grant_count DESC FETCH FIRST 20 ROWS ONLY

SELECT owner, table_name, privilege, grantor, grantable FROM dba_tab_privs WHERE grantee = 'PUBLIC' AND owner NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'MDSYS', 'CTXSYS', 'XDB', 'WMSYS') ORDER BY owner, table_name FETCH FIRST 30 ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) AS audited_objects FROM dba_obj_audit_opts WHERE owner NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM')

SELECT 'test_schemas' AS check_item, COUNT(*) AS count FROM dba_users WHERE username LIKE '%TEST%' OR username LIKE '%DEV%' OR username LIKE '%QA%' AND account_status = 'OPEN' UNION ALL SELECT 'unlimited_profile_limits', COUNT(*) FROM dba_profiles WHERE profile = 'DEFAULT' AND limit = 'UNLIMITED' AND resource_name IN ('FAILED_LOGIN_ATTEMPTS', 'PASSWORD_LIFE_TIME') UNION ALL SELECT 'public_grants_on_sensitive', COUNT(*) FROM dba_tab_privs WHERE grantee = 'PUBLIC' AND privilege IN ('SELECT', 'INSERT', 'UPDATE', 'DELETE') AND owner NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM')

SELECT grantee, privilege, admin_option FROM dba_sys_privs WHERE grantee IN (SELECT username FROM dba_users WHERE oracle_maintained = 'N' AND username NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM')) AND privilege IN ('SELECT ANY TABLE', 'CREATE ANY TABLE', 'ALTER ANY TABLE', 'DROP ANY TABLE', 'CREATE ANY INDEX', 'UNLIMITED TABLESPACE', 'SELECT ANY DICTIONARY') ORDER BY grantee, privilege

SELECT o.owner AS procedure_owner, o.object_name, d.referenced_owner AS data_owner, d.referenced_name AS accessed_object, d.referenced_type FROM ALL_OBJECTS o JOIN ALL_DEPENDENCIES d ON o.owner = d.owner AND o.object_name = d.name WHERE o.object_type IN ('PROCEDURE', 'FUNCTION', 'PACKAGE BODY') AND o.owner != d.referenced_owner AND d.referenced_owner NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'PUBLIC') AND o.owner NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM') AND d.referenced_type IN ('TABLE', 'VIEW') ORDER BY o.owner, o.object_name FETCH FIRST 30 ROWS ONLY

SELECT grantee, privilege FROM dba_sys_privs WHERE privilege IN ('SELECT ANY TABLE', 'INSERT ANY TABLE', 'UPDATE ANY TABLE', 'DELETE ANY TABLE', 'ALTER ANY TABLE', 'DROP ANY TABLE') AND grantee NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'DBA', 'IMP_FULL_DATABASE', 'DATAPUMP_IMP_FULL_DATABASE') AND grantee IN (SELECT username FROM dba_users WHERE oracle_maintained = 'N') ORDER BY grantee, privilege

SELECT grantee, owner, table_name, privilege, grantable FROM dba_tab_privs WHERE grantable = 'YES' AND grantee NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'DBA') AND grantee IN (SELECT username FROM dba_users WHERE oracle_maintained = 'N') ORDER BY grantee, owner, table_name FETCH FIRST 30 ROWS ONLY

SELECT tp.grantor, tp.grantee, tp.owner || '.' || tp.table_name AS object, tp.privilege, tp.grantable FROM dba_tab_privs tp WHERE tp.grantor NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM') AND tp.grantable = 'YES' AND tp.grantee NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'PUBLIC') ORDER BY tp.grantor, tp.grantee FETCH FIRST 30 ROWS ONLY

SELECT tp.grantor, tp.grantee, tp.owner || '.' || tp.table_name AS object, tp.privilege FROM dba_tab_privs tp WHERE tp.grantor NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM') AND tp.grantor IN (SELECT grantee FROM dba_tab_privs WHERE grantable = 'YES') AND tp.grantee NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'PUBLIC') ORDER BY tp.grantor, tp.grantee FETCH FIRST 30 ROWS ONLY

SELECT db_user AS granting_user, COUNT(*) AS grant_count, MIN(TO_CHAR(extended_timestamp, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS first_grant, MAX(TO_CHAR(extended_timestamp, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS last_grant FROM dba_common_audit_trail WHERE statement_type = 'GRANT' AND db_user NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM') AND extended_timestamp > SYSTIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '90' DAY GROUP BY db_user ORDER BY grant_count DESC
SELECT policy_name, audit_option FROM audit_unified_policies WHERE audit_option IN ('GRANT', 'REVOKE', 'ALTER USER') ORDER BY policy_name

SELECT grantee, owner, table_name, privilege, grantable FROM dba_tab_privs WHERE grantable = 'YES' AND grantee NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'DBA', 'PUBLIC') AND owner NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM') ORDER BY grantee, owner, table_name

SELECT grantee, privilege, admin_option FROM dba_sys_privs WHERE admin_option = 'YES' AND privilege IN ('CREATE USER', 'ALTER USER', 'DROP USER', 'GRANT ANY PRIVILEGE', 'GRANT ANY ROLE', 'ALTER SYSTEM', 'CREATE ANY TABLE', 'DROP ANY TABLE', 'SELECT ANY TABLE', 'CREATE ANY PROCEDURE', 'EXECUTE ANY PROCEDURE', 'ALTER DATABASE') AND grantee NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'DBA') ORDER BY grantee, privilege

SELECT role, privilege, admin_option FROM role_sys_privs WHERE admin_option = 'YES' AND role NOT IN ('DBA', 'IMP_FULL_DATABASE', 'EXP_FULL_DATABASE', 'DATAPUMP_EXP_FULL_DATABASE', 'DATAPUMP_IMP_FULL_DATABASE') ORDER BY role, privilege

SELECT role AS parent_role, granted_role AS child_role, admin_option FROM role_role_privs WHERE granted_role IN ('DBA', 'RESOURCE', 'CONNECT') OR granted_role IN (SELECT role FROM role_sys_privs WHERE privilege LIKE '%ANY%') ORDER BY role, granted_role

SELECT sp1.grantee, sp1.privilege AS privilege_1, sp2.privilege AS privilege_2 FROM dba_sys_privs sp1 JOIN dba_sys_privs sp2 ON sp1.grantee = sp2.grantee WHERE sp1.grantee NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'DBA') AND ((sp1.privilege = 'CREATE USER' AND sp2.privilege = 'AUDIT SYSTEM') OR (sp1.privilege = 'ALTER SYSTEM' AND sp2.privilege = 'SELECT ANY TABLE') OR (sp1.privilege = 'CREATE ANY PROCEDURE' AND sp2.privilege = 'GRANT ANY PRIVILEGE') OR (sp1.privilege = 'ALTER DATABASE' AND sp2.privilege = 'CREATE USER') OR (sp1.privilege = 'DROP ANY TABLE' AND sp2.privilege = 'CREATE ANY TABLE')) ORDER BY sp1.grantee

SELECT grantee, COUNT(*) AS admin_priv_count FROM dba_sys_privs WHERE admin_option = 'YES' AND grantee NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'DBA') GROUP BY grantee HAVING COUNT(*) > 3 ORDER BY admin_priv_count DESC

SELECT grantee, COUNT(*) AS any_priv_count, LISTAGG(privilege, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY privilege) AS any_privileges FROM dba_sys_privs WHERE privilege LIKE '%ANY%' AND grantee NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'DBA') GROUP BY grantee HAVING COUNT(*) > 3 ORDER BY any_priv_count DESC
SELECT role, privilege FROM role_sys_privs WHERE role IN ('CONNECT', 'RESOURCE') ORDER BY role, privilege

SELECT sp.grantee, sp.privilege FROM dba_sys_privs sp WHERE sp.privilege IN ('SELECT ANY TABLE', 'INSERT ANY TABLE', 'UPDATE ANY TABLE', 'DELETE ANY TABLE') AND sp.grantee NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'DBA') ORDER BY sp.grantee, sp.privilege

SELECT name, value, isdefault FROM v$parameter WHERE name IN ('remote_os_authent', 'remote_os_roles', 'sec_case_sensitive_logon', 'O7_DICTIONARY_ACCESSIBILITY', 'sql92_security', 'audit_trail') AND ((name = 'remote_os_authent' AND UPPER(value) = 'TRUE') OR (name = 'remote_os_roles' AND UPPER(value) = 'TRUE') OR (name = 'sec_case_sensitive_logon' AND UPPER(value) = 'FALSE') OR (name = 'O7_DICTIONARY_ACCESSIBILITY' AND UPPER(value) = 'TRUE') OR (name = 'sql92_security' AND UPPER(value) = 'FALSE') OR (name = 'audit_trail' AND UPPER(value) = 'NONE')) ORDER BY name

SELECT name, value, isdefault FROM v$parameter WHERE name IN ('sql_trace', 'timed_statistics', 'max_dump_file_size', 'remote_os_authent', 'utl_file_dir', '_trace_files_public') AND isdefault = 'FALSE' ORDER BY name
SELECT name, value, isdefault, ismodified FROM v$parameter WHERE ismodified != 'FALSE' AND name NOT LIKE '%__oracle%' ORDER BY name

SELECT grantee, owner, table_name, privilege FROM dba_tab_privs WHERE privilege = 'EXECUTE' AND grantee = 'PUBLIC' AND owner NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'XDB', 'MDSYS', 'CTXSYS', 'ORDSYS') AND table_name IN (SELECT DISTINCT name FROM dba_source WHERE owner NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM') AND type IN ('PROCEDURE', 'FUNCTION', 'PACKAGE') AND UPPER(text) LIKE '%EXECUTE IMMEDIATE%') ORDER BY owner, table_name
SELECT policy_name, enabled_option, entity_name FROM audit_unified_enabled_policies ORDER BY policy_name

SELECT name, value FROM v$parameter WHERE (name = 'remote_os_authent' AND UPPER(value) = 'TRUE') OR (name = 'utl_file_dir' AND value IS NOT NULL AND value != '') OR (name = 'O7_DICTIONARY_ACCESSIBILITY' AND UPPER(value) = 'TRUE') OR (name = 'sec_case_sensitive_logon' AND UPPER(value) = 'FALSE') ORDER BY name

SELECT u.username, u.profile, p.limit AS verify_function FROM dba_users u JOIN dba_profiles p ON p.profile = u.profile AND p.resource_name = 'PASSWORD_VERIFY_FUNCTION' WHERE u.oracle_maintained = 'N' AND u.account_status = 'OPEN' AND (p.limit = 'NULL' OR p.limit IS NULL) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dba_sys_privs sp WHERE sp.grantee = u.username AND sp.privilege LIKE '%ANY%') ORDER BY u.username
SELECT owner, db_link, username, host FROM ALL_DB_LINKS WHERE owner NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM') ORDER BY owner, db_link

SELECT owner, trigger_name, trigger_type, triggering_event, status FROM ALL_TRIGGERS WHERE base_object_type = 'DATABASE' AND status = 'ENABLED' AND owner NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM') ORDER BY owner, trigger_name
SELECT username, created, account_status, authentication_type FROM dba_users WHERE oracle_maintained = 'N' AND created > SYSDATE - 90 ORDER BY created DESC

SELECT d.directory_name, d.directory_path, p.grantee, p.privilege FROM dba_directories d LEFT JOIN dba_tab_privs p ON p.table_name = d.directory_name AND p.type = 'DIRECTORY' WHERE d.directory_name NOT IN ('ORACLE_HOME', 'ORACLE_BASE') ORDER BY d.directory_name, p.grantee

SELECT grantee, privilege, table_name FROM dba_tab_privs WHERE table_name IN (SELECT directory_name FROM dba_directories) AND privilege IN ('READ', 'WRITE', 'EXECUTE') AND grantee NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'DBA') ORDER BY grantee, table_name
SELECT directory_name, directory_path FROM dba_directories ORDER BY directory_name

SELECT grantee, privilege, table_name FROM ALL_TAB_PRIVS WHERE table_name IN ('UTL_FILE', 'UTL_HTTP', 'UTL_TCP', 'UTL_SMTP', 'DBMS_LOB', 'UTL_INADDR', 'DBMS_JAVA', 'DBMS_JAVA_TEST') AND privilege = 'EXECUTE' AND grantee NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'DBA', 'PUBLIC') ORDER BY grantee, table_name

SELECT directory_name, directory_path FROM dba_directories WHERE directory_path LIKE '/etc%' OR directory_path LIKE '/home%' OR directory_path LIKE '%/conf%' OR directory_path LIKE '%password%' OR directory_path LIKE '%config%' ORDER BY directory_name

SELECT d.directory_name, d.directory_path, COUNT(DISTINCT p.grantee) AS grantee_count, LISTAGG(p.grantee, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY p.grantee) AS grantees FROM dba_directories d LEFT JOIN dba_tab_privs p ON p.table_name = d.directory_name AND p.type = 'DIRECTORY' GROUP BY d.directory_name, d.directory_path HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.grantee) > 3 ORDER BY grantee_count DESC

SELECT directory_name, directory_path FROM dba_directories WHERE directory_path LIKE '%dev%' OR directory_path LIKE '%test%' OR directory_path LIKE '%tmp%' OR directory_path LIKE '%temp%' ORDER BY directory_name

SELECT directory_name, directory_path FROM dba_directories WHERE directory_name NOT IN ('DATA_PUMP_DIR', 'ORACLE_HOME', 'ORACLE_BASE', 'ADMIN_DIR', 'OPATCH_INST_DIR', 'OPATCH_LOG_DIR', 'OPATCH_SCRIPT_DIR', 'XMLDIR', 'XSDDIR') ORDER BY directory_name

SELECT d.directory_name, d.directory_path, COUNT(p.grantee) AS grant_count FROM dba_directories d LEFT JOIN dba_tab_privs p ON p.table_name = d.directory_name AND p.type = 'DIRECTORY' GROUP BY d.directory_name, d.directory_path ORDER BY d.directory_name
SELECT username, account_status, default_tablespace, created FROM dba_users WHERE username IN ('HR', 'OE', 'PM', 'IX', 'SH', 'BI', 'SCOTT', 'ADAMS', 'BLAKE', 'CLARK', 'JONES') ORDER BY username

SELECT username, account_status, default_tablespace, created FROM dba_users WHERE (UPPER(username) LIKE '%DEV%' OR UPPER(username) LIKE '%TEST%' OR UPPER(username) LIKE '%QA%' OR UPPER(username) LIKE '%STAGING%') ORDER BY username
SELECT owner, COUNT(*) AS object_count FROM ALL_OBJECTS WHERE owner IN ('HR', 'OE', 'PM', 'IX', 'SH', 'BI', 'SCOTT') GROUP BY owner ORDER BY owner

SELECT username, account_status, default_tablespace, created FROM dba_users WHERE UPPER(username) LIKE '%MIGRATE%' OR UPPER(username) LIKE '%IMPORT%' OR UPPER(username) LIKE '%CONVERT%' OR UPPER(username) LIKE '%LEGACY%' ORDER BY username

SELECT u.username, u.account_status, u.created, u.profile, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dba_objects o WHERE o.owner = u.username) AS object_count FROM dba_users u WHERE u.oracle_maintained = 'N' AND u.username NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM') AND u.account_status != 'OPEN' ORDER BY u.created

SELECT username, account_status, authentication_type, created FROM dba_users WHERE username IN ('HR', 'OE', 'PM', 'IX', 'SH', 'BI', 'SCOTT') OR (UPPER(username) LIKE '%TEST%' OR UPPER(username) LIKE '%DEMO%' OR UPPER(username) LIKE '%SAMPLE%') ORDER BY username

SELECT username, account_status, default_tablespace, created FROM dba_users WHERE oracle_maintained = 'N' AND (UPPER(username) LIKE '%PROD%' OR UPPER(username) LIKE '%LIVE%') AND username IN (SELECT REPLACE(REPLACE(UPPER(username), 'PROD', 'TEST'), 'LIVE', 'TEST') FROM dba_users) ORDER BY username
SELECT username, account_status, default_tablespace, created, profile FROM dba_users WHERE username IN ('HR', 'OE', 'PM', 'IX', 'SH', 'BI', 'SCOTT') AND account_status = 'OPEN' ORDER BY username

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_schemas, COUNT(CASE WHEN account_status = 'OPEN' THEN 1 END) AS open_schemas, COUNT(CASE WHEN account_status != 'OPEN' THEN 1 END) AS non_open_schemas, COUNT(CASE WHEN oracle_maintained = 'N' THEN 1 END) AS custom_schemas FROM dba_users
SELECT grantee, owner, table_name, privilege FROM dba_tab_privs WHERE owner IN ('HR', 'OE', 'PM', 'IX', 'SH', 'BI', 'SCOTT') AND grantee NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'DBA') ORDER BY owner, grantee

SELECT grantee, owner, table_name, privilege, grantable FROM dba_tab_privs WHERE grantee NOT IN ('SYS','SYSTEM','PUBLIC') AND owner NOT IN ('SYS','SYSTEM','DBSNMP','OUTLN','XDB') AND grantee != owner ORDER BY grantee, owner FETCH FIRST 30 ROWS ONLY

SELECT grantee, granted_role, default_role, admin_option FROM dba_role_privs WHERE grantee IN (SELECT username FROM dba_users WHERE oracle_maintained = 'N' AND account_status = 'OPEN') AND granted_role IN ('DBA', 'RESOURCE', 'CONNECT', 'SELECT_CATALOG_ROLE', 'EXECUTE_CATALOG_ROLE', 'DELETE_CATALOG_ROLE') ORDER BY grantee, granted_role

SELECT owner, object_name, object_type FROM ALL_OBJECTS WHERE owner NOT IN ('SYS','SYSTEM','DBSNMP','OUTLN','XDB','CTXSYS','MDSYS') AND (object_name LIKE 'DBA_%' OR object_name LIKE 'V$%' OR object_name LIKE 'GV$%' OR object_name LIKE 'ALL_%' OR object_name LIKE 'USER_%' OR object_name LIKE 'DBMS_%') ORDER BY owner, object_name FETCH FIRST 20 ROWS ONLY
SELECT name, value FROM v$parameter WHERE name = 'enable_pluggable_database'
SELECT comp_id, comp_name, version, status FROM dba_registry WHERE comp_id IN ('JAVAVM', 'XML', 'CATJAVA', 'ORDIM') ORDER BY comp_id

SELECT name, value FROM v$parameter WHERE name IN ('utl_file_dir', 'plsql_native_library_dir', 'remote_os_authent', 'remote_login_passwordfile', 'sec_case_sensitive_logon', 'remote_os_roles', 'o7_dictionary_accessibility') ORDER BY name

SELECT s.username, s.program, COUNT(DISTINCT sp.privilege) AS sys_privs, COUNT(DISTINCT rp.granted_role) AS roles FROM v$session s LEFT JOIN dba_sys_privs sp ON s.username = sp.grantee LEFT JOIN dba_role_privs rp ON s.username = rp.grantee WHERE s.type = 'USER' AND s.username IS NOT NULL AND s.username NOT IN ('SYS','SYSTEM') AND (s.program LIKE '%OEM%' OR s.program LIKE '%monitor%' OR s.program LIKE '%backup%' OR s.program LIKE '%nagios%' OR s.program LIKE '%zabbix%' OR s.program LIKE '%toad%' OR s.program LIKE '%SQL Developer%') GROUP BY s.username, s.program ORDER BY sys_privs DESC

SELECT owner, object_name, object_type, status FROM ALL_OBJECTS WHERE object_type IN ('JAVA CLASS', 'JAVA SOURCE', 'JAVA RESOURCE') AND owner NOT IN ('SYS','SYSTEM','DBSNMP','OUTLN','XDB','CTXSYS','MDSYS','ORDSYS','ORDDATA','WMSYS') ORDER BY owner, object_type, object_name FETCH FIRST 30 ROWS ONLY

SELECT owner, object_name, object_type, authid FROM ALL_PROCEDURES WHERE authid = 'DEFINER' AND owner NOT IN ('SYS','SYSTEM','DBSNMP','OUTLN','XDB','CTXSYS','MDSYS','WMSYS') AND object_type IN ('PROCEDURE','FUNCTION','PACKAGE') ORDER BY owner, object_name FETCH FIRST 20 ROWS ONLY

SELECT x.grantee, x.type_name, x.name, x.action, x.enabled
FROM XMLTABLE('/ROWSET/ROW' PASSING
  XMLTYPE(NVL(DBMS_XMLGEN.getxml(
    CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM all_objects WHERE object_name = 'DBA_JAVA_POLICY' AND object_type IN ('VIEW','SYNONYM')) > 0
         THEN q'[SELECT grantee, type_name, name, action, enabled FROM dba_java_policy WHERE type_name IN ('java.lang.RuntimePermission', 'java.io.FilePermission', 'java.net.SocketPermission') AND grantee NOT IN ('SYS','SYSTEM','JAVASYSPRIV') AND enabled = 'ENABLED' ORDER BY grantee, type_name]'
         ELSE q'[SELECT NULL AS grantee, NULL AS type_name, NULL AS name, NULL AS action, NULL AS enabled FROM dual WHERE 1=0]'
    END), '<ROWSET/>'))
  COLUMNS grantee   VARCHAR2(128)  PATH 'GRANTEE',
          type_name VARCHAR2(256)  PATH 'TYPE_NAME',
          name      VARCHAR2(4000) PATH 'NAME',
          action    VARCHAR2(256)  PATH 'ACTION',
          enabled   VARCHAR2(40)   PATH 'ENABLED') x

SELECT grantee, privilege, table_name AS object_name FROM dba_tab_privs WHERE table_name IN ('UTL_FILE', 'DBMS_SCHEDULER', 'UTL_TCP', 'UTL_HTTP', 'UTL_SMTP', 'UTL_INADDR', 'DBMS_JAVA', 'DBMS_JAVA_TEST') AND privilege = 'EXECUTE' AND grantee NOT IN ('SYS','SYSTEM','PUBLIC','DBA') AND owner = 'SYS' ORDER BY grantee, table_name
SELECT owner, db_link, username, host FROM ALL_DB_LINKS WHERE owner NOT IN ('SYS','SYSTEM') ORDER BY owner, db_link
SELECT owner, library_name, file_spec, dynamic, status FROM dba_libraries WHERE owner NOT IN ('SYS','SYSTEM','DBSNMP','OUTLN','XDB') ORDER BY owner, library_name

SELECT owner, trigger_name, trigger_type, triggering_event, table_name, status FROM dba_triggers WHERE triggering_event LIKE '%LOGON%' OR triggering_event LIKE '%STARTUP%' OR triggering_event LIKE '%SERVERERROR%' ORDER BY owner, trigger_name

SELECT name, value FROM v$parameter WHERE name IN ('plsql_debug', 'sql_trace', 'timed_statistics', 'plsql_optimize_level', 'plsql_warnings', 'tracefile_identifier') AND (value IS NOT NULL AND value != 'FALSE' AND value != '0') ORDER BY name
SELECT parameter, value FROM v$option WHERE parameter = 'Unified Auditing'

SELECT name, value, ismodified FROM v$parameter WHERE name IN ('remote_os_authent', 'o7_dictionary_accessibility', 'sec_case_sensitive_logon', 'audit_trail', 'remote_os_roles', 'sql92_security') AND (value = 'TRUE' AND name IN ('remote_os_authent', 'o7_dictionary_accessibility', 'remote_os_roles') OR value = 'FALSE' AND name IN ('sec_case_sensitive_logon', 'sql92_security')) ORDER BY name

SELECT name, value, isdefault, ismodified, description FROM v$parameter WHERE isdefault = 'FALSE' AND name IN ('sec_case_sensitive_logon', 'sec_max_failed_login_attempts', 'sec_protocol_error_trace_action', 'sec_return_server_release_banner', 'audit_sys_operations', 'unified_audit_sga_queue_size', 'remote_os_authent', 'remote_os_roles', 'o7_dictionary_accessibility') ORDER BY name

SELECT originating_timestamp, message_text FROM v$diag_alert_ext WHERE message_text LIKE '%ALTER SYSTEM SET%' AND originating_timestamp > SYSDATE - 90 ORDER BY originating_timestamp DESC FETCH FIRST 20 ROWS ONLY

SELECT name, value FROM v$parameter WHERE (name = 'audit_trail' AND value = 'NONE') OR (name = 'db_block_checking' AND value = 'FALSE') OR (name = 'db_block_checksum' AND value = 'OFF') OR (name = 'sec_case_sensitive_logon' AND value = 'FALSE') OR (name = 'sql92_security' AND value = 'FALSE') ORDER BY name

SELECT name, value FROM v$parameter WHERE (name = 'remote_os_authent' AND value = 'TRUE') OR (name = 'remote_os_roles' AND value = 'TRUE') OR (name = 'O7_DICTIONARY_ACCESSIBILITY' AND value = 'TRUE') OR (name = 'utl_file_dir' AND value != '') OR (name = '_trace_files_public' AND value = 'TRUE') ORDER BY name
SELECT name, value, description FROM v$parameter WHERE name LIKE '\_%%' ESCAPE '\' AND isdefault = 'FALSE' ORDER BY name

SELECT name, value FROM v$parameter WHERE (name LIKE '%debug%' AND value != '0' AND value != 'FALSE') OR (name LIKE '%trace%' AND value NOT IN ('0', 'FALSE', 'NONE', 'OFF') AND name NOT IN ('diagnostic_dest', 'tracefile_identifier')) OR (name = 'sql_trace' AND value = 'TRUE') OR (name = 'timed_statistics' AND value = 'TRUE') OR (name = 'statistics_level' AND value = 'ALL') ORDER BY name
SELECT name, value, ismodified, isdefault, description FROM v$parameter WHERE ismodified != 'FALSE' ORDER BY name

SELECT name, value FROM v$parameter WHERE (name = 'sec_case_sensitive_logon' AND value = 'FALSE') OR (name = 'compatible' AND value LIKE '11%') OR (name = 'cursor_sharing' AND value = 'FORCE') OR (name = 'optimizer_features_enable' AND value < '19') ORDER BY name
SELECT name, value FROM v$parameter WHERE name = 'diagnostic_dest'

SELECT name, value FROM v$parameter WHERE (name = 'cursor_sharing' AND value = 'FORCE') OR (name = 'optimizer_index_caching' AND value != '0') OR (name = 'optimizer_index_cost_adj' AND TO_NUMBER(value) < 50) OR (name = 'skip_unusable_indexes' AND value = 'TRUE') ORDER BY name

SELECT policy_name, audit_option, audit_option_type FROM audit_unified_policies WHERE audit_option LIKE '%ALTER SYSTEM%' OR audit_option = 'ALTER SYSTEM' UNION ALL SELECT 'Traditional' AS policy_name, audit_option, 'STANDARD' FROM dba_stmt_audit_opts WHERE audit_option = 'ALTER SYSTEM'

SELECT grantee, privilege, table_name FROM dba_tab_privs WHERE table_name IN ('DBMS_SYS_SQL', 'DBMS_BACKUP_RESTORE', 'DBMS_FILE_TRANSFER', 'UTL_FILE', 'UTL_TCP', 'UTL_HTTP', 'UTL_SMTP', 'DBMS_ADVISOR', 'UTL_INADDR', 'DBMS_JAVA') AND grantee NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'DBA', 'PUBLIC') ORDER BY table_name, grantee
SELECT owner, db_link, username, host, created FROM dba_db_links WHERE username IS NOT NULL ORDER BY owner, db_link
SELECT owner, db_link, username, host FROM dba_db_links WHERE username IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'DBA') OR username LIKE '%ADMIN%' ORDER BY owner, db_link
SELECT owner, db_link, username, host, created FROM dba_db_links WHERE owner = 'PUBLIC' ORDER BY db_link

SELECT dl.owner AS link_owner, dl.db_link, dl.username AS remote_user, dl.host, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dba_sys_privs WHERE grantee = dl.owner) AS owner_priv_count FROM dba_db_links dl WHERE dl.username IS NOT NULL AND dl.owner != 'PUBLIC' ORDER BY dl.owner, dl.db_link
SELECT grantee, privilege FROM dba_sys_privs WHERE privilege IN ('CREATE DATABASE LINK', 'CREATE PUBLIC DATABASE LINK') AND grantee NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'DBA') ORDER BY grantee
SELECT dl1.owner, dl1.db_link AS link1, dl1.host AS target1, dl1.username AS remote_user FROM dba_db_links dl1 WHERE dl1.username IS NOT NULL ORDER BY dl1.owner

SELECT sql_id, SUBSTR(sql_text, 1, 300) AS sql_preview FROM v$sql WHERE sql_text LIKE '%@%' AND (sql_text LIKE '%EXECUTE IMMEDIATE%' OR sql_text LIKE '%DBMS_SQL%') AND parsing_schema_name NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM') ORDER BY last_active_time DESC FETCH FIRST 20 ROWS ONLY
SELECT owner, db_link, username, host, created FROM dba_db_links ORDER BY owner, db_link

SELECT sql_id, SUBSTR(sql_text, 1, 200) AS sql_preview FROM v$sql WHERE sql_text LIKE '%CREATE%DATABASE%LINK%IDENTIFIED%BY%' OR sql_text LIKE '%ALTER%DATABASE%LINK%IDENTIFIED%BY%' ORDER BY last_active_time DESC FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY
SELECT owner, db_link, username, host, created, ROUND(SYSDATE - created) AS age_days FROM dba_db_links WHERE username IS NOT NULL ORDER BY age_days DESC
SELECT owner, db_link, username, host FROM dba_db_links WHERE username IS NOT NULL AND owner = 'PUBLIC' ORDER BY db_link

SELECT owner, name, type, line, text FROM ALL_SOURCE WHERE UPPER(text) LIKE '%DBMS_SQL%' AND (UPPER(text) LIKE '%||%' OR UPPER(text) LIKE '%PARSE%') AND owner NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'XDB', 'MDSYS', 'CTXSYS', 'WMSYS', 'ORDSYS') AND type IN ('PROCEDURE', 'FUNCTION', 'PACKAGE BODY') ORDER BY owner, name, line FETCH FIRST 20 ROWS ONLY

SELECT DISTINCT owner, name, type FROM ALL_SOURCE WHERE (UPPER(text) LIKE '%EXECUTE IMMEDIATE%' OR UPPER(text) LIKE '%DBMS_SQL.PARSE%') AND owner NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'XDB', 'MDSYS', 'CTXSYS') AND type IN ('PROCEDURE', 'FUNCTION', 'PACKAGE BODY') AND name NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT name FROM ALL_SOURCE WHERE UPPER(text) LIKE '%DBMS_ASSERT%' AND owner NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM')) ORDER BY owner, name

SELECT owner, COUNT(DISTINCT name) AS objects_with_dynamic_sql, SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(text) LIKE '%USING%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bind_variable_usage, SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(text) LIKE '%||%' AND (UPPER(text) LIKE '%EXECUTE IMMEDIATE%' OR UPPER(text) LIKE '%DBMS_SQL%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS concatenation_usage FROM ALL_SOURCE WHERE (UPPER(text) LIKE '%EXECUTE IMMEDIATE%' OR UPPER(text) LIKE '%DBMS_SQL%') AND owner NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'XDB', 'MDSYS', 'CTXSYS', 'WMSYS') AND type IN ('PROCEDURE', 'FUNCTION', 'PACKAGE BODY') GROUP BY owner ORDER BY concatenation_usage DESC

SELECT o.owner, o.object_name, o.object_type, o.created, o.last_ddl_time, ROUND(SYSDATE - o.created) AS age_days FROM ALL_OBJECTS o WHERE o.object_type IN ('PROCEDURE', 'FUNCTION', 'PACKAGE BODY') AND o.owner NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'XDB', 'MDSYS', 'CTXSYS') AND o.created < SYSDATE - 1095 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ALL_SOURCE s WHERE s.owner = o.owner AND s.name = o.object_name AND (UPPER(s.text) LIKE '%EXECUTE IMMEDIATE%||%' OR UPPER(s.text) LIKE '%DBMS_SQL%||%')) ORDER BY o.created ASC FETCH FIRST 20 ROWS ONLY

SELECT o.owner, o.object_name, o.object_type, o.last_ddl_time FROM ALL_OBJECTS o WHERE o.object_type IN ('PROCEDURE', 'FUNCTION', 'PACKAGE BODY', 'TRIGGER') AND o.owner NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'XDB', 'MDSYS', 'CTXSYS') AND o.last_ddl_time > SYSDATE - 90 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ALL_SOURCE s WHERE s.owner = o.owner AND s.name = o.object_name AND UPPER(s.text) LIKE '%EXECUTE IMMEDIATE%||%' AND UPPER(s.text) NOT LIKE '%DBMS_ASSERT%' AND UPPER(s.text) NOT LIKE '%USING%') ORDER BY o.last_ddl_time DESC

SELECT owner, COUNT(DISTINCT name) AS total_plsql_objects, SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ALL_SOURCE s2 WHERE s2.owner = s1.owner AND s2.name = s1.name AND (UPPER(s2.text) LIKE '%EXECUTE IMMEDIATE%||%' OR UPPER(s2.text) LIKE '%DBMS_SQL%||%')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unsafe_objects FROM (SELECT DISTINCT owner, name FROM ALL_SOURCE WHERE owner NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'XDB', 'MDSYS', 'CTXSYS') AND type IN ('PROCEDURE', 'FUNCTION', 'PACKAGE BODY')) s1 GROUP BY owner HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ALL_SOURCE s2 WHERE s2.owner = s1.owner AND s2.name = s1.name AND (UPPER(s2.text) LIKE '%EXECUTE IMMEDIATE%||%' OR UPPER(s2.text) LIKE '%DBMS_SQL%||%')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 ORDER BY unsafe_objects DESC

SELECT owner, name, type, line, text FROM ALL_SOURCE WHERE UPPER(text) LIKE '%WHERE%||%' AND (UPPER(text) LIKE '%EXECUTE IMMEDIATE%' OR UPPER(text) LIKE '%OPEN%FOR%') AND owner NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'XDB', 'MDSYS', 'CTXSYS') AND type IN ('PROCEDURE', 'FUNCTION', 'PACKAGE BODY') ORDER BY owner, name, line FETCH FIRST 20 ROWS ONLY

SELECT owner, name, type, COUNT(*) AS dynamic_sql_lines FROM ALL_SOURCE WHERE (UPPER(text) LIKE '%EXECUTE IMMEDIATE%' OR UPPER(text) LIKE '%DBMS_SQL%') AND owner NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'XDB', 'MDSYS', 'CTXSYS') AND type IN ('PROCEDURE', 'FUNCTION', 'PACKAGE BODY') GROUP BY owner, name, type HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY dynamic_sql_lines DESC

SELECT owner, name, type, line, text FROM ALL_SOURCE WHERE UPPER(text) LIKE '%EXECUTE IMMEDIATE%SELECT%' AND UPPER(text) NOT LIKE '%||%' AND owner NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'XDB', 'MDSYS', 'CTXSYS') AND type IN ('PROCEDURE', 'FUNCTION', 'PACKAGE BODY') ORDER BY owner, name, line FETCH FIRST 20 ROWS ONLY
SELECT name, value FROM v$sysstat WHERE name IN ('parse count (total)', 'parse count (hard)', 'parse count (failures)', 'execute count') ORDER BY name

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT owner || '.' || name) AS unsafe_objects FROM ALL_SOURCE WHERE (UPPER(text) LIKE '%EXECUTE IMMEDIATE%||%' OR UPPER(text) LIKE '%DBMS_SQL.PARSE%') AND UPPER(text) NOT LIKE '%DBMS_ASSERT%' AND owner NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'XDB', 'MDSYS', 'CTXSYS', 'WMSYS', 'ORDSYS') AND type IN ('PROCEDURE', 'FUNCTION', 'PACKAGE BODY', 'TRIGGER')

SELECT owner, object_name, object_type FROM ALL_OBJECTS WHERE object_type IN ('PACKAGE BODY', 'PROCEDURE', 'FUNCTION') AND owner NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'XDB', 'MDSYS', 'CTXSYS', 'WMSYS', 'ORDSYS') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ALL_SOURCE WHERE owner = ALL_OBJECTS.owner AND name = ALL_OBJECTS.object_name AND type = ALL_OBJECTS.object_type AND ROWNUM = 1 AND text NOT LIKE '%wrapped%') ORDER BY owner, object_name FETCH FIRST 20 ROWS ONLY

SELECT owner, object_name, object_type FROM dba_objects WHERE (object_name LIKE '%OS_COMMAND%' OR object_name LIKE '%SHELL%' OR object_name LIKE '%HOST_COMMAND%') AND object_type IN ('PROCEDURE', 'FUNCTION', 'JAVA CLASS', 'JAVA SOURCE') AND owner NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM') UNION ALL SELECT owner, job_name, job_type FROM dba_scheduler_jobs WHERE job_type = 'EXECUTABLE' AND owner NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM') ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT owner, name, type, COUNT(*) AS dynamic_sql_count FROM ALL_SOURCE WHERE (UPPER(text) LIKE '%EXECUTE IMMEDIATE%' OR UPPER(text) LIKE '%DBMS_SQL%') AND type IN ('PROCEDURE', 'FUNCTION', 'PACKAGE BODY') AND owner NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'XDB', 'MDSYS', 'CTXSYS', 'WMSYS') GROUP BY owner, name, type ORDER BY dynamic_sql_count DESC FETCH FIRST 20 ROWS ONLY

SELECT owner, name, type, line, text FROM ALL_SOURCE WHERE UPPER(text) LIKE '%EXECUTE IMMEDIATE%||%USING%' AND owner NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'XDB', 'MDSYS', 'CTXSYS') AND type IN ('PROCEDURE', 'FUNCTION', 'PACKAGE BODY') ORDER BY owner, name, line FETCH FIRST 20 ROWS ONLY

SELECT o.owner, o.object_name, o.object_type, o.created, o.last_ddl_time, ROUND(SYSDATE - o.created) AS age_days FROM ALL_OBJECTS o WHERE o.object_type IN ('JAVA CLASS', 'JAVA SOURCE') AND o.owner NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'XDB', 'ORDSYS', 'MDSYS') AND o.created < SYSDATE - 1095 ORDER BY o.created ASC FETCH FIRST 15 ROWS ONLY

SELECT d.referenced_owner, d.referenced_name, d.referenced_type, COUNT(*) AS dependent_objects FROM ALL_DEPENDENCIES d WHERE d.referenced_type IN ('JAVA CLASS', 'JAVA SOURCE') AND d.referenced_owner NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM') GROUP BY d.referenced_owner, d.referenced_name, d.referenced_type HAVING COUNT(*) > 3 ORDER BY dependent_objects DESC

LOWER(column_name) LIKE '%credit_card%' OR LOWER(column_name) LIKE '%card_number%' OR LOWER(column_name) LIKE '%cvv%' OR LOWER(column_name) LIKE '%password%' OR LOWER(column_name) LIKE '%passwd%' OR LOWER(column_name) LIKE '%secret%' OR LOWER(column_name) LIKE '%api_key%' OR LOWER(column_name) LIKE '%email%' OR LOWER(column_name) LIKE '%phone%' OR LOWER(column_name) LIKE '%mobile%' OR LOWER(column_name) LIKE '%birth%' OR LOWER(column_name) LIKE '%dob%' OR LOWER(column_name) LIKE '%salary%' OR LOWER(column_name) LIKE '%income%' OR LOWER(column_name) LIKE '%bank_account%' OR LOWER(column_name) LIKE '%iban%' OR LOWER(column_name) LIKE '%national_id%' OR LOWER(column_name) LIKE '%passport%' OR LOWER(column_name) LIKE '%tax_id%' OR LOWER(column_name) LIKE '%medical%' OR
