SELECT c.owner AS schema_name, c.table_name, c.column_name, s.num_rows, s.last_analyzed, CASE WHEN LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%ssn%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%bvn%' THEN 'ssn|bvn' WHEN LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%credit_card%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%card_number%' THEN 'Credit Card' WHEN LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%password%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%secret%' THEN 'Credential' WHEN LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%email%' THEN 'Email' WHEN LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%phone%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%mobile%' THEN 'Phone' WHEN LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%salary%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%income%' THEN 'Financial' WHEN LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%national_id%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%passport%' THEN 'Government ID' WHEN LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%medical%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%diagnosis%' THEN 'Medical' ELSE 'Other Sensitive' END AS pii_category FROM all_tab_columns c JOIN all_tables s ON s.owner = c.owner AND s.table_name = c.table_name WHERE c.owner NOT IN ('SYS','SYSTEM','DBSNMP','OUTLN','MDSYS','ORDSYS','CTXSYS','XDB') AND s.num_rows > 0 AND (LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%ssn%' OR (LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%bvn%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%credit_card%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%password%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%email%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%phone%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%salary%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%bank_account%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%national_id%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%passport%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%tax_id%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%medical%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%diagnosis%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%birth%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%secret%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%api_key%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%iban%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%income%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%biometric%') ORDER BY s.num_rows DESC

SELECT s.sid AS session_id, s.username AS login_name, s.machine AS host_name, s.program AS program_name, s.module, c.owner AS schema_name, c.table_name, c.column_name, CASE WHEN LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%password%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%pass%' THEN 'Password' WHEN LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%secret%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%token%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%key%' THEN 'Credential' WHEN LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%credit%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%card%' THEN 'Credit Card' WHEN LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%ssn%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%bvn%' THEN 'ssn|bvn' WHEN LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%email%' THEN 'Email' WHEN LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%phone%' THEN 'Phone' WHEN LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%address%' THEN 'Address' WHEN LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%dob%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%birth%' THEN 'Date of Birth' WHEN LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%salary%' THEN 'Salary' ELSE 'Other Sensitive' END AS pii_category, SUBSTR(sq.sql_text, 1, 4000) AS query_text, s.status FROM v$session s JOIN v$sql sq ON sq.sql_id = s.sql_id JOIN all_tab_columns c ON UPPER(sq.sql_text) LIKE '%' || UPPER(c.table_name) || '%' WHERE s.type = 'USER' AND s.status = 'ACTIVE' AND s.sid <> SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV', 'SID') AND c.owner NOT IN ('SYS','SYSTEM','DBSNMP','OUTLN','MDSYS','ORDSYS','CTXSYS','XDB','WMSYS') AND (LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%password%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%pass%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%secret%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%token%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%key%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%credit%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%card%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%ssn%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%bvn%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%email%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%phone%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%address%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%dob%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%birth%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%salary%') ORDER BY s.sid, c.table_name, c.column_name

WITH sensitive_cols AS (SELECT c.owner AS schema_name, c.table_name, c.column_name, CASE WHEN LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%password%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%pass%' THEN 'Password' WHEN LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%secret%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%token%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%key%' THEN 'Credential' WHEN LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%credit%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%card%' THEN 'Credit Card' WHEN LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%ssn%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%bvn%' THEN 'ssn|bvn' WHEN LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%email%' THEN 'Email' WHEN LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%phone%' THEN 'Phone' WHEN LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%address%' THEN 'Address' WHEN LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%dob%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%birth%' THEN 'Date of Birth' WHEN LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%salary%' THEN 'Salary' WHEN LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%passport%' THEN 'Passport' WHEN LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%medical%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%diagnosis%' THEN 'Medical' WHEN LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%teudat%' THEN 'Teudat Zehut' ELSE 'Other Sensitive' END AS pii_category FROM all_tab_columns c WHERE c.owner NOT IN ('SYS','SYSTEM','DBSNMP','OUTLN','MDSYS','ORDSYS','CTXSYS','XDB','WMSYS') AND (LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%password%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%pass%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%secret%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%token%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%key%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%credit%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%card%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%ssn%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%bvn%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%email%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%phone%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%address%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%dob%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%birth%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%salary%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%passport%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%medical%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%diagnosis%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%teudat%')) SELECT 'cached_plan' AS source, CAST(NULL AS NUMBER) AS session_id, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(50)) AS transaction_id, sql.executions AS execution_count, sql.last_active_time AS last_execution_time, sql.buffer_gets / NULLIF(sql.executions, 0) AS avg_reads, sql.cpu_time / NULLIF(sql.executions, 0) / 1000 AS avg_cpu_ms, CAST(NULL AS DATE) AS transaction_begin_time, sc.schema_name, sc.table_name, sc.column_name, sc.pii_category, SUBSTR(sql.sql_text, 1, 4000) AS query_text, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(128)) AS login_name FROM v$sql sql JOIN sensitive_cols sc ON UPPER(sql.sql_text) LIKE '%' || UPPER(sc.table_name) || '%' WHERE sql.sql_text IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'active_transaction' AS source, s.sid AS session_id, t.xidusn || '.' || t.xidslot || '.' || t.xidsqn AS transaction_id, CAST(NULL AS NUMBER), CAST(NULL AS DATE), CAST(NULL AS NUMBER), CAST(NULL AS NUMBER), t.start_date AS transaction_begin_time, sc.schema_name, sc.table_name, sc.column_name, sc.pii_category, SUBSTR(sql.sql_text, 1, 4000) AS query_text, s.username AS login_name FROM v$transaction t JOIN v$session s ON s.taddr = t.addr JOIN v$sql sql ON sql.sql_id = COALESCE(s.sql_id, s.prev_sql_id) JOIN sensitive_cols sc ON UPPER(sql.sql_text) LIKE '%' || UPPER(sc.table_name) || '%' WHERE s.type = 'USER' AND sql.sql_text IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1, 5 DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT
    SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV','DB_NAME') AS db_name,
    owner                            AS schema_name,
    table_name                       AS table_name,
    column_name                      AS column_name,
    data_type                        AS data_type,
    data_length                      AS max_length,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(50))       AS pii_category
FROM all_tab_columns
WHERE owner NOT IN ('SYS','SYSTEM','XDB','MDSYS','CTXSYS','DBSNMP','OUTLN',
    'APPQOSSYS','ORDSYS','WMSYS','GSMADMIN_INTERNAL','AUDSYS','DVSYS','LBACSYS',
    'OJVMSYS','ORDDATA','OLAPSYS')
ORDER BY owner, table_name, column_id
SELECT policy_name, audit_option, audit_option_type, audit_condition FROM audit_unified_policies WHERE audit_option IN ('ALL', 'ALL STATEMENTS') OR audit_condition IS NULL ORDER BY policy_name

SELECT sql_id, SUBSTR(sql_text, 1, 300) AS sql_preview FROM v$sql WHERE (sql_text LIKE '%password%=%' OR sql_text LIKE '%passwd%=%' OR sql_text LIKE '%secret%=%' OR sql_text LIKE '%ssn%=%' OR sql_text LIKE '%credit_card%=%') AND parsing_schema_name NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM') ORDER BY last_active_time DESC FETCH FIRST 20 ROWS ONLY
SELECT name, value FROM v$parameter WHERE name IN ('max_dump_file_size', '_trace_files_public', 'sec_return_server_release_banner', 'diagnostic_dest') ORDER BY name
SELECT COUNT(*) AS audit_record_count, MIN(event_timestamp) AS oldest_record, MAX(event_timestamp) AS newest_record FROM unified_audit_trail
SELECT name, value FROM v$parameter WHERE name IN ('plsql_debug', 'plsql_warnings') AND value NOT IN ('DISABLE:ALL', 'FALSE') ORDER BY name
SELECT name, value FROM v$parameter WHERE name IN ('max_dump_file_size', 'diagnostic_dest', 'core_dump_dest', '_trace_files_public', 'background_dump_dest', 'user_dump_dest') ORDER BY name
SELECT name, value FROM v$parameter WHERE name IN ('sql_trace', 'tracefile_identifier', 'max_dump_file_size', '_trace_files_public') ORDER BY name
SELECT sid, serial#, username, program, event, action FROM v$session WHERE event LIKE '%debug%' OR event LIKE '%trace%' OR action LIKE '%debug%' ORDER BY username

SELECT s.sid, s.serial#, s.username, s.program, s.sql_trace, s.logon_time, ROUND(SYSDATE - s.logon_time) AS days_active FROM v$session s WHERE s.sql_trace = 'ENABLED' AND SYSDATE - s.logon_time > 1 ORDER BY s.logon_time
SELECT name, value FROM v$parameter WHERE name LIKE '%diagnostic%' OR name LIKE '%dump%' OR name LIKE '%trace%' ORDER BY name

SELECT SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV','DB_NAME') AS database_name, 'missing PPL_SECURITY_LEVEL parameter' AS finding FROM dual WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM database_properties WHERE property_name = 'PPL_SECURITY_LEVEL')
SELECT owner, table_name, num_rows FROM all_tables WHERE num_rows >= 100000 AND owner NOT IN ('SYS','SYSTEM','DBSNMP','OUTLN','MDSYS','ORDSYS','CTXSYS','XDB','WMSYS') ORDER BY num_rows DESC
SELECT name, value FROM v$parameter WHERE name IN ('remote_login_passwordfile','remote_os_authent') AND value NOT IN ('NONE','FALSE')
SELECT tablespace_name, encrypted FROM dba_tablespaces WHERE encrypted = 'NO' AND contents = 'PERMANENT' AND tablespace_name NOT IN ('SYSTEM','SYSAUX')

SELECT c.owner, c.table_name, c.column_name, c.data_type FROM all_tab_columns c LEFT JOIN dba_encrypted_columns ec ON ec.owner = c.owner AND ec.table_name = c.table_name AND ec.column_name = c.column_name WHERE ec.column_name IS NULL AND c.owner NOT IN ('SYS','SYSTEM','DBSNMP','OUTLN') AND (LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%password%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%ssn%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%bvn%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%credit_card%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%email%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%phone%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%medical%')
SELECT name, value FROM v$parameter WHERE name = 'sqlnet.allowed_logon_version_server' AND value < '12'
SELECT name, value FROM v$parameter WHERE name = 'audit_trail' AND LOWER(value) IN ('none','')

SELECT DISTINCT c.owner, c.table_name
FROM all_tab_columns c
WHERE c.owner NOT IN ('SYS','SYSTEM','DBSNMP')
  AND (LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%password%'
       OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%ssn%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%bvn%'
       OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%credit_card%'
       OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%email%')
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM dba_obj_audit_opts a
      WHERE a.object_name = c.table_name
        AND a.owner = c.owner
        AND a.alt = 'A/A'
  )
SELECT job_name, last_start_date FROM dba_scheduler_jobs WHERE job_name LIKE '%AUDIT%PURGE%' AND repeat_interval LIKE '%FREQ=DAILY%'

SELECT p.owner, p.table_name, p.privilege FROM dba_tab_privs p JOIN all_tab_columns c ON c.owner = p.owner AND c.table_name = p.table_name WHERE p.grantee = 'PUBLIC' AND p.privilege = 'SELECT' AND (LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%password%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%ssn%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%bvn%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%credit_card%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%email%')

SELECT grantee, granted_role FROM dba_role_privs WHERE granted_role IN ('DBA','SYSDBA') AND (LOWER(grantee) LIKE '%app%' OR LOWER(grantee) LIKE '%svc%' OR LOWER(grantee) LIKE '%service%' OR LOWER(grantee) LIKE '%api%')
SELECT username, last_login FROM dba_users WHERE account_status = 'OPEN' AND (last_login IS NULL OR last_login < SYSDATE - 90) AND username NOT IN ('SYS','SYSTEM','DBSNMP','XS$NULL')
SELECT username, profile FROM dba_users WHERE profile = 'DEFAULT' AND account_status = 'OPEN' AND username NOT IN ('SYS','SYSTEM','DBSNMP')
SELECT username FROM dba_users WHERE account_status = 'OPEN' AND LOWER(username) IN ('admin','app','svc','dba','root','test','dbuser')
SELECT username, account_status FROM dba_users WHERE username IN ('SYS','SYSTEM') AND account_status = 'OPEN'

SELECT name AS database_name, MAX(end_time) AS last_backup FROM v$database, v$rman_backup_job_details WHERE input_type IN ('DB FULL','DB INCR') GROUP BY name HAVING MAX(end_time) < SYSDATE - 7 OR MAX(end_time) IS NULL
SELECT bs_key, completion_time, encrypted FROM v$backup_set_details WHERE completion_time > SYSDATE - 30 AND encrypted = 'NO'
SELECT name AS data_file, 'check db_recovery_file_dest = data dir' AS finding FROM v$datafile WHERE ROWNUM = 1

SELECT c.owner, c.table_name, c.column_name FROM all_tab_columns c WHERE c.data_type IN ('DATE','TIMESTAMP') AND (LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%created%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%insert%') AND c.owner NOT IN ('SYS','SYSTEM') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM all_tab_columns c2 WHERE c2.owner = c.owner AND c2.table_name = c.table_name AND (LOWER(c2.column_name) LIKE '%email%' OR LOWER(c2.column_name) LIKE '%phone%'))
SELECT owner, table_name, column_name FROM all_tab_columns WHERE (LOWER(column_name) LIKE '%last_login%' OR LOWER(column_name) LIKE '%last_active%') AND owner NOT IN ('SYS','SYSTEM')

SELECT owner, table_name, column_name FROM all_tab_columns WHERE (LOWER(column_name) IN ('is_deleted','isdeleted','deleted') OR LOWER(column_name) LIKE '%deleted_at%') AND owner NOT IN ('SYS','SYSTEM')

SELECT username, os_username, COUNT(*) AS failed_count, MAX(timestamp) AS last_failure FROM dba_audit_session WHERE returncode <> 0 AND timestamp > SYSDATE - 1/24 GROUP BY username, os_username HAVING COUNT(*) > 20
SELECT grantee, granted_role, default_role, admin_option FROM dba_role_privs WHERE granted_role IN ('DBA','SYSDBA') AND grantee NOT IN ('SYS','SYSTEM','DBA_USERS')
SELECT s.sid, s.username, s.machine, s.program FROM v$session s WHERE s.type = 'USER' AND s.status = 'ACTIVE' AND (TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24')) < 6 OR TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24')) >= 22)

SELECT c.owner, c.table_name, c.column_name FROM all_tab_columns c LEFT JOIN dba_encrypted_columns ec ON ec.owner = c.owner AND ec.table_name = c.table_name AND ec.column_name = c.column_name WHERE ec.column_name IS NULL AND c.owner NOT IN ('SYS','SYSTEM') AND (LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%teudat%zehut%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) = 'tz' OR LOWER(c.column_name) = 'national_id' OR LOWER(c.column_name) = 'israeli_id')

SELECT owner, table_name, column_name FROM all_tab_columns WHERE owner NOT IN ('SYS','SYSTEM') AND (LOWER(column_name) LIKE '%medical%' OR LOWER(column_name) LIKE '%diagnosis%' OR LOWER(column_name) LIKE '%treatment%' OR LOWER(column_name) LIKE '%prescription%' OR LOWER(column_name) LIKE '%health%')

SELECT owner, table_name, column_name FROM all_tab_columns WHERE owner NOT IN ('SYS','SYSTEM') AND (LOWER(column_name) LIKE '%religion%' OR LOWER(column_name) = 'dat' OR LOWER(column_name) LIKE '%political%' OR LOWER(column_name) LIKE '%orientation%' OR LOWER(column_name) LIKE '%ethnic%')

SELECT grantee, privilege FROM dba_sys_privs WHERE privilege LIKE '%ANY%' AND grantee NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'DBA', 'DATAPUMP_EXP_FULL_DATABASE', 'DATAPUMP_IMP_FULL_DATABASE') ORDER BY grantee, privilege

SELECT policy_name, audit_option, audit_option_type FROM audit_unified_policies WHERE audit_option IN ('GRANT', 'REVOKE', 'ALTER USER', 'CREATE USER', 'DROP USER', 'CREATE ROLE', 'ALTER ROLE', 'DROP ROLE') ORDER BY policy_name

SELECT grantee, COUNT(*) AS priv_count FROM dba_sys_privs WHERE grantee NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'DBA', 'DATAPUMP_EXP_FULL_DATABASE', 'DATAPUMP_IMP_FULL_DATABASE') GROUP BY grantee HAVING COUNT(*) > 10 ORDER BY priv_count DESC FETCH FIRST 20 ROWS ONLY

SELECT username, COUNT(DISTINCT machine) AS distinct_machines, COUNT(DISTINCT program) AS distinct_programs, COUNT(*) AS active_sessions FROM v$session WHERE username IN (SELECT grantee FROM dba_role_privs WHERE granted_role = 'DBA' AND grantee NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM')) GROUP BY username HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT machine) > 2 ORDER BY distinct_machines DESC

SELECT u.username, u.account_status, TO_CHAR(u.last_login, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS last_login, TO_CHAR(u.created, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS created, ROUND(SYSDATE - NVL(CAST(u.last_login AS DATE), u.created)) AS days_inactive, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dba_sys_privs WHERE grantee = u.username) AS sys_priv_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dba_role_privs WHERE grantee = u.username) AS role_count FROM dba_users u WHERE u.account_status = 'OPEN' AND NVL(CAST(u.last_login AS DATE), u.created) < SYSDATE - 90 AND u.username NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'DBSNMP', 'OUTLN', 'XDB', 'AUDSYS', 'GSMADMIN_INTERNAL') ORDER BY days_inactive DESC FETCH FIRST 20 ROWS ONLY
SELECT grantee, granted_role, admin_option FROM dba_role_privs WHERE grantee IN (SELECT role FROM dba_roles) AND grantee NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM') ORDER BY grantee, granted_role

SELECT policy_name, audit_option FROM audit_unified_policies WHERE audit_option IN ('GRANT', 'REVOKE', 'ALTER USER', 'CREATE USER', 'DROP USER') AND policy_name IN (SELECT policy_name FROM audit_unified_enabled_policies) ORDER BY policy_name

SELECT grantee, granted_role, admin_option, default_role FROM dba_role_privs WHERE grantee NOT IN (SELECT role FROM dba_roles) AND grantee NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'PUBLIC') AND granted_role IN (SELECT grantee FROM dba_role_privs WHERE granted_role IN ('DBA', 'RESOURCE') OR grantee IN (SELECT grantee FROM dba_sys_privs WHERE privilege LIKE '%ANY%')) ORDER BY grantee
SELECT username FROM dba_users_with_defpwd WHERE username NOT IN ('XS$NULL') ORDER BY username
SELECT name, type, status FROM dba_priv_captures ORDER BY name
SELECT COUNT(*) AS pdb_count FROM v$containers WHERE con_id > 2

SELECT owner, object_name, object_type, status FROM ALL_OBJECTS WHERE object_type LIKE 'JAVA%' AND owner NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'PUBLIC', 'ORDSYS', 'MDSYS', 'XDB', 'WMSYS') ORDER BY owner, object_name FETCH FIRST 20 ROWS ONLY
SELECT TO_CHAR(MAX(action_time), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS last_patch_date, ROUND(SYSDATE - CAST(MAX(action_time) AS DATE)) AS days_since_patch FROM dba_registry_sqlpatch WHERE action = 'APPLY'
SELECT parameter, value FROM v$option WHERE value = 'TRUE' ORDER BY parameter

SELECT GRANTEE, PRIVILEGE FROM DBA_SYS_PRIVS WHERE PRIVILEGE IN ('CREATE ANY PROCEDURE', 'CREATE ANY TRIGGER', 'CREATE ANY TYPE', 'ALTER ANY PROCEDURE', 'ALTER ANY TRIGGER') AND GRANTEE NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'DBA') ORDER BY GRANTEE, PRIVILEGE

SELECT OWNER, OBJECT_TYPE, COUNT(*) AS object_count FROM ALL_OBJECTS WHERE OBJECT_TYPE IN ('PACKAGE', 'PACKAGE BODY', 'PROCEDURE', 'FUNCTION', 'TRIGGER', 'JAVA CLASS', 'JAVA SOURCE') AND OWNER NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'MDSYS', 'CTXSYS', 'XDB', 'WMSYS', 'ORDSYS', 'DBSNMP', 'APPQOSSYS', 'GSMADMIN_INTERNAL', 'AUDSYS', 'OUTLN', 'ORDDATA', 'ORDPLUGINS', 'SI_INFORMTN_SCHEMA', 'DVSYS', 'LBACSYS', 'DVF') GROUP BY OWNER, OBJECT_TYPE ORDER BY OWNER, object_count DESC

SELECT u.USERNAME, u.ACCOUNT_STATUS, u.CREATED, u.DEFAULT_TABLESPACE, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DBA_OBJECTS o WHERE o.OWNER = u.USERNAME) AS object_count FROM DBA_USERS u WHERE u.USERNAME NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'MDSYS', 'CTXSYS', 'XDB', 'WMSYS', 'ORDSYS', 'DBSNMP', 'APPQOSSYS', 'GSMADMIN_INTERNAL', 'AUDSYS', 'OUTLN', 'ORDDATA', 'ORDPLUGINS', 'SI_INFORMTN_SCHEMA', 'DVSYS', 'LBACSYS', 'DVF', 'ANONYMOUS', 'XS$NULL') AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DBA_OBJECTS o WHERE o.OWNER = u.USERNAME) > 0 ORDER BY object_count DESC

SELECT GRANTEE, COUNT(*) AS priv_count FROM DBA_SYS_PRIVS WHERE GRANTEE NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'DBA', 'IMP_FULL_DATABASE', 'EXP_FULL_DATABASE', 'DATAPUMP_IMP_FULL_DATABASE', 'DATAPUMP_EXP_FULL_DATABASE') AND ADMIN_OPTION = 'YES' GROUP BY GRANTEE HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY priv_count DESC

SELECT x.grantee, x.type_name, x.name, x.action
FROM XMLTABLE('/ROWSET/ROW' PASSING
  XMLTYPE(NVL(DBMS_XMLGEN.getxml(
    CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM all_objects WHERE object_name = 'DBA_JAVA_POLICY' AND object_type IN ('VIEW','SYNONYM')) > 0
         THEN q'[SELECT grantee, type_name, name, action FROM dba_java_policy WHERE grantee NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'PUBLIC') AND type_name IN ('java.io.FilePermission', 'java.net.SocketPermission', 'java.lang.RuntimePermission') AND action NOT LIKE '%read%' ORDER BY grantee, type_name]'
         ELSE q'[SELECT NULL AS grantee, NULL AS type_name, NULL AS name, NULL AS action FROM dual WHERE 1=0]'
    END), '<ROWSET/>'))
  COLUMNS grantee   VARCHAR2(128)  PATH 'GRANTEE',
          type_name VARCHAR2(256)  PATH 'TYPE_NAME',
          name      VARCHAR2(4000) PATH 'NAME',
          action    VARCHAR2(256)  PATH 'ACTION') x

SELECT OWNER, NAME, TYPE, TEXT FROM ALL_SOURCE WHERE (UPPER(TEXT) LIKE '%EXECUTE IMMEDIATE%' OR UPPER(TEXT) LIKE '%DBMS_SQL%') AND OWNER NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'MDSYS', 'CTXSYS', 'XDB', 'WMSYS', 'ORDSYS', 'AUDSYS') ORDER BY OWNER, NAME FETCH FIRST 20 ROWS ONLY

SELECT OWNER, OBJECT_NAME, OBJECT_TYPE, CREATED, STATUS FROM ALL_OBJECTS WHERE OBJECT_TYPE IN ('PACKAGE', 'PACKAGE BODY', 'PROCEDURE', 'FUNCTION', 'TRIGGER', 'JAVA CLASS') AND CREATED > SYSDATE - 30 AND OWNER NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'MDSYS', 'CTXSYS', 'XDB', 'WMSYS', 'ORDSYS', 'AUDSYS') ORDER BY CREATED DESC

SELECT OWNER, COUNT(*) AS objects, MAX(LAST_DDL_TIME) AS last_modified FROM ALL_OBJECTS WHERE OBJECT_TYPE IN ('PACKAGE', 'PACKAGE BODY', 'PROCEDURE', 'FUNCTION', 'JAVA CLASS') AND OWNER NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'MDSYS', 'CTXSYS', 'XDB', 'WMSYS', 'ORDSYS', 'AUDSYS', 'DBSNMP') GROUP BY OWNER HAVING MAX(LAST_DDL_TIME) < SYSDATE - 365 ORDER BY last_modified

SELECT OWNER, TRIGGER_NAME, TRIGGER_TYPE, TRIGGERING_EVENT, TABLE_OWNER, BASE_OBJECT_TYPE, STATUS FROM ALL_TRIGGERS WHERE BASE_OBJECT_TYPE = 'DATABASE' AND OWNER NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM') ORDER BY OWNER, TRIGGER_NAME
SELECT POLICY_NAME, ENABLED_OPTION FROM AUDIT_UNIFIED_ENABLED_POLICIES WHERE POLICY_NAME LIKE '%DDL%' OR ENABLED_OPTION LIKE '%CREATE%' OR ENABLED_OPTION LIKE '%ALTER%' ORDER BY POLICY_NAME

SELECT OWNER, OBJECT_NAME, OBJECT_TYPE, AUTHID FROM ALL_PROCEDURES WHERE AUTHID = 'CURRENT_USER' AND OWNER NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'MDSYS', 'CTXSYS', 'XDB', 'WMSYS', 'ORDSYS', 'AUDSYS') ORDER BY OWNER, OBJECT_NAME
SELECT USERNAME, ACCOUNT_STATUS FROM DBA_USERS WHERE USERNAME IN (SELECT USERNAME FROM DBA_USERS_WITH_DEFPWD)
SELECT USERNAME, PASSWORD_VERSIONS FROM DBA_USERS WHERE PASSWORD_VERSIONS LIKE '%10G%' AND ACCOUNT_STATUS = 'OPEN'
SELECT u.USERNAME, u.ACCOUNT_STATUS, u.PROFILE, u.CREATED FROM DBA_USERS u WHERE u.USERNAME IN (SELECT USERNAME FROM DBA_USERS_WITH_DEFPWD) AND u.ACCOUNT_STATUS = 'OPEN'

SELECT PROFILE, RESOURCE_NAME, LIMIT FROM DBA_PROFILES WHERE RESOURCE_TYPE = 'PASSWORD' AND PROFILE IN (SELECT DISTINCT PROFILE FROM DBA_USERS WHERE ACCOUNT_STATUS = 'OPEN') ORDER BY PROFILE, RESOURCE_NAME

SELECT USERNAME, ACCOUNT_STATUS, LOCK_DATE, EXPIRY_DATE, CREATED, DEFAULT_TABLESPACE FROM DBA_USERS WHERE USERNAME IN ('SCOTT', 'HR', 'OE', 'SH', 'PM', 'IX', 'BI', 'OUTLN', 'MDSYS', 'CTXSYS', 'DBSNMP', 'XDB', 'APEX_PUBLIC_USER', 'FLOWS_FILES', 'WMSYS', 'ORDSYS', 'ORDDATA', 'ORDPLUGINS', 'SI_INFORMTN_SCHEMA', 'DIP', 'MGMT_VIEW', 'SYSMAN') AND ACCOUNT_STATUS NOT LIKE '%LOCKED%' AND ACCOUNT_STATUS NOT LIKE '%EXPIRED%'
SELECT PROFILE, RESOURCE_NAME, LIMIT FROM DBA_PROFILES WHERE RESOURCE_NAME = 'PASSWORD_VERIFY_FUNCTION' AND PROFILE IN (SELECT DISTINCT PROFILE FROM DBA_USERS WHERE ACCOUNT_STATUS = 'OPEN')

SELECT u.USERNAME, u.ACCOUNT_STATUS, u.PROFILE FROM DBA_USERS u WHERE u.USERNAME IN (SELECT USERNAME FROM DBA_USERS_WITH_DEFPWD) AND u.ACCOUNT_STATUS = 'OPEN' AND u.USERNAME IN ('DBSNMP', 'SYSMAN', 'APPQOSSYS', 'GSMADMIN_INTERNAL', 'XDB', 'MDSYS', 'CTXSYS')
SELECT USERNAME, ACCOUNT_STATUS, EXPIRY_DATE, LOCK_DATE, PROFILE FROM DBA_USERS WHERE ACCOUNT_STATUS = 'OPEN' AND (EXPIRY_DATE IS NULL OR EXPIRY_DATE > SYSDATE + 365) ORDER BY USERNAME

SELECT u.username, u.account_status, u.created, u.expiry_date, u.last_login, u.profile, ROUND(SYSDATE - u.created) AS account_age_days FROM dba_users u WHERE u.oracle_maintained = 'N' AND u.account_status = 'OPEN' AND (u.expiry_date IS NULL OR u.expiry_date > SYSDATE + 365) ORDER BY u.created
SELECT username, password_versions FROM dba_users WHERE oracle_maintained = 'N' AND account_status = 'OPEN' AND password_versions NOT LIKE '%12C%' ORDER BY username
SELECT username, account_status, profile, created, authentication_type FROM dba_users WHERE oracle_maintained = 'Y' AND account_status NOT IN ('EXPIRED & LOCKED', 'LOCKED') ORDER BY username
SELECT authentication_type, COUNT(*) AS user_count FROM dba_users WHERE oracle_maintained = 'N' AND account_status = 'OPEN' GROUP BY authentication_type ORDER BY user_count DESC
SELECT username, account_status, default_tablespace, created, authentication_type FROM dba_users WHERE oracle_maintained = 'Y' ORDER BY account_status, username

SELECT u.username, u.account_status, u.default_tablespace, u.profile, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dba_role_privs rp WHERE rp.grantee = u.username) AS roles, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dba_sys_privs sp WHERE sp.grantee = u.username) AS sys_privs, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dba_tab_privs tp WHERE tp.grantee = u.username) AS obj_privs FROM dba_users u WHERE u.oracle_maintained = 'Y' AND u.account_status NOT LIKE '%LOCKED%' AND u.username NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM') ORDER BY u.username
SELECT d.username, d.account_status, d.password_versions FROM dba_users d JOIN dba_users_with_defpwd dp ON d.username = dp.username WHERE d.account_status = 'OPEN' ORDER BY d.username

SELECT s.sid, s.serial#, s.username, s.osuser, s.machine, s.program, t.start_time, ROUND((SYSDATE - TO_DATE(t.start_time, 'MM/DD/YY HH24:MI:SS')) * 86400) AS duration_seconds, TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(t.start_time, 'MM/DD/YY HH24:MI:SS'), 'HH24')) AS start_hour FROM v$session s JOIN v$transaction t ON t.ses_addr = s.saddr WHERE s.type = 'USER' AND (TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(t.start_time, 'MM/DD/YY HH24:MI:SS'), 'HH24')) < 7 OR TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(t.start_time, 'MM/DD/YY HH24:MI:SS'), 'HH24')) >= 19) AND UPPER(s.username) NOT IN ('SYS','SYSTEM','DBSNMP','SYSMAN','XDB','GSMADMIN_INTERNAL','APP_USER','SVC_APP','ETL_SERVICE') AND NOT (UPPER(COALESCE(s.program, '')) LIKE '%JDBC%' OR UPPER(COALESCE(s.program, '')) LIKE 'W3WP%' OR UPPER(COALESCE(s.program, '')) LIKE '%ODBC%' OR UPPER(COALESCE(s.program, '')) LIKE 'PYTHON%' OR UPPER(COALESCE(s.program, '')) LIKE 'NODE%' OR (COALESCE(s.program, '') <> '' AND UPPER(s.username) LIKE '%' || UPPER(s.program) || '%')) ORDER BY t.start_time

SELECT s1.sid AS sid_a, s1.username AS user_a, s2.sid AS sid_b, s2.username AS user_b, s1.event AS wait_event, sq1.sql_text AS query_a, sq2.sql_text AS query_b FROM v$session s1 JOIN v$session s2 ON
  s1.blocking_session = s2.sid AND s2.blocking_session = s1.sid LEFT JOIN v$sqlarea sq1 ON s1.sql_id = sq1.sql_id LEFT JOIN v$sqlarea sq2 ON s2.sql_id = sq2.sql_id WHERE s1.blocking_session IS NOT NULL AND
  s2.blocking_session IS NOT NULL
SELECT value AS isolation_level FROM v$parameter WHERE name = 'transaction_isolation'

SELECT username AS login_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT machine) AS host_count,
       LISTAGG(DISTINCT machine, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY machine) AS hosts,
       COUNT(*) AS session_count,
       LISTAGG(DISTINCT SUBSTR(sql_text, 1, 500), ' | ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY SUBSTR(sql_text, 1, 500)) AS queries
FROM (
    SELECT s.username, s.machine, s.sid, q.sql_text
    FROM gv$session s
    LEFT JOIN gv$sql q ON q.sql_id = s.sql_id AND q.inst_id = s.inst_id
    WHERE s.username IS NOT NULL AND s.type = 'USER' AND s.machine IS NOT NULL
)
GROUP BY username
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT machine) > 1
ORDER BY host_count DESC
SELECT value AS isolation_level FROM v$parameter WHERE name = 'transaction_isolation'

SELECT s.sid AS trx_id, s.status AS trx_state, s.logon_time AS trx_started, s.seconds_in_wait AS wait_seconds, sq.sql_text AS trx_query FROM v$session s LEFT JOIN v$sqlarea sq ON s.sql_id = sq.sql_id
  WHERE s.blocking_session IS NOT NULL AND s.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY s.seconds_in_wait DESC

SELECT o.object_name AS lock_table, c.table_name AS fk_table, c.constraint_name, r.table_name AS referenced_table FROM v$lock l JOIN dba_objects o ON o.object_id = l.id1 JOIN all_constraints c ON
  c.table_name = o.object_name AND c.constraint_type = 'R' JOIN all_constraints r ON r.constraint_name = c.r_constraint_name AND r.owner = c.r_owner WHERE l.block > 0

SELECT
  s.sid AS session_id,
  s.username AS login_name,
  s.machine AS host_name,
  s.program AS program_name,
  SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV','DB_NAME') AS database_name,
  t.xidusn || '.' || t.xidslot || '.' || t.xidsqn AS transaction_id,
  TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(t.start_time,'MM/DD/YY HH24:MI:SS'),'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS transaction_begin_time,
  s.last_call_et AS duration_seconds,
  s.status AS transaction_state,
  SUBSTR(sq.sql_text, 1, 4000) AS query_text
FROM v$session s
LEFT JOIN v$transaction t ON t.ses_addr = s.saddr
LEFT JOIN v$sql sq ON sq.sql_id = s.sql_id
WHERE s.type = 'USER' AND s.username IS NOT NULL
  AND s.username NOT IN ('SYS','SYSTEM','DBSNMP','SYSMAN','XDB')
  AND (s.status = 'ACTIVE' OR t.ses_addr IS NOT NULL OR s.last_call_et <= 120)

SELECT profile, resource_name, limit FROM dba_profiles WHERE profile = 'DEFAULT' AND resource_name IN ('FAILED_LOGIN_ATTEMPTS', 'PASSWORD_LIFE_TIME', 'PASSWORD_LOCK_TIME', 'PASSWORD_VERIFY_FUNCTION') ORDER BY resource_name
SELECT banner FROM v$version WHERE ROWNUM = 1

SELECT DISTINCT machine, program, COUNT(*) AS connection_count FROM v$session WHERE type = 'USER' AND machine != (SELECT host_name FROM v$instance) GROUP BY machine, program ORDER BY connection_count DESC FETCH FIRST 20 ROWS ONLY

SELECT 'default_passwords' AS check_item, COUNT(*) AS issue_count FROM dba_users_with_defpwd UNION ALL SELECT 'unlimited_login_attempts', COUNT(*) FROM dba_profiles WHERE resource_name = 'FAILED_LOGIN_ATTEMPTS' AND limit = 'UNLIMITED' UNION ALL SELECT 'no_password_verify', COUNT(*) FROM dba_profiles WHERE resource_name = 'PASSWORD_VERIFY_FUNCTION' AND (limit = 'NULL' OR limit IS NULL) UNION ALL SELECT 'audit_trail_none', CASE WHEN (SELECT value FROM v$parameter WHERE name = 'audit_trail') = 'NONE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM dual UNION ALL SELECT 'sample_schemas_open', COUNT(*) FROM dba_users WHERE username IN ('SCOTT', 'HR', 'OE', 'SH', 'PM', 'IX', 'BI') AND account_status = 'OPEN'

SELECT username, account_status, profile, TO_CHAR(created, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS created, default_tablespace, oracle_maintained FROM dba_users WHERE oracle_maintained = 'Y' AND account_status = 'OPEN' AND username NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM') ORDER BY username

SELECT 'mixed_audit_modes' AS check_item, CASE WHEN (SELECT value FROM v$parameter WHERE name = 'audit_trail') != 'NONE' AND (SELECT value FROM v$option WHERE parameter = 'Unified Auditing') = 'TRUE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_issue FROM dual UNION ALL SELECT 'non_standard_profiles', COUNT(*) FROM dba_profiles WHERE profile NOT IN ('DEFAULT', 'ORA_STIG_PROFILE') AND resource_type = 'PASSWORD' GROUP BY profile HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'orphaned_db_links', COUNT(*) FROM dba_db_links WHERE owner NOT IN (SELECT username FROM dba_users WHERE account_status = 'OPEN')
SELECT name, guarantee_flashback_database, storage_size, TO_CHAR(time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS created FROM v$restore_point ORDER BY time DESC

SELECT username, account_status, authentication_type, TO_CHAR(last_login, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS last_login, ROUND(SYSDATE - NVL(CAST(last_login AS DATE), created)) AS days_inactive FROM dba_users WHERE oracle_maintained = 'N' AND account_status = 'OPEN' AND (last_login IS NULL OR last_login < SYSDATE - 90) ORDER BY days_inactive DESC
SELECT authentication_type, COUNT(*) AS account_count FROM dba_users WHERE oracle_maintained = 'N' AND account_status = 'OPEN' GROUP BY authentication_type ORDER BY account_count DESC

SELECT u.username, u.created, u.last_login, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dba_sys_privs sp WHERE sp.grantee = u.username) AS sys_priv_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dba_role_privs rp WHERE rp.grantee = u.username) AS role_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dba_tab_privs tp WHERE tp.grantee = u.username) AS obj_priv_count FROM dba_users u WHERE u.oracle_maintained = 'N' AND u.account_status = 'OPEN' ORDER BY (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dba_sys_privs sp WHERE sp.grantee = u.username) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dba_role_privs rp WHERE rp.grantee = u.username) DESC FETCH FIRST 20 ROWS ONLY
SELECT policy_name, audit_option FROM audit_unified_policies WHERE audit_option IN ('CREATE USER', 'ALTER USER', 'DROP USER', 'GRANT', 'REVOKE') ORDER BY policy_name

SELECT username, account_status, authentication_type, TO_CHAR(created, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS created, TO_CHAR(last_login, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS last_login, ROUND(SYSDATE - NVL(CAST(last_login AS DATE), created)) AS days_since_activity FROM dba_users WHERE oracle_maintained = 'N' AND account_status = 'OPEN' AND (last_login IS NULL OR last_login < SYSDATE - 90) ORDER BY days_since_activity DESC

SELECT username, account_status, authentication_type, created FROM dba_users WHERE username IN ('SCOTT', 'HR', 'OE', 'SH', 'PM', 'IX', 'BI', 'DEMO', 'TEST', 'SAMPLE', 'DBSNMP', 'MGMT_VIEW', 'SYSMAN', 'APEX_PUBLIC_USER') AND account_status = 'OPEN' ORDER BY username
SELECT username FROM dba_users_with_defpwd WHERE username IN (SELECT username FROM dba_users WHERE account_status = 'OPEN') ORDER BY username

SELECT username, account_status, authentication_type, created, last_login FROM dba_users WHERE oracle_maintained = 'N' AND (UPPER(username) LIKE '%TEST%' OR UPPER(username) LIKE '%TEMP%' OR UPPER(username) LIKE '%DEV%' OR UPPER(username) LIKE '%QA%' OR UPPER(username) LIKE '%DEMO%' OR UPPER(username) LIKE '%SAMPLE%' OR UPPER(username) LIKE '%TMP%' OR UPPER(username) LIKE '%DEBUG%') AND account_status = 'OPEN' ORDER BY username

SELECT username, account_status, authentication_type, password_versions, external_name, created FROM dba_users WHERE oracle_maintained = 'N' AND account_status = 'OPEN' AND (authentication_type = 'NONE' OR authentication_type = 'EXTERNAL' OR password_versions IS NULL) ORDER BY username

SELECT username, account_status, authentication_type, external_name, TO_CHAR(created, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS created, TO_CHAR(last_login, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS last_login, ROUND(SYSDATE - NVL(CAST(last_login AS DATE), created)) AS days_inactive FROM dba_users WHERE authentication_type IN ('GLOBAL', 'EXTERNAL') AND account_status = 'OPEN' AND (last_login IS NULL OR last_login < SYSDATE - 90) ORDER BY days_inactive DESC
SELECT name, value FROM v$parameter WHERE name IN ('spfile', 'control_files', 'diagnostic_dest', 'audit_file_dest', 'background_dump_dest', 'user_dump_dest') AND value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY name
SELECT username FROM dba_users_with_defpwd WHERE username IN (SELECT username FROM dba_users WHERE account_status = 'OPEN') ORDER BY username
SELECT name, value FROM v$parameter WHERE name IN ('ldap_directory_access', 'ldap_directory_sysauth') ORDER BY name

SELECT TO_CHAR(created, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS creation_window, COUNT(*) AS accounts_created, LISTAGG(username, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY username) AS usernames FROM dba_users WHERE oracle_maintained = 'N' GROUP BY TO_CHAR(created, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') HAVING COUNT(*) > 3 ORDER BY creation_window DESC
SELECT username, account_status FROM dba_users WHERE username IN ('DBSAT_ADMIN', 'DBSAT', 'SECURITY_SCAN', 'AUDIT_ADMIN') AND account_status != 'EXPIRED & LOCKED'
SELECT resource_name, limit FROM dba_profiles WHERE profile = 'DEFAULT' AND resource_type = 'PASSWORD' ORDER BY resource_name
SELECT profile, resource_name, limit FROM dba_profiles WHERE resource_name = 'PASSWORD_VERIFY_FUNCTION' ORDER BY profile

SELECT name, value FROM v$parameter WHERE name IN ('sec_case_sensitive_logon', 'sqlnet.allowed_logon_version_server', 'sqlnet.allowed_logon_version_client') AND (value = 'FALSE' OR value LIKE '%8%' OR value LIKE '%10%') ORDER BY name

SELECT profile, resource_name, limit FROM dba_profiles WHERE resource_name IN ('PASSWORD_LIFE_TIME', 'PASSWORD_REUSE_TIME', 'PASSWORD_REUSE_MAX', 'PASSWORD_LOCK_TIME', 'FAILED_LOGIN_ATTEMPTS', 'PASSWORD_GRACE_TIME', 'PASSWORD_VERIFY_FUNCTION') AND profile = 'DEFAULT' ORDER BY resource_name

SELECT object_name, object_type, status FROM dba_objects WHERE object_name IN (SELECT limit FROM dba_profiles WHERE resource_name = 'PASSWORD_VERIFY_FUNCTION' AND limit NOT IN ('NULL', 'DEFAULT')) AND object_type = 'FUNCTION' ORDER BY object_name

SELECT profile, resource_name, limit FROM dba_profiles WHERE resource_name IN ('PASSWORD_VERIFY_FUNCTION', 'PASSWORD_LIFE_TIME', 'PASSWORD_REUSE_TIME', 'PASSWORD_REUSE_MAX', 'PASSWORD_LOCK_TIME', 'FAILED_LOGIN_ATTEMPTS') AND profile IN (SELECT DISTINCT profile FROM dba_users WHERE account_status = 'OPEN') ORDER BY profile, resource_name

SELECT profile, resource_name, limit FROM dba_profiles WHERE resource_name IN ('PASSWORD_VERIFY_FUNCTION', 'PASSWORD_LIFE_TIME', 'FAILED_LOGIN_ATTEMPTS') AND limit IN ('NULL', 'DEFAULT', 'UNLIMITED') AND profile IN (SELECT DISTINCT profile FROM dba_users WHERE account_status = 'OPEN') ORDER BY profile, resource_name
SELECT profile, resource_name, limit FROM dba_profiles WHERE resource_type = 'PASSWORD' ORDER BY profile, resource_name

SELECT parameter_name, parameter_value FROM dba_audit_mgmt_config_params WHERE parameter_name = 'AUDIT_TRAIL' UNION ALL SELECT 'UNIFIED_AUDIT' AS parameter_name, DECODE((SELECT value FROM v$option WHERE parameter = 'Unified Auditing'), 'TRUE', 'ENABLED', 'DISABLED') AS parameter_value FROM dual
SELECT username, profile, account_status, created, authentication_type FROM dba_users WHERE created > SYSDATE - 30 AND username NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'DBSNMP', 'OUTLN') ORDER BY created DESC
SELECT name, value FROM v$parameter WHERE name = 'remote_os_roles'
SELECT username, authentication_type, account_status, external_name FROM dba_users WHERE authentication_type = 'EXTERNAL' AND account_status = 'OPEN' ORDER BY username
SELECT u.username, u.authentication_type, u.external_name, u.account_status FROM dba_users u WHERE u.authentication_type IN ('EXTERNAL', 'GLOBAL') AND u.account_status = 'OPEN' ORDER BY u.username
SELECT name, value FROM v$parameter WHERE name IN ('remote_os_authent', 'os_authent_prefix', 'remote_os_roles') ORDER BY name

SELECT name, value FROM v$parameter WHERE name IN ('sqlnet.authentication_services', 'sqlnet.crypto_checksum_server', 'sqlnet.encryption_server', 'sqlnet.crypto_checksum_types_server', 'sqlnet.encryption_types_server') ORDER BY name
SELECT username, authentication_type, external_name, account_status FROM dba_users WHERE authentication_type = 'GLOBAL' AND account_status = 'OPEN' ORDER BY username
SELECT name, value FROM v$parameter WHERE name IN ('remote_os_authent', 'remote_os_roles', 'os_authent_prefix') ORDER BY name
SELECT COUNT(*) AS ext_auth_users FROM dba_users WHERE authentication_type = 'EXTERNAL' AND account_status = 'OPEN'
SELECT username, authentication_type, account_status FROM dba_users WHERE authentication_type = 'GLOBAL' AND account_status = 'OPEN'

SELECT policy_name, audit_option, audit_condition FROM audit_unified_policies WHERE audit_option = 'LOGON' UNION ALL SELECT 'TRADITIONAL' AS policy_name, 'AUDIT_TRAIL' AS audit_option, value AS audit_condition FROM v$parameter WHERE name = 'audit_trail'

SELECT username, authentication_type, account_status, profile, created, last_login, common FROM dba_users WHERE authentication_type = 'PASSWORD' AND account_status = 'OPEN' AND username NOT IN ('SYS','SYSTEM','DBSNMP','OUTLN','XDB') AND oracle_maintained = 'N' ORDER BY username

SELECT username, COUNT(DISTINCT machine) AS distinct_machines, COUNT(DISTINCT program) AS distinct_programs, COUNT(*) AS session_count FROM v$session WHERE type = 'USER' AND username IS NOT NULL AND username NOT IN ('SYS','SYSTEM') GROUP BY username HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT machine) > 5 ORDER BY distinct_machines DESC

SELECT grantee, privilege FROM dba_sys_privs WHERE grantee NOT IN ('SYS','SYSTEM','DBA','IMP_FULL_DATABASE','EXP_FULL_DATABASE') AND privilege IN ('SELECT ANY TABLE', 'INSERT ANY TABLE', 'UPDATE ANY TABLE', 'DELETE ANY TABLE', 'CREATE ANY TABLE', 'DROP ANY TABLE', 'ALTER ANY TABLE', 'GRANT ANY PRIVILEGE', 'CREATE ANY PROCEDURE', 'EXECUTE ANY PROCEDURE') AND grantee IN (SELECT username FROM dba_users WHERE oracle_maintained = 'N') ORDER BY grantee, privilege
SELECT authentication_type, COUNT(*) AS account_count FROM dba_users WHERE oracle_maintained = 'N' AND account_status = 'OPEN' GROUP BY authentication_type ORDER BY account_count DESC

SELECT u.username, u.account_status, u.created, u.expiry_date, p.resource_name, p.limit AS password_life_time FROM dba_users u JOIN dba_profiles p ON u.profile = p.profile WHERE p.resource_name = 'PASSWORD_LIFE_TIME' AND (p.limit = 'UNLIMITED' OR p.limit = 'DEFAULT') AND u.oracle_maintained = 'N' AND u.account_status = 'OPEN' ORDER BY u.created

SELECT username, account_status, profile, created, last_login FROM dba_users WHERE oracle_maintained = 'N' AND (username LIKE '%DEV%' OR username LIKE '%TEST%' OR username LIKE '%QA%' OR username LIKE '%DEMO%' OR username LIKE '%SANDBOX%') AND account_status = 'OPEN' ORDER BY username
SELECT username, account_status, profile, authentication_type FROM dba_users WHERE oracle_maintained = 'Y' AND account_status = 'OPEN' AND username NOT IN ('SYS','SYSTEM') ORDER BY username

SELECT username, account_status, profile, authentication_type, created, last_login FROM dba_users WHERE oracle_maintained = 'N' AND authentication_type = 'PASSWORD' AND account_status = 'OPEN' AND (username LIKE '%SVC%' OR username LIKE '%SERVICE%' OR username LIKE '%APP%' OR username LIKE '%BATCH%' OR username LIKE '%ETL%' OR username LIKE '%API%') ORDER BY username

SELECT p.profile, r.resource_name, r.limit FROM dba_profiles r JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT profile FROM dba_users WHERE account_status = 'OPEN' AND oracle_maintained = 'N') p ON r.profile = p.profile WHERE r.resource_name IN ('PASSWORD_REUSE_TIME', 'PASSWORD_REUSE_MAX', 'PASSWORD_VERIFY_FUNCTION') ORDER BY p.profile, r.resource_name
SELECT username, authentication_type, external_name, account_status FROM dba_users WHERE authentication_type = 'EXTERNAL' AND account_status = 'OPEN' ORDER BY username

SELECT s.username, s.program, s.machine, s.osuser, COUNT(*) AS connection_count FROM v$session s WHERE s.type = 'USER' AND s.username IS NOT NULL AND s.username NOT IN ('SYS','SYSTEM','DBSNMP') GROUP BY s.username, s.program, s.machine, s.osuser HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY connection_count DESC
SELECT policy_name, enabled_option, entity_name, entity_type, success, failure FROM audit_unified_enabled_policies ORDER BY policy_name

SELECT username, account_status, TO_CHAR(last_login, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS last_login, TO_CHAR(created, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS created, ROUND(SYSDATE - NVL(CAST(last_login AS DATE), created)) AS days_since_activity FROM dba_users WHERE oracle_maintained = 'N' AND account_status = 'OPEN' ORDER BY days_since_activity DESC NULLS FIRST FETCH FIRST 20 ROWS ONLY

SELECT username, account_status, TO_CHAR(created, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS created, TO_CHAR(last_login, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS last_login, profile, authentication_type, ROUND(SYSDATE - NVL(CAST(last_login AS DATE), created)) AS days_inactive FROM dba_users WHERE oracle_maintained = 'N' AND account_status = 'OPEN' AND (last_login IS NULL OR last_login < SYSDATE - 90) ORDER BY days_inactive DESC NULLS FIRST

SELECT u.username, u.profile, u.created, u.last_login, p.resource_name, p.limit FROM dba_users u JOIN dba_profiles p ON u.profile = p.profile WHERE u.oracle_maintained = 'N' AND u.account_status = 'OPEN' AND p.resource_name = 'PASSWORD_LIFE_TIME' AND (p.limit = 'UNLIMITED' OR CAST(p.limit AS INT) > 365) AND (u.username LIKE '%SVC%' OR u.username LIKE '%SERVICE%' OR u.username LIKE '%APP%' OR u.username LIKE '%BATCH%') ORDER BY u.username

SELECT username, account_status, TO_CHAR(created, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS created, TO_CHAR(last_login, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS last_login, profile, ROUND(SYSDATE - NVL(CAST(last_login AS DATE), created)) AS days_inactive FROM dba_users WHERE oracle_maintained = 'N' AND account_status = 'OPEN' AND (username LIKE '%CONTRACT%' OR username LIKE '%VENDOR%' OR username LIKE '%EXTERN%' OR username LIKE '%TEMP_%' OR username LIKE '%CONSULT%') AND NVL(CAST(last_login AS DATE), created) < SYSDATE - 60 ORDER BY days_inactive DESC

SELECT grantee, privilege, admin_option FROM dba_sys_privs WHERE grantee IN (SELECT username FROM dba_users WHERE oracle_maintained = 'N' AND account_status = 'OPEN') AND privilege IN ('SELECT ANY TABLE', 'INSERT ANY TABLE', 'DELETE ANY TABLE', 'CREATE ANY TABLE', 'DROP ANY TABLE', 'ALTER ANY TABLE', 'EXECUTE ANY PROCEDURE', 'CREATE SESSION', 'DBA') AND grantee NOT IN ('SYS','SYSTEM') ORDER BY grantee, privilege

SELECT username, account_status, profile, created, last_login, authentication_type FROM dba_users WHERE oracle_maintained = 'N' AND account_status = 'OPEN' AND (username LIKE 'TEST%' OR username LIKE '%_TEST' OR username LIKE 'DEV%' OR username LIKE '%_DEV' OR username LIKE 'QA%' OR username LIKE 'UAT%' OR username LIKE 'DEMO%' OR username LIKE 'SAMPLE%' OR username LIKE 'SCOTT' OR username LIKE 'HR') ORDER BY username

SELECT u.username, u.account_status, u.authentication_type, u.profile, u.created, u.last_login, u.expiry_date, u.oracle_maintained, COUNT(DISTINCT sp.privilege) AS sys_privs, COUNT(DISTINCT rp.granted_role) AS roles FROM dba_users u LEFT JOIN dba_sys_privs sp ON u.username = sp.grantee LEFT JOIN dba_role_privs rp ON u.username = rp.grantee WHERE u.account_status = 'OPEN' GROUP BY u.username, u.account_status, u.authentication_type, u.profile, u.created, u.last_login, u.expiry_date, u.oracle_maintained ORDER BY u.oracle_maintained, u.username
SELECT name, value FROM v$parameter WHERE name IN ('ldap_directory_access', 'os_authent_prefix', 'remote_os_authent') ORDER BY name

SELECT u.username, TO_CHAR(u.created, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS created, u.account_status, TO_CHAR(u.last_login, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS last_login, u.profile, ROUND(SYSDATE - NVL(CAST(u.last_login AS DATE), u.created)) AS days_since_activity FROM dba_users u WHERE u.account_status = 'OPEN' AND u.username NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'DBSNMP', 'OUTLN', 'MDSYS', 'XDB') AND (u.last_login IS NULL OR u.last_login < SYSDATE - 90) ORDER BY days_since_activity DESC

SELECT username, COUNT(DISTINCT machine) AS unique_machines, COUNT(DISTINCT program) AS unique_programs, COUNT(*) AS total_sessions FROM v$session WHERE username IS NOT NULL AND type = 'USER' GROUP BY username HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT machine) > 5 OR COUNT(DISTINCT program) > 5 ORDER BY unique_machines DESC

SELECT u.username, u.created, u.account_status, u.profile, u.default_tablespace, u.authentication_type FROM dba_users u WHERE u.account_status = 'OPEN' AND u.username NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT grantee FROM dba_role_privs WHERE granted_role = 'DBA') AND u.username NOT LIKE '%SYS%' AND u.username NOT LIKE 'APEX%' AND u.username NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'DBSNMP', 'OUTLN', 'MDSYS', 'XDB', 'WMSYS', 'APPQOSSYS', 'ANONYMOUS') ORDER BY u.created

SELECT username, TO_CHAR(last_login, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS last_login, account_status, ROUND(SYSDATE - NVL(CAST(last_login AS DATE), created)) AS days_inactive FROM dba_users WHERE account_status = 'OPEN' AND (last_login IS NULL OR last_login < SYSDATE - 90) AND username NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'DBSNMP', 'OUTLN') ORDER BY days_inactive DESC FETCH FIRST 20 ROWS ONLY

SELECT grantee, COUNT(DISTINCT privilege) AS sys_priv_count FROM dba_sys_privs WHERE grantee NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'DBA', 'IMP_FULL_DATABASE', 'EXP_FULL_DATABASE') AND grantee IN (SELECT username FROM dba_users WHERE account_status = 'OPEN') GROUP BY grantee HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT privilege) > 10 ORDER BY sys_priv_count DESC
SELECT name, value FROM v$parameter WHERE name IN ('audit_trail', 'audit_sys_operations', 'unified_audit_sga_queue_size') ORDER BY name

SELECT 'Total users' AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM dba_users WHERE account_status = 'OPEN' AND username NOT LIKE '%SYS%' UNION ALL SELECT 'Users with DBA role', COUNT(*) FROM dba_role_privs WHERE granted_role = 'DBA' AND grantee IN (SELECT username FROM dba_users WHERE account_status = 'OPEN') UNION ALL SELECT 'Direct object grants', COUNT(*) FROM dba_tab_privs WHERE grantee IN (SELECT username FROM dba_users WHERE account_status = 'OPEN') AND grantee NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'PUBLIC') UNION ALL SELECT 'System privilege grants', COUNT(*) FROM dba_sys_privs WHERE grantee IN (SELECT username FROM dba_users WHERE account_status = 'OPEN') AND grantee NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM')
SELECT username, account_status, authentication_type, external_name FROM dba_users WHERE authentication_type = 'EXTERNAL' ORDER BY username
SELECT username FROM dba_users_with_defpwd WHERE username IN (SELECT username FROM dba_users WHERE account_status = 'OPEN')
SELECT username, authentication_type, external_name, account_status FROM dba_users WHERE authentication_type = 'EXTERNAL' AND account_status = 'OPEN' ORDER BY username

SELECT name, value FROM v$parameter WHERE (name = 'remote_os_authent' AND value = 'TRUE') OR (name = 'sec_case_sensitive_logon' AND value = 'FALSE') OR (name = 'remote_login_passwordfile' AND value = 'NONE') OR (name = 'O7_DICTIONARY_ACCESSIBILITY' AND value = 'TRUE') OR (name = 'remote_os_roles' AND value = 'TRUE') ORDER BY name
SELECT name, value FROM v$parameter WHERE name IN ('local_listener', 'remote_listener', 'dispatchers', 'sec_protocol_error_trace_action', 'sec_protocol_error_further_action') ORDER BY name

SELECT name, value FROM v$parameter WHERE (name = 'audit_trail' AND value = 'NONE') OR (name = 'sec_return_server_release_banner' AND value = 'TRUE') OR (name = 'sql92_security' AND value = 'FALSE') OR (name = 'remote_os_authent' AND value = 'TRUE') OR (name = 'O7_DICTIONARY_ACCESSIBILITY' AND value = 'TRUE') ORDER BY name

SELECT name, value FROM v$parameter WHERE name IN ('sqlnet.encryption_server', 'sqlnet.crypto_checksum_server', 'sqlnet.encryption_types_server') OR name LIKE '%encryption%' OR name LIKE '%crypto%' ORDER BY name
SELECT name, value FROM v$parameter WHERE name IN ('remote_login_passwordfile', 'sec_case_sensitive_logon') ORDER BY name

SELECT DISTINCT s.machine, s.program, s.username FROM v$session s WHERE s.type = 'USER' AND (s.machine LIKE '%pod%' OR s.machine LIKE '%container%' OR s.machine LIKE '%docker%' OR s.machine LIKE '%k8s%' OR LENGTH(s.machine) = 12) ORDER BY s.machine
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT machine) AS unique_clients, COUNT(DISTINCT username) AS unique_users FROM v$session WHERE type = 'USER' AND username IS NOT NULL

SELECT username, account_status, lock_date, expiry_date FROM dba_users WHERE username IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM') OR username IN (SELECT grantee FROM dba_role_privs WHERE granted_role = 'DBA') ORDER BY username
SELECT policy_name, enabled_option, entity_name, entity_type, success, failure FROM audit_unified_enabled_policies ORDER BY policy_name

SELECT name, value, ismodified FROM v$parameter WHERE ismodified != 'FALSE' AND name IN ('audit_trail', 'audit_sys_operations', 'remote_login_passwordfile', 'sec_case_sensitive_logon', 'remote_os_authent', 'o7_dictionary_accessibility', 'utl_file_dir', 'sec_protocol_error_trace_action') ORDER BY name
SELECT name, value FROM v$parameter WHERE name IN ('audit_trail', 'audit_sys_operations') ORDER BY name
SELECT comp_id, comp_name, version, status FROM dba_registry WHERE comp_id IN ('AUDIT_VAULT', 'DV') OR comp_name LIKE '%Audit%' ORDER BY comp_name
SELECT policy_name, enabled_option, entity_name, entity_type, success, failure FROM audit_unified_enabled_policies ORDER BY policy_name
SELECT banner FROM v$version WHERE ROWNUM = 1 UNION ALL SELECT parameter || ': ' || value FROM v$option WHERE parameter IN ('Unified Auditing', 'Database Vault', 'Label Security') ORDER BY 1
SELECT name, value FROM v$parameter WHERE name IN ('audit_file_dest', 'audit_trail', 'audit_syslog_level') ORDER BY name
SELECT COUNT(*) AS enabled_policies FROM audit_unified_enabled_policies
SELECT name, value FROM v$parameter WHERE name IN ('audit_file_dest', 'audit_trail', 'audit_syslog_level') ORDER BY name
SELECT policy_name, audit_option FROM audit_unified_policies WHERE policy_name NOT LIKE 'ORA_%' ORDER BY policy_name

SELECT sp.name, sp.value AS spfile_value, p.value AS runtime_value FROM v$spparameter sp JOIN v$parameter p ON sp.name = p.name WHERE sp.name IN ('audit_trail', 'audit_sys_operations', 'audit_file_dest') AND sp.value IS NOT NULL AND sp.value != p.value ORDER BY sp.name
SELECT username, account_status, default_tablespace FROM dba_users WHERE username = 'AUDSYS'
SELECT con_id, name, open_mode FROM v$containers ORDER BY con_id

SELECT originating_timestamp, message_text FROM v$diag_alert_ext WHERE (message_text LIKE '%audit%' OR message_text LIKE '%AUDSYS%') AND (message_text LIKE '%error%' OR message_text LIKE '%fail%' OR message_text LIKE '%crash%' OR message_text LIKE '%ORA-%') AND originating_timestamp > SYSDATE - 7 ORDER BY originating_timestamp DESC FETCH FIRST 20 ROWS ONLY

SELECT TO_CHAR(MIN(event_timestamp), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS oldest_record, TO_CHAR(MAX(event_timestamp), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS newest_record, COUNT(*) AS total_records FROM unified_audit_trail

SELECT df.tablespace_name, ROUND(df.total_mb, 1) AS total_mb, ROUND(df.total_mb - NVL(fs.free_mb, 0), 1) AS used_mb, ROUND(NVL(fs.free_mb, 0), 1) AS free_mb, ROUND((df.total_mb - NVL(fs.free_mb, 0)) / df.total_mb * 100, 1) AS pct_used FROM (SELECT tablespace_name, SUM(bytes) / 1024 / 1024 AS total_mb FROM dba_data_files WHERE tablespace_name = (SELECT default_tablespace FROM dba_users WHERE username = 'AUDSYS') GROUP BY tablespace_name) df LEFT JOIN (SELECT tablespace_name, SUM(bytes) / 1024 / 1024 AS free_mb FROM dba_free_space WHERE tablespace_name = (SELECT default_tablespace FROM dba_users WHERE username = 'AUDSYS') GROUP BY tablespace_name) fs ON df.tablespace_name = fs.tablespace_name
SELECT audit_trail, last_archive_ts FROM dba_audit_mgmt_last_arch_ts ORDER BY audit_trail

SELECT TO_CHAR(MIN(event_timestamp), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS oldest_record, ROUND(SYSDATE - CAST(MIN(event_timestamp) AS DATE)) AS retention_days, COUNT(*) AS total_records FROM unified_audit_trail

SELECT job_name, status, actual_start_date, run_duration, additional_info FROM dba_scheduler_job_run_details WHERE job_name LIKE '%AUDIT%' AND actual_start_date > SYSDATE - 30 ORDER BY actual_start_date DESC FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY

SELECT s.SEGMENT_NAME, s.TABLESPACE_NAME, ROUND(s.BYTES / 1048576, 1) AS size_mb FROM DBA_SEGMENTS s WHERE s.SEGMENT_NAME IN ('AUD$', 'FGA_LOG$', 'CLI_AUD$', 'AUDSYS') OR s.OWNER = 'AUDSYS' ORDER BY s.BYTES DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) AS record_count, MIN(EXTENDED_TIMESTAMP) AS oldest_record, MAX(EXTENDED_TIMESTAMP) AS newest_record FROM DBA_AUDIT_TRAIL
SELECT NAME, VALUE FROM V$PARAMETER WHERE NAME IN ('audit_file_dest', 'audit_trail', 'audit_sys_operations')

SELECT GRANTEE, PRIVILEGE, TABLE_NAME, GRANTOR FROM ALL_TAB_PRIVS WHERE TABLE_NAME IN ('AUD$', 'FGA_LOG$') AND PRIVILEGE IN ('DELETE', 'UPDATE', 'INSERT', 'ALTER') AND GRANTEE NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM')
SELECT NAME, VALUE FROM V$PARAMETER WHERE NAME IN ('audit_trail', 'audit_file_dest', 'audit_sys_operations')
SELECT NAME, VALUE FROM V$PARAMETER WHERE NAME IN ('audit_trail', 'audit_file_dest')
SELECT VALUE AS audit_mode FROM V$PARAMETER WHERE NAME = 'audit_trail'
SELECT NAME, VALUE FROM V$PARAMETER WHERE NAME IN ('audit_trail', 'audit_syslog_level')
SELECT OBJECT_SCHEMA, OBJECT_NAME, POLICY_NAME, POLICY_TEXT, ENABLED, POLICY_COLUMN FROM DBA_AUDIT_POLICIES WHERE ENABLED = 'YES'

SELECT s.USERNAME, s.OSUSER, s.MACHINE, s.PROGRAM, COUNT(*) AS session_count FROM V$SESSION s WHERE s.USERNAME IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM') OR s.SID IN (SELECT SID FROM V$SESSION WHERE SCHEMANAME = 'SYS') GROUP BY s.USERNAME, s.OSUSER, s.MACHINE, s.PROGRAM HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY session_count DESC
SELECT GRANTEE, PRIVILEGE FROM DBA_SYS_PRIVS WHERE PRIVILEGE IN ('AUDIT ANY', 'AUDIT SYSTEM', 'ADMINISTER DATABASE TRIGGER') AND GRANTEE NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'DBA') ORDER BY GRANTEE
SELECT POLICY_NAME, ENABLED_OPTION, SUCCESS, FAILURE FROM AUDIT_UNIFIED_ENABLED_POLICIES ORDER BY POLICY_NAME
SELECT POLICY_NAME, ENABLED_OPTION, SUCCESS, FAILURE FROM AUDIT_UNIFIED_ENABLED_POLICIES WHERE POLICY_NAME LIKE '%LOGON%' ORDER BY POLICY_NAME

SELECT COUNT(*) AS sessions_audited, COUNT(DISTINCT AUTHENTICATION_TYPE) AS auth_types, COUNT(DISTINCT DBPROXY_USERNAME) AS proxy_users FROM UNIFIED_AUDIT_TRAIL WHERE EVENT_TIMESTAMP > SYSTIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '1' DAY AND ACTION_NAME = 'LOGON'

SELECT POLICY_NAME FROM AUDIT_UNIFIED_ENABLED_POLICIES WHERE POLICY_NAME IN ('ORA_SECURECONFIG', 'ORA_LOGON_FAILURES', 'ORA_ACCOUNT_MGMT', 'ORA_DATABASE_PARAMETER', 'ORA_DV_AUDPOL', 'ORA_DV_AUDPOL2', 'ORA_RAS_POLICY_MGMT', 'ORA_RAS_SESSION_MGMT', 'ORA_CIS_RECOMMENDATIONS')
SELECT POLICY_NAME, AUDIT_CONDITION, CONDITION_EVAL_OPT FROM AUDIT_UNIFIED_POLICIES WHERE AUDIT_CONDITION IS NOT NULL AND AUDIT_CONDITION != 'NONE'

SELECT RETURN_CODE, ACTION_NAME, COUNT(*) AS occurrences FROM UNIFIED_AUDIT_TRAIL WHERE RETURN_CODE != 0 AND EVENT_TIMESTAMP > SYSTIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '7' DAY GROUP BY RETURN_CODE, ACTION_NAME ORDER BY occurrences DESC FETCH FIRST 20 ROWS ONLY

SELECT AUTHENTICATION_TYPE, COUNT(*) AS logon_count FROM UNIFIED_AUDIT_TRAIL WHERE ACTION_NAME = 'LOGON' AND EVENT_TIMESTAMP > SYSTIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '7' DAY GROUP BY AUTHENTICATION_TYPE ORDER BY logon_count DESC

SELECT entity_name, policy_name, enabled_option
FROM audit_unified_enabled_policies
WHERE entity_type = 'USER'
  AND enabled_option LIKE 'EXCEPT%'
ORDER BY entity_name

SELECT policy_name, audit_option, audit_option_type, object_schema, object_name FROM audit_unified_policies WHERE audit_option_type = 'STANDARD ACTION' AND audit_option IN ('SELECT', 'INSERT', 'UPDATE', 'DELETE') ORDER BY policy_name
SELECT name, value FROM v$parameter WHERE name = 'audit_trail' ORDER BY name

SELECT policy_name, entity_name, entity_type, enabled_option FROM audit_unified_enabled_policies WHERE entity_type = 'USER' AND entity_name IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'SYSMAN', 'DBSNMP') AND enabled_option = 'EXCEPT' ORDER BY policy_name

SELECT policy_name, audit_option, object_schema, object_name FROM audit_unified_policies WHERE audit_option IN ('CREATE TABLE', 'ALTER TABLE', 'DROP TABLE', 'CREATE INDEX', 'DROP INDEX', 'CREATE VIEW', 'DROP VIEW', 'CREATE PROCEDURE', 'DROP PROCEDURE', 'CREATE TRIGGER', 'DROP TRIGGER') ORDER BY policy_name

SELECT u.username, u.account_status, u.created, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM audit_unified_enabled_policies p WHERE p.entity_name = u.username AND p.entity_type = 'USER') THEN 'AUDITED' ELSE 'NOT_AUDITED' END AS audit_status FROM dba_users u WHERE u.username NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'DBSNMP', 'OUTLN', 'XDB') AND u.account_status = 'OPEN' AND u.oracle_maintained = 'N' ORDER BY u.username

SELECT t.owner, t.table_name, t.temporary, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM audit_unified_policies p WHERE p.object_schema = t.owner AND p.object_name = t.table_name) THEN 'AUDITED' ELSE 'NOT_AUDITED' END AS audit_status FROM dba_tables t WHERE t.temporary = 'Y' AND t.owner NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM') ORDER BY t.owner, t.table_name

SELECT policy_name, audit_option FROM audit_unified_policies WHERE audit_option_type = 'STANDARD ACTION' AND (audit_option LIKE 'EXECUTE%' OR audit_option LIKE '%PROCEDURE%' OR audit_option LIKE '%PACKAGE%') ORDER BY policy_name
SELECT name, value FROM v$parameter WHERE name IN ('audit_trail', 'unified_audit_sga_queue_size') ORDER BY name

SELECT s.SID, s.SERIAL#, s.USERNAME, s.OSUSER, s.MACHINE,
       s.STATUS, q.SQL_TEXT, s.LOGON_TIME
FROM V$SESSION s
JOIN V$SQL q ON s.SQL_ID = q.SQL_ID
WHERE s.STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
  AND q.COMMAND_TYPE IN (2,6,7,9)
  AND s.USERNAME IN (
      SELECT GRANTEE FROM DBA_ROLE_PRIVS WHERE GRANTED_ROLE = 'DBA'
  )

SELECT s.USERNAME, q.SQL_TEXT, s.MACHINE, s.LOGON_TIME
     FROM V$SESSION s JOIN V$SQL q ON s.SQL_ID = q.SQL_ID
     WHERE s.USERNAME IN (SELECT GRANTEE FROM DBA_ROLE_PRIVS WHERE GRANTED_ROLE = 'DBA')
       AND (UPPER(q.SQL_TEXT) LIKE '%PASSWORD%' OR UPPER(q.SQL_TEXT) LIKE '%CREDENTIAL%'
            OR UPPER(q.SQL_TEXT) LIKE '%SALARY%'  OR UPPER(q.SQL_TEXT) LIKE '%API_KEY%')

SELECT s.USERNAME, o.OWNER AS accessed_schema, q.SQL_TEXT
     FROM V$SESSION s
     JOIN V$SQL q ON s.SQL_ID = q.SQL_ID
     JOIN ALL_OBJECTS o ON UPPER(q.SQL_TEXT) LIKE '%' || o.OBJECT_NAME || '%'
     WHERE s.USERNAME IN (SELECT GRANTEE FROM DBA_ROLE_PRIVS WHERE GRANTED_ROLE = 'DBA')
       AND o.OWNER != s.USERNAME
       AND o.OWNER NOT IN ('SYS','SYSTEM','OUTLN','DBSNMP')
     FETCH FIRST 20 ROWS ONLY

SELECT USERNAME, PROGRAM, MACHINE, TERMINAL, LOGON_TIME, STATUS
FROM V$SESSION
WHERE (UPPER(PROGRAM) LIKE '%SQLPLUS%' OR UPPER(PROGRAM) LIKE '%SQLDEV%'
       OR UPPER(PROGRAM) LIKE '%TOAD%' OR UPPER(PROGRAM) LIKE '%DBEAVER%')
  AND (UPPER(USERNAME) LIKE '%SVC%' OR UPPER(USERNAME) LIKE '%SERVICE%'
       OR UPPER(USERNAME) LIKE '%APP%' OR UPPER(USERNAME) LIKE '%API%'
       OR UPPER(USERNAME) LIKE '%ETL%')

SELECT DB_USER, ACTION_NAME, OBJ_NAME, TIMESTAMP, RETURN_CODE

SELECT USERNAME, CLIENT_INFO, MACHINE, COUNT(*) AS sessions

SELECT SQL_ID, SQL_TEXT, EXECUTIONS, BUFFER_GETS, DISK_READS,
            FIRST_LOAD_TIME, LAST_ACTIVE_TIME

SELECT USERNAME, MACHINE, TERMINAL, PROGRAM, LOGON_TIME, STATUS
     FROM V$SESSION
     WHERE TYPE = 'USER'

       AND MACHINE NOT LIKE '%.corp'

SELECT USERNAME, PROGRAM, MACHINE, LOGON_TIME, STATUS,
       TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(SYSTIMESTAMP),'HH24')) AS utc_hour
FROM V$SESSION
WHERE TYPE = 'USER'
  AND STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
  AND USERNAME NOT IN (
      SELECT USERNAME FROM DBA_USERS
      WHERE REGEXP_LIKE(USERNAME, '(SVC|SERVICE|APP|ETL|BATCH|MONITOR|BACKUP)')
  )
  AND TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(SYSTIMESTAMP),'HH24')) NOT BETWEEN 6 AND 20

SELECT OWNER, OBJECT_NAME, OBJECT_TYPE, CREATED, LAST_DDL_TIME, STATUS

SELECT TO_CHAR(s.logon_time,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS event_time, s.username AS login_name,

SELECT TO_CHAR(event_timestamp,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS event_time, dbusername AS login_name,
       userhost AS host_name, os_username AS os_user,
       'ORA-'||LPAD(TO_CHAR(return_code),5,'0') AS error_info, TO_CHAR(return_code) AS attempts
FROM unified_audit_trail WHERE action_name='LOGON' AND return_code <> 0
  AND event_timestamp > SYSTIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '1' DAY
ORDER BY event_timestamp DESC FETCH FIRST 500 ROWS ONLY

SELECT TO_CHAR(event_timestamp,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS event_time, dbusername AS login_name,
       userhost AS host_name, os_username AS os_user, action_name AS auth_info, sql_text AS statement
FROM unified_audit_trail WHERE (action_name IN ('CREATE USER','CREATE ROLE'))
  AND event_timestamp > SYSTIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '1' DAY
ORDER BY event_timestamp DESC FETCH FIRST 500 ROWS ONLY

SELECT TO_CHAR(event_timestamp,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS event_time, dbusername AS login_name,

FROM unified_audit_trail WHERE (action_name LIKE '%GRANT%')
  AND event_timestamp > SYSTIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '1' DAY
ORDER BY event_timestamp DESC FETCH FIRST 500 ROWS ONLY

SELECT TO_CHAR(event_timestamp,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS event_time, dbusername AS login_name,
       userhost AS host_name, os_username AS os_user, action_name AS auth_info, sql_text AS statement
FROM unified_audit_trail WHERE (action_name IN ('DROP USER','DROP ROLE'))
  AND event_timestamp > SYSTIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '1' DAY
ORDER BY event_timestamp DESC FETCH FIRST 500 ROWS ONLY

SELECT TO_CHAR(last_active_time,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS event_time, parsing_schema_name AS login_name,
       SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV','DB_NAME') AS host_name, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(30)) AS os_user,
       'plan cache' AS auth_info, SUBSTR(sql_text,1,4000) AS statement
FROM v$sql
WHERE command_type = 3   -- SELECT
  AND (UPPER(sql_text) LIKE '%FSDH_CUSTOMER_BVN%' OR UPPER(sql_text) LIKE '%STTM_CUSTOMER%' OR UPPER(sql_text) LIKE '%STTM_CUST_ACCOUNT%' OR UPPER(sql_text) LIKE '%STTM_PERSONAL%' OR UPPER(sql_text) LIKE '%STTM_CORPORATE%')
ORDER BY last_active_time DESC FETCH FIRST 500 ROWS ONLY

SELECT TO_CHAR(last_active_time,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS event_time, parsing_schema_name AS login_name,
       SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV','DB_NAME') AS host_name, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(30)) AS os_user,
       CASE command_type WHEN 6 THEN 'UPDATE' WHEN 7 THEN 'DELETE' WHEN 2 THEN 'INSERT' END AS auth_info,
       SUBSTR(sql_text,1,4000) AS statement
FROM v$sql
WHERE command_type IN (6,7,2)   -- UPDATE / DELETE / INSERT (data change)
  AND (UPPER(sql_text) LIKE '%FSDH_CUSTOMER_BVN%' OR UPPER(sql_text) LIKE '%STTM_CUSTOMER%' OR UPPER(sql_text) LIKE '%STTM_CUST_ACCOUNT%' OR UPPER(sql_text) LIKE '%STTM_PERSONAL%' OR UPPER(sql_text) LIKE '%STTM_CORPORATE%')
ORDER BY last_active_time DESC FETCH FIRST 500 ROWS ONLY

SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT TO_CHAR(SYSTIMESTAMP,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS event_time, grantee AS login_name,
         SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV','DB_NAME') AS host_name, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(30)) AS os_user,
         'ROLE '||granted_role AS auth_info,
         'Account '||grantee||' holds elevated role '||granted_role||
           CASE WHEN admin_option='YES' THEN ' (WITH ADMIN OPTION)' ELSE '' END AS statement
  FROM dba_role_privs
  WHERE granted_role IN ('DBA','PDB_DBA','IMP_FULL_DATABASE','EXP_FULL_DATABASE',
        'DATAPUMP_IMP_FULL_DATABASE','DATAPUMP_EXP_FULL_DATABASE','AUDIT_ADMIN')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT TO_CHAR(SYSTIMESTAMP,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), grantee,
         SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV','DB_NAME'), CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(30)), 'PRIV '||privilege,
         'Account '||grantee||' holds elevated privilege '||privilege||
           CASE WHEN admin_option='YES' THEN ' (WITH ADMIN OPTION)' ELSE '' END
  FROM dba_sys_privs
  WHERE privilege IN ('ALTER SYSTEM','ALTER DATABASE','BECOME USER','GRANT ANY PRIVILEGE',
        'GRANT ANY ROLE','GRANT ANY OBJECT PRIVILEGE','CREATE ANY TABLE','DROP ANY TABLE',
        'SELECT ANY TABLE','INSERT ANY TABLE','UPDATE ANY TABLE','DELETE ANY TABLE','CREATE USER',
        'ALTER USER','DROP USER','CREATE ANY PROCEDURE','ALTER ANY TABLE','AUDIT SYSTEM','ALTER PROFILE')
) t
WHERE login_name IN (SELECT username FROM dba_users WHERE oracle_maintained='N')
ORDER BY login_name, auth_info
FETCH FIRST 500 ROWS ONLY

SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT TO_CHAR(event_timestamp, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS event_time,
         dbusername AS login_name,
         SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV','DB_NAME') AS host_name,
         os_username AS os_user,
         action_name || CASE WHEN return_code <> 0 THEN ' (FAILED ORA-' || return_code || ')' ELSE '' END AS auth_info,
         NVL(object_schema || '.' || object_name, '-') || ' :: ' || NVL(SUBSTR(sql_text, 1, 200), '-') AS statement
  FROM unified_audit_trail
  WHERE event_timestamp >= SYSTIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '1' DAY
    AND (action_name LIKE 'DROP%' OR action_name LIKE 'TRUNCATE%' OR action_name LIKE 'PURGE%')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT SUBSTR(droptime, 1, 10) || ' ' || SUBSTR(droptime, 12, 8),
         owner,
         SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV','DB_NAME'),
         CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(30)),
         'DROP ' || type || ' (recyclebin)',
         'Dropped object ' || owner || '.' || original_name
  FROM dba_recyclebin
  WHERE TO_DATE(droptime, 'YYYY-MM-DD:HH24:MI:SS') >= SYSDATE - 1
) t
ORDER BY event_time DESC
FETCH FIRST 500 ROWS ONLY
