SELECT policy_name, audit_option FROM audit_unified_policies WHERE audit_option IN ('GRANT', 'REVOKE', 'ALTER USER') ORDER BY policy_name

SELECT grantee, owner, table_name, privilege, grantable FROM dba_tab_privs WHERE grantable = 'YES' AND grantee NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'DBA', 'PUBLIC') AND owner NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM') ORDER BY grantee, owner, table_name

SELECT grantee, privilege, admin_option FROM dba_sys_privs WHERE admin_option = 'YES' AND privilege IN ('CREATE USER', 'ALTER USER', 'DROP USER', 'GRANT ANY PRIVILEGE', 'GRANT ANY ROLE', 'ALTER SYSTEM', 'CREATE ANY TABLE', 'DROP ANY TABLE', 'SELECT ANY TABLE', 'CREATE ANY PROCEDURE', 'EXECUTE ANY PROCEDURE', 'ALTER DATABASE') AND grantee NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'DBA') ORDER BY grantee, privilege

SELECT role, privilege, admin_option FROM role_sys_privs WHERE admin_option = 'YES' AND role NOT IN ('DBA', 'IMP_FULL_DATABASE', 'EXP_FULL_DATABASE', 'DATAPUMP_EXP_FULL_DATABASE', 'DATAPUMP_IMP_FULL_DATABASE') ORDER BY role, privilege

SELECT role AS parent_role, granted_role AS child_role, admin_option FROM role_role_privs WHERE granted_role IN ('DBA', 'RESOURCE', 'CONNECT') OR granted_role IN (SELECT role FROM role_sys_privs WHERE privilege LIKE '%ANY%') ORDER BY role, granted_role

SELECT sp1.grantee, sp1.privilege AS privilege_1, sp2.privilege AS privilege_2 FROM dba_sys_privs sp1 JOIN dba_sys_privs sp2 ON sp1.grantee = sp2.grantee WHERE sp1.grantee NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'DBA') AND ((sp1.privilege = 'CREATE USER' AND sp2.privilege = 'AUDIT SYSTEM') OR (sp1.privilege = 'ALTER SYSTEM' AND sp2.privilege = 'SELECT ANY TABLE') OR (sp1.privilege = 'CREATE ANY PROCEDURE' AND sp2.privilege = 'GRANT ANY PRIVILEGE') OR (sp1.privilege = 'ALTER DATABASE' AND sp2.privilege = 'CREATE USER') OR (sp1.privilege = 'DROP ANY TABLE' AND sp2.privilege = 'CREATE ANY TABLE')) ORDER BY sp1.grantee

SELECT grantee, COUNT(*) AS admin_priv_count FROM dba_sys_privs WHERE admin_option = 'YES' AND grantee NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'DBA') GROUP BY grantee HAVING COUNT(*) > 3 ORDER BY admin_priv_count DESC

SELECT grantee, COUNT(*) AS any_priv_count, LISTAGG(privilege, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY privilege) AS any_privileges FROM dba_sys_privs WHERE privilege LIKE '%ANY%' AND grantee NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'DBA') GROUP BY grantee HAVING COUNT(*) > 3 ORDER BY any_priv_count DESC
SELECT role, privilege FROM role_sys_privs WHERE role IN ('CONNECT', 'RESOURCE') ORDER BY role, privilege

SELECT sp.grantee, sp.privilege FROM dba_sys_privs sp WHERE sp.privilege IN ('SELECT ANY TABLE', 'INSERT ANY TABLE', 'UPDATE ANY TABLE', 'DELETE ANY TABLE') AND sp.grantee NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'DBA') ORDER BY sp.grantee, sp.privilege

SELECT name, value, isdefault FROM v$parameter WHERE name IN ('remote_os_authent', 'remote_os_roles', 'sec_case_sensitive_logon', 'O7_DICTIONARY_ACCESSIBILITY', 'sql92_security', 'audit_trail') AND ((name = 'remote_os_authent' AND UPPER(value) = 'TRUE') OR (name = 'remote_os_roles' AND UPPER(value) = 'TRUE') OR (name = 'sec_case_sensitive_logon' AND UPPER(value) = 'FALSE') OR (name = 'O7_DICTIONARY_ACCESSIBILITY' AND UPPER(value) = 'TRUE') OR (name = 'sql92_security' AND UPPER(value) = 'FALSE') OR (name = 'audit_trail' AND UPPER(value) = 'NONE')) ORDER BY name

SELECT name, value, isdefault FROM v$parameter WHERE name IN ('sql_trace', 'timed_statistics', 'max_dump_file_size', 'remote_os_authent', 'utl_file_dir', '_trace_files_public') AND isdefault = 'FALSE' ORDER BY name
SELECT name, value, isdefault, ismodified FROM v$parameter WHERE ismodified != 'FALSE' AND name NOT LIKE '%__oracle%' ORDER BY name

SELECT grantee, owner, table_name, privilege FROM dba_tab_privs WHERE privilege = 'EXECUTE' AND grantee = 'PUBLIC' AND owner NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'XDB', 'MDSYS', 'CTXSYS', 'ORDSYS') AND table_name IN (SELECT DISTINCT name FROM dba_source WHERE owner NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM') AND type IN ('PROCEDURE', 'FUNCTION', 'PACKAGE') AND UPPER(text) LIKE '%EXECUTE IMMEDIATE%') ORDER BY owner, table_name
SELECT policy_name, enabled_option, entity_name FROM audit_unified_enabled_policies ORDER BY policy_name

SELECT name, value FROM v$parameter WHERE (name = 'remote_os_authent' AND UPPER(value) = 'TRUE') OR (name = 'utl_file_dir' AND value IS NOT NULL AND value != '') OR (name = 'O7_DICTIONARY_ACCESSIBILITY' AND UPPER(value) = 'TRUE') OR (name = 'sec_case_sensitive_logon' AND UPPER(value) = 'FALSE') ORDER BY name

SELECT u.username, u.profile, p.limit AS verify_function FROM dba_users u JOIN dba_profiles p ON p.profile = u.profile AND p.resource_name = 'PASSWORD_VERIFY_FUNCTION' WHERE u.oracle_maintained = 'N' AND u.account_status = 'OPEN' AND (p.limit = 'NULL' OR p.limit IS NULL) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dba_sys_privs sp WHERE sp.grantee = u.username AND sp.privilege LIKE '%ANY%') ORDER BY u.username
SELECT owner, db_link, username, host FROM ALL_DB_LINKS WHERE owner NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM') ORDER BY owner, db_link

SELECT owner, trigger_name, trigger_type, triggering_event, status FROM ALL_TRIGGERS WHERE base_object_type = 'DATABASE' AND status = 'ENABLED' AND owner NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM') ORDER BY owner, trigger_name
SELECT username, created, account_status, authentication_type FROM dba_users WHERE oracle_maintained = 'N' AND created > SYSDATE - 90 ORDER BY created DESC

SELECT d.directory_name, d.directory_path, p.grantee, p.privilege FROM dba_directories d LEFT JOIN dba_tab_privs p ON p.table_name = d.directory_name AND p.type = 'DIRECTORY' WHERE d.directory_name NOT IN ('ORACLE_HOME', 'ORACLE_BASE') ORDER BY d.directory_name, p.grantee

SELECT grantee, privilege, table_name FROM dba_tab_privs WHERE table_name IN (SELECT directory_name FROM dba_directories) AND privilege IN ('READ', 'WRITE', 'EXECUTE') AND grantee NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'DBA') ORDER BY grantee, table_name
SELECT directory_name, directory_path FROM dba_directories ORDER BY directory_name

SELECT grantee, privilege, table_name FROM ALL_TAB_PRIVS WHERE table_name IN ('UTL_FILE', 'UTL_HTTP', 'UTL_TCP', 'UTL_SMTP', 'DBMS_LOB', 'UTL_INADDR', 'DBMS_JAVA', 'DBMS_JAVA_TEST') AND privilege = 'EXECUTE' AND grantee NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'DBA', 'PUBLIC') ORDER BY grantee, table_name

SELECT directory_name, directory_path FROM dba_directories WHERE directory_path LIKE '/etc%' OR directory_path LIKE '/home%' OR directory_path LIKE '%/conf%' OR directory_path LIKE '%password%' OR directory_path LIKE '%config%' ORDER BY directory_name

SELECT d.directory_name, d.directory_path, COUNT(DISTINCT p.grantee) AS grantee_count, LISTAGG(p.grantee, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY p.grantee) AS grantees FROM dba_directories d LEFT JOIN dba_tab_privs p ON p.table_name = d.directory_name AND p.type = 'DIRECTORY' GROUP BY d.directory_name, d.directory_path HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.grantee) > 3 ORDER BY grantee_count DESC

SELECT directory_name, directory_path FROM dba_directories WHERE directory_path LIKE '%dev%' OR directory_path LIKE '%test%' OR directory_path LIKE '%tmp%' OR directory_path LIKE '%temp%' ORDER BY directory_name

SELECT directory_name, directory_path FROM dba_directories WHERE directory_name NOT IN ('DATA_PUMP_DIR', 'ORACLE_HOME', 'ORACLE_BASE', 'ADMIN_DIR', 'OPATCH_INST_DIR', 'OPATCH_LOG_DIR', 'OPATCH_SCRIPT_DIR', 'XMLDIR', 'XSDDIR') ORDER BY directory_name

SELECT d.directory_name, d.directory_path, COUNT(p.grantee) AS grant_count FROM dba_directories d LEFT JOIN dba_tab_privs p ON p.table_name = d.directory_name AND p.type = 'DIRECTORY' GROUP BY d.directory_name, d.directory_path ORDER BY d.directory_name
SELECT username, account_status, default_tablespace, created FROM dba_users WHERE username IN ('HR', 'OE', 'PM', 'IX', 'SH', 'BI', 'SCOTT', 'ADAMS', 'BLAKE', 'CLARK', 'JONES') ORDER BY username

SELECT username, account_status, default_tablespace, created FROM dba_users WHERE (UPPER(username) LIKE '%DEV%' OR UPPER(username) LIKE '%TEST%' OR UPPER(username) LIKE '%QA%' OR UPPER(username) LIKE '%STAGING%') ORDER BY username
SELECT owner, COUNT(*) AS object_count FROM ALL_OBJECTS WHERE owner IN ('HR', 'OE', 'PM', 'IX', 'SH', 'BI', 'SCOTT') GROUP BY owner ORDER BY owner

SELECT username, account_status, default_tablespace, created FROM dba_users WHERE UPPER(username) LIKE '%MIGRATE%' OR UPPER(username) LIKE '%IMPORT%' OR UPPER(username) LIKE '%CONVERT%' OR UPPER(username) LIKE '%LEGACY%' ORDER BY username

SELECT u.username, u.account_status, u.created, u.profile, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dba_objects o WHERE o.owner = u.username) AS object_count FROM dba_users u WHERE u.oracle_maintained = 'N' AND u.username NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM') AND u.account_status != 'OPEN' ORDER BY u.created

SELECT username, account_status, authentication_type, created FROM dba_users WHERE username IN ('HR', 'OE', 'PM', 'IX', 'SH', 'BI', 'SCOTT') OR (UPPER(username) LIKE '%TEST%' OR UPPER(username) LIKE '%DEMO%' OR UPPER(username) LIKE '%SAMPLE%') ORDER BY username

SELECT username, account_status, default_tablespace, created FROM dba_users WHERE oracle_maintained = 'N' AND (UPPER(username) LIKE '%PROD%' OR UPPER(username) LIKE '%LIVE%') AND username IN (SELECT REPLACE(REPLACE(UPPER(username), 'PROD', 'TEST'), 'LIVE', 'TEST') FROM dba_users) ORDER BY username
SELECT username, account_status, default_tablespace, created, profile FROM dba_users WHERE username IN ('HR', 'OE', 'PM', 'IX', 'SH', 'BI', 'SCOTT') AND account_status = 'OPEN' ORDER BY username

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_schemas, COUNT(CASE WHEN account_status = 'OPEN' THEN 1 END) AS open_schemas, COUNT(CASE WHEN account_status != 'OPEN' THEN 1 END) AS non_open_schemas, COUNT(CASE WHEN oracle_maintained = 'N' THEN 1 END) AS custom_schemas FROM dba_users
SELECT grantee, owner, table_name, privilege FROM dba_tab_privs WHERE owner IN ('HR', 'OE', 'PM', 'IX', 'SH', 'BI', 'SCOTT') AND grantee NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'DBA') ORDER BY owner, grantee

SELECT grantee, owner, table_name, privilege, grantable FROM dba_tab_privs WHERE grantee NOT IN ('SYS','SYSTEM','PUBLIC') AND owner NOT IN ('SYS','SYSTEM','DBSNMP','OUTLN','XDB') AND grantee != owner ORDER BY grantee, owner FETCH FIRST 30 ROWS ONLY

SELECT grantee, granted_role, default_role, admin_option FROM dba_role_privs WHERE grantee IN (SELECT username FROM dba_users WHERE oracle_maintained = 'N' AND account_status = 'OPEN') AND granted_role IN ('DBA', 'RESOURCE', 'CONNECT', 'SELECT_CATALOG_ROLE', 'EXECUTE_CATALOG_ROLE', 'DELETE_CATALOG_ROLE') ORDER BY grantee, granted_role

SELECT owner, object_name, object_type FROM ALL_OBJECTS WHERE owner NOT IN ('SYS','SYSTEM','DBSNMP','OUTLN','XDB','CTXSYS','MDSYS') AND (object_name LIKE 'DBA_%' OR object_name LIKE 'V$%' OR object_name LIKE 'GV$%' OR object_name LIKE 'ALL_%' OR object_name LIKE 'USER_%' OR object_name LIKE 'DBMS_%') ORDER BY owner, object_name FETCH FIRST 20 ROWS ONLY
SELECT name, value FROM v$parameter WHERE name = 'enable_pluggable_database'
SELECT comp_id, comp_name, version, status FROM dba_registry WHERE comp_id IN ('JAVAVM', 'XML', 'CATJAVA', 'ORDIM') ORDER BY comp_id

SELECT name, value FROM v$parameter WHERE name IN ('utl_file_dir', 'plsql_native_library_dir', 'remote_os_authent', 'remote_login_passwordfile', 'sec_case_sensitive_logon', 'remote_os_roles', 'o7_dictionary_accessibility') ORDER BY name

SELECT s.username, s.program, COUNT(DISTINCT sp.privilege) AS sys_privs, COUNT(DISTINCT rp.granted_role) AS roles FROM v$session s LEFT JOIN dba_sys_privs sp ON s.username = sp.grantee LEFT JOIN dba_role_privs rp ON s.username = rp.grantee WHERE s.type = 'USER' AND s.username IS NOT NULL AND s.username NOT IN ('SYS','SYSTEM') AND (s.program LIKE '%OEM%' OR s.program LIKE '%monitor%' OR s.program LIKE '%backup%' OR s.program LIKE '%nagios%' OR s.program LIKE '%zabbix%' OR s.program LIKE '%toad%' OR s.program LIKE '%SQL Developer%') GROUP BY s.username, s.program ORDER BY sys_privs DESC

SELECT owner, object_name, object_type, status FROM ALL_OBJECTS WHERE object_type IN ('JAVA CLASS', 'JAVA SOURCE', 'JAVA RESOURCE') AND owner NOT IN ('SYS','SYSTEM','DBSNMP','OUTLN','XDB','CTXSYS','MDSYS','ORDSYS','ORDDATA','WMSYS') ORDER BY owner, object_type, object_name FETCH FIRST 30 ROWS ONLY

SELECT owner, object_name, object_type, authid FROM ALL_PROCEDURES WHERE authid = 'DEFINER' AND owner NOT IN ('SYS','SYSTEM','DBSNMP','OUTLN','XDB','CTXSYS','MDSYS','WMSYS') AND object_type IN ('PROCEDURE','FUNCTION','PACKAGE') ORDER BY owner, object_name FETCH FIRST 20 ROWS ONLY

SELECT x.grantee, x.type_name, x.name, x.action, x.enabled
FROM XMLTABLE('/ROWSET/ROW' PASSING
  XMLTYPE(NVL(DBMS_XMLGEN.getxml(
    CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM all_objects WHERE object_name = 'DBA_JAVA_POLICY' AND object_type IN ('VIEW','SYNONYM')) > 0
         THEN q'[SELECT grantee, type_name, name, action, enabled FROM dba_java_policy WHERE type_name IN ('java.lang.RuntimePermission', 'java.io.FilePermission', 'java.net.SocketPermission') AND grantee NOT IN ('SYS','SYSTEM','JAVASYSPRIV') AND enabled = 'ENABLED' ORDER BY grantee, type_name]'
         ELSE q'[SELECT NULL AS grantee, NULL AS type_name, NULL AS name, NULL AS action, NULL AS enabled FROM dual WHERE 1=0]'
    END), '<ROWSET/>'))
  COLUMNS grantee   VARCHAR2(128)  PATH 'GRANTEE',
          type_name VARCHAR2(256)  PATH 'TYPE_NAME',
          name      VARCHAR2(4000) PATH 'NAME',
          action    VARCHAR2(256)  PATH 'ACTION',
          enabled   VARCHAR2(40)   PATH 'ENABLED') x

SELECT grantee, privilege, table_name AS object_name FROM dba_tab_privs WHERE table_name IN ('UTL_FILE', 'DBMS_SCHEDULER', 'UTL_TCP', 'UTL_HTTP', 'UTL_SMTP', 'UTL_INADDR', 'DBMS_JAVA', 'DBMS_JAVA_TEST') AND privilege = 'EXECUTE' AND grantee NOT IN ('SYS','SYSTEM','PUBLIC','DBA') AND owner = 'SYS' ORDER BY grantee, table_name
SELECT owner, db_link, username, host FROM ALL_DB_LINKS WHERE owner NOT IN ('SYS','SYSTEM') ORDER BY owner, db_link
SELECT owner, library_name, file_spec, dynamic, status FROM dba_libraries WHERE owner NOT IN ('SYS','SYSTEM','DBSNMP','OUTLN','XDB') ORDER BY owner, library_name

SELECT owner, trigger_name, trigger_type, triggering_event, table_name, status FROM dba_triggers WHERE triggering_event LIKE '%LOGON%' OR triggering_event LIKE '%STARTUP%' OR triggering_event LIKE '%SERVERERROR%' ORDER BY owner, trigger_name

SELECT name, value FROM v$parameter WHERE name IN ('plsql_debug', 'sql_trace', 'timed_statistics', 'plsql_optimize_level', 'plsql_warnings', 'tracefile_identifier') AND (value IS NOT NULL AND value != 'FALSE' AND value != '0') ORDER BY name
SELECT parameter, value FROM v$option WHERE parameter = 'Unified Auditing'

SELECT name, value, ismodified FROM v$parameter WHERE name IN ('remote_os_authent', 'o7_dictionary_accessibility', 'sec_case_sensitive_logon', 'audit_trail', 'remote_os_roles', 'sql92_security') AND (value = 'TRUE' AND name IN ('remote_os_authent', 'o7_dictionary_accessibility', 'remote_os_roles') OR value = 'FALSE' AND name IN ('sec_case_sensitive_logon', 'sql92_security')) ORDER BY name

SELECT name, value, isdefault, ismodified, description FROM v$parameter WHERE isdefault = 'FALSE' AND name IN ('sec_case_sensitive_logon', 'sec_max_failed_login_attempts', 'sec_protocol_error_trace_action', 'sec_return_server_release_banner', 'audit_sys_operations', 'unified_audit_sga_queue_size', 'remote_os_authent', 'remote_os_roles', 'o7_dictionary_accessibility') ORDER BY name

SELECT originating_timestamp, message_text FROM v$diag_alert_ext WHERE message_text LIKE '%ALTER SYSTEM SET%' AND originating_timestamp > SYSDATE - 90 ORDER BY originating_timestamp DESC FETCH FIRST 20 ROWS ONLY

SELECT name, value FROM v$parameter WHERE (name = 'audit_trail' AND value = 'NONE') OR (name = 'db_block_checking' AND value = 'FALSE') OR (name = 'db_block_checksum' AND value = 'OFF') OR (name = 'sec_case_sensitive_logon' AND value = 'FALSE') OR (name = 'sql92_security' AND value = 'FALSE') ORDER BY name

SELECT name, value FROM v$parameter WHERE (name = 'remote_os_authent' AND value = 'TRUE') OR (name = 'remote_os_roles' AND value = 'TRUE') OR (name = 'O7_DICTIONARY_ACCESSIBILITY' AND value = 'TRUE') OR (name = 'utl_file_dir' AND value != '') OR (name = '_trace_files_public' AND value = 'TRUE') ORDER BY name
SELECT name, value, description FROM v$parameter WHERE name LIKE '\_%%' ESCAPE '\' AND isdefault = 'FALSE' ORDER BY name

SELECT name, value FROM v$parameter WHERE (name LIKE '%debug%' AND value != '0' AND value != 'FALSE') OR (name LIKE '%trace%' AND value NOT IN ('0', 'FALSE', 'NONE', 'OFF') AND name NOT IN ('diagnostic_dest', 'tracefile_identifier')) OR (name = 'sql_trace' AND value = 'TRUE') OR (name = 'timed_statistics' AND value = 'TRUE') OR (name = 'statistics_level' AND value = 'ALL') ORDER BY name
SELECT name, value, ismodified, isdefault, description FROM v$parameter WHERE ismodified != 'FALSE' ORDER BY name

SELECT name, value FROM v$parameter WHERE (name = 'sec_case_sensitive_logon' AND value = 'FALSE') OR (name = 'compatible' AND value LIKE '11%') OR (name = 'cursor_sharing' AND value = 'FORCE') OR (name = 'optimizer_features_enable' AND value < '19') ORDER BY name
SELECT name, value FROM v$parameter WHERE name = 'diagnostic_dest'

SELECT name, value FROM v$parameter WHERE (name = 'cursor_sharing' AND value = 'FORCE') OR (name = 'optimizer_index_caching' AND value != '0') OR (name = 'optimizer_index_cost_adj' AND TO_NUMBER(value) < 50) OR (name = 'skip_unusable_indexes' AND value = 'TRUE') ORDER BY name

SELECT policy_name, audit_option, audit_option_type FROM audit_unified_policies WHERE audit_option LIKE '%ALTER SYSTEM%' OR audit_option = 'ALTER SYSTEM' UNION ALL SELECT 'Traditional' AS policy_name, audit_option, 'STANDARD' FROM dba_stmt_audit_opts WHERE audit_option = 'ALTER SYSTEM'

SELECT grantee, privilege, table_name FROM dba_tab_privs WHERE table_name IN ('DBMS_SYS_SQL', 'DBMS_BACKUP_RESTORE', 'DBMS_FILE_TRANSFER', 'UTL_FILE', 'UTL_TCP', 'UTL_HTTP', 'UTL_SMTP', 'DBMS_ADVISOR', 'UTL_INADDR', 'DBMS_JAVA') AND grantee NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'DBA', 'PUBLIC') ORDER BY table_name, grantee
SELECT owner, db_link, username, host, created FROM dba_db_links WHERE username IS NOT NULL ORDER BY owner, db_link
SELECT owner, db_link, username, host FROM dba_db_links WHERE username IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'DBA') OR username LIKE '%ADMIN%' ORDER BY owner, db_link
SELECT owner, db_link, username, host, created FROM dba_db_links WHERE owner = 'PUBLIC' ORDER BY db_link

SELECT dl.owner AS link_owner, dl.db_link, dl.username AS remote_user, dl.host, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dba_sys_privs WHERE grantee = dl.owner) AS owner_priv_count FROM dba_db_links dl WHERE dl.username IS NOT NULL AND dl.owner != 'PUBLIC' ORDER BY dl.owner, dl.db_link
SELECT grantee, privilege FROM dba_sys_privs WHERE privilege IN ('CREATE DATABASE LINK', 'CREATE PUBLIC DATABASE LINK') AND grantee NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'DBA') ORDER BY grantee
SELECT dl1.owner, dl1.db_link AS link1, dl1.host AS target1, dl1.username AS remote_user FROM dba_db_links dl1 WHERE dl1.username IS NOT NULL ORDER BY dl1.owner

SELECT sql_id, SUBSTR(sql_text, 1, 300) AS sql_preview FROM v$sql WHERE sql_text LIKE '%@%' AND (sql_text LIKE '%EXECUTE IMMEDIATE%' OR sql_text LIKE '%DBMS_SQL%') AND parsing_schema_name NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM') ORDER BY last_active_time DESC FETCH FIRST 20 ROWS ONLY
SELECT owner, db_link, username, host, created FROM dba_db_links ORDER BY owner, db_link

SELECT sql_id, SUBSTR(sql_text, 1, 200) AS sql_preview FROM v$sql WHERE sql_text LIKE '%CREATE%DATABASE%LINK%IDENTIFIED%BY%' OR sql_text LIKE '%ALTER%DATABASE%LINK%IDENTIFIED%BY%' ORDER BY last_active_time DESC FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY
SELECT owner, db_link, username, host, created, ROUND(SYSDATE - created) AS age_days FROM dba_db_links WHERE username IS NOT NULL ORDER BY age_days DESC
SELECT owner, db_link, username, host FROM dba_db_links WHERE username IS NOT NULL AND owner = 'PUBLIC' ORDER BY db_link
SELECT owner, db_link, username, host FROM dba_db_links ORDER BY owner, db_link
SELECT owner, db_link, username, host, created FROM dba_db_links WHERE username IS NOT NULL ORDER BY owner, db_link
SELECT db_link, owner, host FROM dba_db_links WHERE host NOT LIKE '%TCPS%' AND host NOT LIKE '%(SECURITY%' ORDER BY owner, db_link
SELECT name, value FROM v$parameter WHERE name LIKE '%authentication%' OR name LIKE '%wallet%' ORDER BY name
SELECT owner, db_link, username, host FROM dba_db_links WHERE username IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'SYSDBA') OR username IS NULL ORDER BY owner, db_link
SELECT network_service_banner FROM v$session_connect_info WHERE sid = SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV', 'SID') AND network_service_banner LIKE '%Encryption%'

SELECT s.sid, s.serial#, s.username, s.program, s.machine, sci.network_service_banner FROM v$session s LEFT JOIN v$session_connect_info sci ON s.sid = sci.sid AND sci.network_service_banner LIKE '%Encryption%' WHERE s.type = 'USER' AND s.status = 'ACTIVE' AND sci.sid IS NULL ORDER BY s.username
SELECT name, value FROM v$parameter WHERE name LIKE '%encryption%server%' OR name LIKE '%crypto%server%' ORDER BY name
SELECT s.sid, s.username, s.program, s.machine, sci.client_driver FROM v$session s LEFT JOIN v$session_connect_info sci ON s.sid = sci.sid WHERE s.type = 'USER' ORDER BY sci.client_driver
SELECT name, value FROM v$parameter WHERE (name LIKE '%encryption%' AND value = 'REJECTED') OR (name LIKE '%crypto%' AND value = 'REJECTED') ORDER BY name

SELECT name, value, isdefault FROM v$parameter WHERE name IN ('sqlnet.encryption_server', 'sqlnet.encryption_client', 'sqlnet.encryption_types_server', 'wallet_root', 'tde_configuration') ORDER BY name
SELECT wrl_type, wrl_parameter, status, wallet_type, wallet_order FROM v$encryption_wallet
SELECT name, value FROM v$parameter WHERE name IN ('local_listener', 'remote_listener') ORDER BY name
SELECT COUNT(*) AS encryption_params FROM v$parameter WHERE (name LIKE '%encryption%' OR name LIKE '%crypto%' OR name LIKE '%ssl%' OR name LIKE '%wallet%') AND value IS NOT NULL AND value != 'FALSE'

SELECT name, value FROM v$parameter WHERE name IN ('audit_trail', 'audit_sys_operations', 'sec_case_sensitive_logon', 'sec_max_failed_login_attempts', 'sec_protocol_error_further_action') AND (value IS NULL OR value = 'FALSE' OR value = 'NONE') ORDER BY name

SELECT s.program, s.machine, COUNT(*) AS session_count, MIN(sci.network_service_banner) AS encryption_info FROM v$session s LEFT JOIN v$session_connect_info sci ON s.sid = sci.sid AND sci.network_service_banner LIKE '%Encryption%' WHERE s.type = 'USER' GROUP BY s.program, s.machine ORDER BY session_count DESC FETCH FIRST 20 ROWS ONLY

SELECT name, value FROM v$parameter WHERE (name = 'remote_os_authent' AND value = 'TRUE') OR (name = 'o7_dictionary_accessibility' AND value = 'TRUE') OR (name = 'sec_case_sensitive_logon' AND value = 'FALSE') OR (name = 'audit_trail' AND value = 'NONE') ORDER BY name
SELECT policy_name, audit_condition FROM audit_unified_policies WHERE policy_name LIKE '%ENCRYPT%' OR audit_condition LIKE '%encryption%' ORDER BY policy_name

SELECT 'network_encryption' AS check_type, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM v$parameter WHERE name LIKE '%encryption%server%' AND value = 'REQUIRED') THEN 'CONFIGURED' ELSE 'NOT_CONFIGURED' END AS status FROM dual UNION ALL SELECT 'tde_encryption' AS check_type, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM v$encryption_wallet WHERE status = 'OPEN') THEN 'CONFIGURED' ELSE 'NOT_CONFIGURED' END AS status FROM dual UNION ALL SELECT 'audit_configured' AS check_type, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM audit_unified_enabled_policies) THEN 'CONFIGURED' ELSE 'NOT_CONFIGURED' END AS status FROM dual
SELECT 'Check sqlnet.ora for SSL_VERSION parameter' AS action, 'File: $ORACLE_HOME/network/admin/sqlnet.ora' AS location, 'SSL_VERSION should be 1.2 or higher' AS requirement FROM DUAL
SELECT s.SID, s.PROGRAM, s.MODULE, s.CLIENT_INFO, s.MACHINE FROM V$SESSION s WHERE s.TYPE = 'USER' AND s.USERNAME IS NOT NULL ORDER BY s.PROGRAM

SELECT s.SID, s.PROGRAM, s.MODULE, s.CLIENT_INFO, s.MACHINE FROM V$SESSION s WHERE s.TYPE = 'USER' AND (s.PROGRAM LIKE '%JDBC%' OR s.PROGRAM LIKE '%java%' OR s.MODULE LIKE '%JDBC%') ORDER BY s.PROGRAM

SELECT NAME, VALUE FROM V$PARAMETER WHERE NAME IN ('sqlnet.encryption_server', 'sqlnet.encryption_client', 'sqlnet.crypto_checksum_server', 'sqlnet.crypto_checksum_client', 'sqlnet.encryption_types_server', 'sqlnet.crypto_checksum_types_server')
SELECT s.SID, s.PROGRAM, s.MACHINE, ns.NETWORK_SERVICE_BANNER FROM V$SESSION s JOIN V$SESSION_CONNECT_INFO ns ON s.SID = ns.SID WHERE s.TYPE = 'USER' AND s.USERNAME IS NOT NULL ORDER BY s.SID
SELECT COUNT(*) AS ssl_sessions FROM V$SESSION_CONNECT_INFO WHERE NETWORK_SERVICE_BANNER LIKE '%SSL%' OR NETWORK_SERVICE_BANNER LIKE '%TLS%'

SELECT s.SID, s.PROGRAM, ci.NETWORK_SERVICE_BANNER FROM V$SESSION s JOIN V$SESSION_CONNECT_INFO ci ON s.SID = ci.SID WHERE ci.NETWORK_SERVICE_BANNER LIKE '%SSL%' OR ci.NETWORK_SERVICE_BANNER LIKE '%Crypto%' ORDER BY s.SID

SELECT owner, name, type, line, text FROM ALL_SOURCE WHERE UPPER(text) LIKE '%EXECUTE IMMEDIATE%SELECT%' AND UPPER(text) NOT LIKE '%||%' AND owner NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'XDB', 'MDSYS', 'CTXSYS') AND type IN ('PROCEDURE', 'FUNCTION', 'PACKAGE BODY') ORDER BY owner, name, line FETCH FIRST 20 ROWS ONLY

SELECT owner, object_name, object_type FROM ALL_OBJECTS WHERE object_type IN ('PACKAGE BODY', 'PROCEDURE', 'FUNCTION') AND owner NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'XDB', 'MDSYS', 'CTXSYS', 'WMSYS', 'ORDSYS') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ALL_SOURCE WHERE owner = ALL_OBJECTS.owner AND name = ALL_OBJECTS.object_name AND type = ALL_OBJECTS.object_type AND ROWNUM = 1 AND text NOT LIKE '%wrapped%') ORDER BY owner, object_name FETCH FIRST 20 ROWS ONLY

SELECT owner, name, type, line, text FROM ALL_SOURCE WHERE UPPER(text) LIKE '%EXECUTE IMMEDIATE%||%USING%' AND owner NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'XDB', 'MDSYS', 'CTXSYS') AND type IN ('PROCEDURE', 'FUNCTION', 'PACKAGE BODY') ORDER BY owner, name, line FETCH FIRST 20 ROWS ONLY

SELECT o.owner, o.object_name, o.object_type, o.created, o.last_ddl_time, ROUND(SYSDATE - o.created) AS age_days FROM ALL_OBJECTS o WHERE o.object_type IN ('JAVA CLASS', 'JAVA SOURCE') AND o.owner NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'XDB', 'ORDSYS', 'MDSYS') AND o.created < SYSDATE - 1095 ORDER BY o.created ASC FETCH FIRST 15 ROWS ONLY

SELECT profile, resource_name, limit FROM dba_profiles WHERE resource_name IN ('FAILED_LOGIN_ATTEMPTS', 'PASSWORD_LOCK_TIME') AND (limit = 'UNLIMITED' OR limit = 'DEFAULT') ORDER BY profile, resource_name
SELECT instance_name, startup_time, ROUND(SYSDATE - startup_time) AS uptime_days, version FROM v$instance
SELECT name, value FROM v$parameter WHERE name = 'local_listener' AND (value LIKE '%1521%' OR value LIKE '%1526%' OR value IS NULL) ORDER BY name
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT machine) AS distinct_hosts, COUNT(DISTINCT program) AS distinct_programs, COUNT(*) AS total_sessions FROM v$session WHERE type = 'USER'
SELECT owner, db_link, host FROM ALL_DB_LINKS WHERE host IS NOT NULL ORDER BY owner, db_link
SELECT host, lower_port, upper_port, acl FROM dba_network_acls WHERE host NOT LIKE '10.%' AND host NOT LIKE '172.%' AND host NOT LIKE '192.168.%' AND host != 'localhost' ORDER BY host
SELECT owner, db_link, username, host, created FROM ALL_DB_LINKS ORDER BY owner, db_link
SELECT na.host, na.lower_port, na.upper_port, na.acl, nap.principal, nap.privilege, nap.is_grant FROM dba_network_acls na JOIN dba_network_acl_privileges nap ON na.acl = nap.acl ORDER BY na.host
SELECT acl, principal, privilege, is_grant FROM dba_network_acl_privileges WHERE privilege = 'resolve' ORDER BY principal
SELECT owner, db_link, host FROM ALL_DB_LINKS WHERE host NOT LIKE '%localhost%' AND host NOT LIKE '%127.0.0.1%' AND host NOT LIKE '%(LOCAL)%' ORDER BY owner, db_link
SELECT dest_id, dest_name, status, target, destination FROM v$archive_dest WHERE status != 'INACTIVE' AND target = 'STANDBY' ORDER BY dest_id
SELECT host, lower_port, upper_port, acl FROM dba_network_acls WHERE lower_port IN (443, 8443, 9090, 9100, 5044, 8086) OR host = '*' ORDER BY host

SELECT host, lower_port, upper_port, acl, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT principal) FROM dba_network_acl_privileges nap WHERE nap.acl = na.acl AND nap.is_grant = 'true') AS grant_count FROM dba_network_acls na WHERE host = '*' OR lower_port IS NULL ORDER BY host
SELECT patch_id, action, status, action_time, description FROM dba_registry_sqlpatch WHERE action = 'APPLY' AND status = 'SUCCESS' ORDER BY action_time DESC FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY
SELECT dbid, name, created, log_mode, open_mode FROM v$database
SELECT version FROM v$instance

SELECT name, detected_usages, currently_used, first_usage_date, last_usage_date FROM dba_feature_usage_statistics WHERE currently_used = 'TRUE' AND detected_usages > 0 AND (name LIKE '%Deprecated%' OR name LIKE '%obsolete%' OR name IN ('Oracle Streams', 'Advanced Replication', 'Rule Manager', 'Expression Filter')) ORDER BY last_usage_date DESC

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dba_registry WHERE status != 'VALID') AS invalid_components, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dba_objects WHERE status = 'INVALID' AND owner NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM')) AS invalid_objects, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT owner) FROM dba_objects WHERE owner NOT IN (SELECT username FROM dba_users WHERE oracle_maintained = 'Y')) AS custom_schemas, (SELECT value FROM v$parameter WHERE name = 'compatible') AS compatible_param, (SELECT version FROM v$instance) AS current_version FROM dual
SELECT patch_id, action, status, action_time, description FROM dba_registry_sqlpatch ORDER BY action_time DESC FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY
SELECT patch_id, action, status, action_time, description FROM dba_registry_sqlpatch WHERE action = 'APPLY' AND status = 'SUCCESS' ORDER BY action_time DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY

SELECT DISTINCT s.program, s.machine, COUNT(*) AS connections FROM v$session s WHERE s.type = 'USER' AND s.username IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.program, s.machine ORDER BY connections DESC FETCH FIRST 20 ROWS ONLY
SELECT name, value FROM v$parameter WHERE name IN ('cluster_database', 'enable_pluggable_database', 'db_domain', 'compatible', 'nls_characterset') AND value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY name

SELECT name, detected_usages, currently_used, first_usage_date, last_usage_date, description FROM dba_feature_usage_statistics WHERE currently_used = 'TRUE' AND name IN ('Advanced Replication','Streams','Workspace Manager','XML DB Repository','Oracle Multimedia','Client Identifier','Fine-grained Auditing','Oracle Spatial') ORDER BY detected_usages DESC

SELECT TO_CHAR(MAX(action_time), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS last_patch_date, ROUND(SYSDATE - CAST(MAX(action_time) AS DATE)) AS days_since_patch FROM dba_registry_sqlpatch WHERE action = 'APPLY' AND status = 'SUCCESS'
SELECT patch_id, action, status, action_time, description FROM dba_registry_sqlpatch WHERE status != 'SUCCESS' ORDER BY action_time DESC
SELECT banner FROM v$version WHERE banner LIKE 'Oracle%'
SELECT name, db_unique_name, platform_name, created, dbid, cdb FROM v$database

SELECT TO_CHAR(MAX(action_time), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS last_cpu_date, ROUND(SYSDATE - CAST(MAX(action_time) AS DATE)) AS days_since_last_cpu FROM dba_registry_sqlpatch WHERE action = 'APPLY' AND status = 'SUCCESS' AND (description LIKE '%Database%Update%' OR description LIKE '%CPU%' OR description LIKE '%PSU%' OR description LIKE '%RU%')

SELECT name, value FROM v$parameter WHERE name IN ('cluster_database', 'enable_pluggable_database', 'compatible', 'nls_characterset', 'optimizer_features_enable', 'cursor_sharing', 'parallel_max_servers', 'db_block_size') AND value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY name
SELECT name, value FROM v$parameter WHERE name IN ('optimizer_features_enable', 'optimizer_adaptive_plans', 'optimizer_adaptive_statistics', '_fix_control') ORDER BY name
SELECT action_time, patch_id, description FROM dba_registry_sqlpatch WHERE action = 'APPLY' AND status = 'SUCCESS' ORDER BY action_time DESC FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v$pdbs WHERE con_id > 2) AS pdb_count, (SELECT value FROM v$parameter WHERE name = 'cluster_database') AS is_rac, (SELECT value FROM v$parameter WHERE name = 'enable_pluggable_database') AS is_cdb FROM dual
SELECT patch_id, action, status, action_time, description FROM dba_registry_sqlpatch WHERE status IN ('WITH ERRORS', 'ROLLBACK', 'ROLLBACK SUCCESS') ORDER BY action_time DESC
SELECT name, platform_id, platform_name FROM v$database
SELECT patch_id, action, status, action_time, description FROM dba_registry_sqlpatch ORDER BY action_time DESC FETCH FIRST 15 ROWS ONLY
SELECT TO_CHAR(sample_time, 'HH24') AS hour, COUNT(*) AS active_sessions FROM v$active_session_history WHERE sample_time > SYSDATE - 7 GROUP BY TO_CHAR(sample_time, 'HH24') ORDER BY hour
SELECT flashback_on, log_mode, force_logging FROM v$database
SELECT patch_id, action_time, description FROM dba_registry_sqlpatch WHERE action = 'APPLY' AND status = 'SUCCESS' ORDER BY action_time DESC FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY
SELECT patch_id, patch_uid, target_version AS version, status, action, action_time, description FROM dba_registry_sqlpatch ORDER BY action_time DESC FETCH FIRST 20 ROWS ONLY
SELECT TO_CHAR(MAX(action_time), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS last_patch_date, ROUND(SYSDATE - CAST(MAX(action_time) AS DATE)) AS days_since_patch FROM dba_registry_sqlpatch WHERE status = 'SUCCESS'
SELECT patch_id, target_version AS version, status, action, action_time FROM dba_registry_sqlpatch WHERE action = 'APPLY' ORDER BY action_time DESC FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY
SELECT owner, table_name, column_name, encryption_alg, salt FROM ALL_ENCRYPTED_COLUMNS ORDER BY owner, table_name

SELECT ic.table_owner, ic.table_name, ic.column_name, ic.index_name, tc.data_type FROM ALL_IND_COLUMNS ic JOIN ALL_TAB_COLUMNS tc ON ic.table_owner = tc.owner AND ic.table_name = tc.table_name AND ic.column_name = tc.column_name WHERE (tc.column_name LIKE '%SSN%' OR (tc.column_name LIKE '%bvn%' OR tc.column_name LIKE '%CARD%' OR tc.column_name LIKE '%ACCOUNT%' OR tc.column_name LIKE '%EMAIL%' OR tc.column_name LIKE '%PHONE%' OR tc.column_name LIKE '%PASSWORD%') AND ic.table_owner NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM') ORDER BY ic.table_owner, ic.table_name

SELECT ts.tablespace_name, ts.encrypted, ts.contents FROM dba_tablespaces ts WHERE ts.contents = 'PERMANENT' AND ts.encrypted = 'NO' AND ts.tablespace_name NOT IN ('SYSTEM', 'SYSAUX', 'UNDO') ORDER BY ts.tablespace_name

SELECT tc.owner, tc.table_name, tc.column_name, tc.data_type, tc.data_length FROM ALL_TAB_COLUMNS tc WHERE (tc.column_name LIKE '%SSN%' OR (tc.column_name LIKE '%bvn%' OR tc.column_name LIKE '%CARD%' OR tc.column_name LIKE '%SECRET%') AND tc.data_type IN ('LONG', 'LONG RAW', 'BFILE', 'ROWID', 'UROWID') AND tc.owner NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM') ORDER BY tc.owner, tc.table_name
SELECT owner, table_name, column_name, data_type FROM ALL_TAB_COLUMNS WHERE data_type IN ('LONG', 'LONG RAW') AND owner NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'MDSYS', 'XDB', 'WMSYS') ORDER BY owner, table_name

SELECT owner, object_name, object_type FROM ALL_OBJECTS WHERE object_type IN ('FUNCTION', 'PACKAGE') AND (object_name LIKE '%MASK%' OR object_name LIKE '%ENCRYPT%' OR object_name LIKE '%OBFUSC%' OR object_name LIKE '%REDACT%') AND owner NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'MDSYS', 'XDB') ORDER BY owner, object_name
SELECT job_name, operation, job_mode, state, attached_sessions FROM dba_datapump_jobs WHERE state = 'EXECUTING' OR state = 'NOT RUNNING' ORDER BY state, job_name
SELECT DISTINCT program, module, COUNT(*) AS sessions FROM v$session WHERE type = 'USER' AND username IS NOT NULL GROUP BY program, module ORDER BY sessions DESC FETCH FIRST 20 ROWS ONLY
SELECT wrl_type, wrl_parameter, status, wallet_type, wallet_order, fully_backed_up FROM v$encryption_wallet
SELECT BANNER_LEGACY, banner_full FROM v$version WHERE banner_full LIKE '%Oracle%'
SELECT conf#, name, value FROM v$rman_configuration WHERE name LIKE '%ENCRYPTION%' ORDER BY name

SELECT owner AS schema_name, table_name, column_name, data_type, data_length, CASE WHEN LOWER(column_name) LIKE '%ssn%' OR LOWER(column_name) LIKE '%bvn%' OR LOWER(column_name) LIKE '%social_security%' THEN 'ssn|bvn' WHEN LOWER(column_name) LIKE '%credit_card%' OR LOWER(column_name) LIKE '%card_number%' OR LOWER(column_name) LIKE '%cvv%' THEN 'Credit Card' WHEN LOWER(column_name) LIKE '%password%' OR LOWER(column_name) LIKE '%passwd%' OR LOWER(column_name) LIKE '%secret%' OR LOWER(column_name) LIKE '%api_key%' THEN 'Credential' WHEN LOWER(column_name) LIKE '%email%' THEN 'Email' WHEN LOWER(column_name) LIKE '%phone%' OR LOWER(column_name) LIKE '%mobile%' THEN 'Phone' WHEN LOWER(column_name) LIKE '%birth%' OR LOWER(column_name) LIKE '%dob%' THEN 'Date of Birth' WHEN LOWER(column_name) LIKE '%salary%' OR LOWER(column_name) LIKE '%income%' THEN 'Financial' WHEN LOWER(column_name) LIKE '%bank_account%' OR LOWER(column_name) LIKE '%iban%' THEN 'Bank Account' WHEN LOWER(column_name) LIKE '%national_id%' OR LOWER(column_name) LIKE '%passport%' OR LOWER(column_name) LIKE '%tax_id%' THEN 'Government ID' WHEN LOWER(column_name) LIKE '%medical%' OR LOWER(column_name) LIKE '%diagnosis%' THEN 'Medical' ELSE 'Other Sensitive' END AS pii_category FROM all_tab_columns WHERE owner NOT IN ('SYS','SYSTEM','DBSNMP','OUTLN','MDSYS','ORDSYS','CTXSYS','XDB','WMSYS') AND (LOWER(column_name) LIKE '%ssn%' OR (LOWER(column_name) LIKE '%bvn%' OR LOWER(column_name) LIKE '%social_security%' OR LOWER(column_name) LIKE '%credit_card%' OR LOWER(column_name) LIKE '%card_number%' OR LOWER(column_name) LIKE '%cvv%' OR LOWER(column_name) LIKE '%password%' OR LOWER(column_name) LIKE '%passwd%' OR LOWER(column_name) LIKE '%secret%' OR LOWER(column_name) LIKE '%api_key%' OR LOWER(column_name) LIKE '%email%' OR LOWER(column_name) LIKE '%phone%' OR LOWER(column_name) LIKE '%mobile%' OR LOWER(column_name) LIKE '%birth%' OR LOWER(column_name) LIKE '%dob%' OR LOWER(column_name) LIKE '%salary%' OR LOWER(column_name) LIKE '%income%' OR LOWER(column_name) LIKE '%bank_account%' OR LOWER(column_name) LIKE '%iban%' OR LOWER(column_name) LIKE '%national_id%' OR LOWER(column_name) LIKE '%passport%' OR LOWER(column_name) LIKE '%tax_id%' OR LOWER(column_name) LIKE '%medical%' OR LOWER(column_name) LIKE '%diagnosis%' OR LOWER(column_name) LIKE '%ip_address%' OR LOWER(column_name) LIKE '%biometric%') ORDER BY pii_category, owner, table_name

SELECT c.owner AS schema_name, c.table_name, c.column_name, s.num_rows, s.last_analyzed, CASE WHEN LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%ssn%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%bvn%' THEN 'ssn|bvn' WHEN LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%credit_card%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%card_number%' THEN 'Credit Card' WHEN LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%password%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%secret%' THEN 'Credential' WHEN LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%email%' THEN 'Email' WHEN LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%phone%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%mobile%' THEN 'Phone' WHEN LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%salary%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%income%' THEN 'Financial' WHEN LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%national_id%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%passport%' THEN 'Government ID' WHEN LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%medical%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%diagnosis%' THEN 'Medical' ELSE 'Other Sensitive' END AS pii_category FROM all_tab_columns c JOIN all_tables s ON s.owner = c.owner AND s.table_name = c.table_name WHERE c.owner NOT IN ('SYS','SYSTEM','DBSNMP','OUTLN','MDSYS','ORDSYS','CTXSYS','XDB') AND s.num_rows > 0 AND (LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%ssn%' OR (LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%bvn%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%credit_card%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%password%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%email%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%phone%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%salary%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%bank_account%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%national_id%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%passport%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%tax_id%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%medical%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%diagnosis%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%birth%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%secret%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%api_key%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%iban%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%income%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%biometric%') ORDER BY s.num_rows DESC

SELECT s.sid AS session_id, s.username AS login_name, s.machine AS host_name, s.program AS program_name, s.module, c.owner AS schema_name, c.table_name, c.column_name, CASE WHEN LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%password%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%pass%' THEN 'Password' WHEN LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%secret%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%token%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%key%' THEN 'Credential' WHEN LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%credit%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%card%' THEN 'Credit Card' WHEN LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%ssn%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%bvn%' THEN 'ssn|bvn' WHEN LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%email%' THEN 'Email' WHEN LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%phone%' THEN 'Phone' WHEN LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%address%' THEN 'Address' WHEN LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%dob%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%birth%' THEN 'Date of Birth' WHEN LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%salary%' THEN 'Salary' ELSE 'Other Sensitive' END AS pii_category, SUBSTR(sq.sql_text, 1, 4000) AS query_text, s.status FROM v$session s JOIN v$sql sq ON sq.sql_id = s.sql_id JOIN all_tab_columns c ON UPPER(sq.sql_text) LIKE '%' || UPPER(c.table_name) || '%' WHERE s.type = 'USER' AND s.status = 'ACTIVE' AND s.sid <> SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV', 'SID') AND c.owner NOT IN ('SYS','SYSTEM','DBSNMP','OUTLN','MDSYS','ORDSYS','CTXSYS','XDB','WMSYS') AND (LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%password%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%pass%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%secret%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%token%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%key%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%credit%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%card%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%ssn%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%bvn%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%email%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%phone%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%address%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%dob%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%birth%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%salary%') ORDER BY s.sid, c.table_name, c.column_name

LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%birth%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%salary%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%passport%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%medical%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%diagnosis%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%teudat%')) SELECT 'cached_plan' AS source, CAST(NULL AS NUMBER) AS session_id, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(50)) AS transaction_id, sql.executions AS execution_count, sql.last_active_time AS last_execution_time, sql.buffer_gets / NULLIF(sql.executions, 0) AS avg_reads, sql.cpu_time / NULLIF(sql.executions, 0) / 1000 AS avg_cpu_ms, CAST(NULL AS '.' || t.xidslot || '.' || t.xidsqn AS transaction_id, CAST(NULL AS NUMBER), CAST(NULL AS DATE), CAST(NULL AS NUMBER), CAST(NULL AS NUMBER), t.start_date AS transaction_begin_time, sc.schema_name, sc.table_name, sc.column_name, sc.pii_category, SUBSTR(sql.sql_text, 1, 4000) AS query_text, s.username AS login_name FROM v$transaction t JOIN v$session s ON s.taddr = t.addr JOIN v$sql sql ON sql.sql_id = COALESCE(s.sql_id, s.prev_sql_id) JOIN sensitive_cols sc ON UPPER(sql.sql_text) LIKE '%' || UPPER(sc.table_name) || '%' WHERE s.type = 'USER' AND sql.sql_text IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1, 5 SELECT
    SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV','DB_NAME') AS db_name,
    owner                            AS schema_name,
    table_name                       AS table_name,
    column_name                      AS column_name,
    data_type                        AS data_type,
    data_length                      AS max_length,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(50))       AS pii_category
FROM all_tab_columns
WHERE owner NOT IN ('SYS','SYSTEM','XDB','MDSYS','CTXSYS','DBSNMP','OUTLN',
    'APPQOSSYS','ORDSYS','WMSYS','GSMADMIN_INTERNAL','AUDSYS','DVSYS','LBACSYS',
    'OJVMSYS','ORDDATA','OLAPSYS')
ORDER BY owner, table_name, column_id
SELECT policy_name, audit_option, audit_option_type, audit_condition FROM audit_unified_policies WHERE audit_option IN ('ALL', 'ALL STATEMENTS') OR audit_condition IS NULL ORDER BY policy_name

SELECT sql_id, SUBSTR(sql_text, 1, 300) AS sql_preview FROM v$sql WHERE (sql_text LIKE '%password%=%' OR sql_text LIKE '%passwd%=%' OR sql_text LIKE '%secret%=%' OR sql_text LIKE '%ssn%=%' OR sql_text LIKE '%credit_card%=%') AND parsing_schema_name NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM') ORDER BY last_active_time DESC FETCH FIRST 20 ROWS ONLY
SELECT name, value FROM v$parameter WHERE name IN ('max_dump_file_size', '_trace_files_public', 'sec_return_server_release_banner', 'diagnostic_dest') ORDER BY name
SELECT COUNT(*) AS audit_record_count, MIN(event_timestamp) AS oldest_record, MAX(event_timestamp) AS newest_record FROM unified_audit_trail
SELECT name, value FROM v$parameter WHERE name IN ('plsql_debug', 'plsql_warnings') AND value NOT IN ('DISABLE:ALL', 'FALSE') ORDER BY name
SELECT name, value FROM v$parameter WHERE name IN ('max_dump_file_size', 'diagnostic_dest', 'core_dump_dest', '_trace_files_public', 'background_dump_dest', 'user_dump_dest') ORDER BY name
SELECT name, value FROM v$parameter WHERE name IN ('sql_trace', 'tracefile_identifier', 'max_dump_file_size', '_trace_files_public') ORDER BY name
SELECT sid, serial#, username, program, event, action FROM v$session WHERE event LIKE '%debug%' OR event LIKE '%trace%' OR action LIKE '%debug%' ORDER BY username

SELECT s.sid, s.serial#, s.username, s.program, s.sql_trace, s.logon_time, ROUND(SYSDATE - s.logon_time) AS days_active FROM v$session s WHERE s.sql_trace = 'ENABLED' AND SYSDATE - s.logon_time > 1 ORDER BY s.logon_time
SELECT name, value FROM v$parameter WHERE name LIKE '%diagnostic%' OR name LIKE '%dump%' OR name LIKE '%trace%' ORDER BY name

SELECT SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV','DB_NAME') AS database_name, 'missing PPL_SECURITY_LEVEL parameter' AS finding FROM dual WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM database_properties WHERE property_name = 'PPL_SECURITY_LEVEL')
SELECT owner, table_name, num_rows FROM all_tables WHERE num_rows >= 100000 AND owner NOT IN ('SYS','SYSTEM','DBSNMP','OUTLN','MDSYS','ORDSYS','CTXSYS','XDB','WMSYS') ORDER BY num_rows DESC
SELECT name, value FROM v$parameter WHERE name IN ('remote_login_passwordfile','remote_os_authent') AND value NOT IN ('NONE','FALSE')
SELECT tablespace_name, encrypted FROM dba_tablespaces WHERE encrypted = 'NO' AND contents = 'PERMANENT' AND tablespace_name NOT IN ('SYSTEM','SYSAUX')

SELECT c.owner, c.table_name, c.column_name, c.data_type FROM all_tab_columns c LEFT JOIN dba_encrypted_columns ec ON ec.owner = c.owner AND ec.table_name = c.table_name AND ec.column_name = c.column_name WHERE ec.column_name IS NULL AND c.owner NOT IN ('SYS','SYSTEM','DBSNMP','OUTLN') AND (LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%password%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%ssn%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%bvn%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%credit_card%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%email%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%phone%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%medical%')
SELECT name, value FROM v$parameter WHERE name = 'sqlnet.allowed_logon_version_server' AND value < '12'
SELECT name, value FROM v$parameter WHERE name = 'audit_trail' AND LOWER(value) IN ('none','')

SELECT DISTINCT c.owner, c.table_name
FROM all_tab_columns c
WHERE c.owner NOT IN ('SYS','SYSTEM','DBSNMP')
  AND (LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%password%'
       OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%ssn%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%bvn%'
       OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%credit_card%'
       OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%email%')
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM dba_obj_audit_opts a
      WHERE a.object_name = c.table_name
        AND a.owner = c.owner
        AND a.alt = 'A/A'
  )
SELECT job_name, last_start_date FROM dba_scheduler_jobs WHERE job_name LIKE '%AUDIT%PURGE%' AND repeat_interval LIKE '%FREQ=DAILY%'

SELECT p.owner, p.table_name, p.privilege FROM dba_tab_privs p JOIN all_tab_columns c ON c.owner = p.owner AND c.table_name = p.table_name WHERE p.grantee = 'PUBLIC' AND p.privilege = 'SELECT' AND (LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%password%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%ssn%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%bvn%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%credit_card%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%email%')

SELECT grantee, granted_role FROM dba_role_privs WHERE granted_role IN ('DBA','SYSDBA') AND (LOWER(grantee) LIKE '%app%' OR LOWER(grantee) LIKE '%svc%' OR LOWER(grantee) LIKE '%service%' OR LOWER(grantee) LIKE '%api%')
SELECT username, last_login FROM dba_users WHERE account_status = 'OPEN' AND (last_login IS NULL OR last_login < SYSDATE - 90) AND username NOT IN ('SYS','SYSTEM','DBSNMP','XS$NULL')
SELECT username, profile FROM dba_users WHERE profile = 'DEFAULT' AND account_status = 'OPEN' AND username NOT IN ('SYS','SYSTEM','DBSNMP')
SELECT username FROM dba_users WHERE account_status = 'OPEN' AND LOWER(username) IN ('admin','app','svc','dba','root','test','dbuser')
SELECT username, account_status FROM dba_users WHERE username IN ('SYS','SYSTEM') AND account_status = 'OPEN'

SELECT name AS database_name, MAX(end_time) AS last_backup FROM v$database, v$rman_backup_job_details WHERE input_type IN ('DB FULL','DB INCR') GROUP BY name HAVING MAX(end_time) < SYSDATE - 7 OR MAX(end_time) IS NULL
SELECT bs_key, completion_time, encrypted FROM v$backup_set_details WHERE completion_time > SYSDATE - 30 AND encrypted = 'NO'
SELECT name AS data_file, 'check db_recovery_file_dest = data dir' AS finding FROM v$datafile WHERE ROWNUM = 1

SELECT c.owner, c.table_name, c.column_name FROM all_tab_columns c WHERE c.data_type IN ('DATE','TIMESTAMP') AND (LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%created%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%insert%') AND c.owner NOT IN ('SYS','SYSTEM') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM all_tab_columns c2 WHERE c2.owner = c.owner AND c2.table_name = c.table_name AND (LOWER(c2.column_name) LIKE '%email%' OR LOWER(c2.column_name) LIKE '%phone%'))
SELECT owner, table_name, column_name FROM all_tab_columns WHERE (LOWER(column_name) LIKE '%last_login%' OR LOWER(column_name) LIKE '%last_active%') AND owner NOT IN ('SYS','SYSTEM')

SELECT owner, table_name, column_name FROM all_tab_columns WHERE (LOWER(column_name) IN ('is_deleted','isdeleted','deleted') OR LOWER(column_name) LIKE '%deleted_at%') AND owner NOT IN ('SYS','SYSTEM')

SELECT username, os_username, COUNT(*) AS failed_count, MAX(timestamp) AS last_failure FROM dba_audit_session WHERE returncode <> 0 AND timestamp > SYSDATE - 1/24 GROUP BY username, os_username HAVING COUNT(*) > 20
SELECT grantee, granted_role, default_role, admin_option FROM dba_role_privs WHERE granted_role IN ('DBA','SYSDBA') AND grantee NOT IN ('SYS','SYSTEM','DBA_USERS')
SELECT s.sid, s.username, s.machine, s.program FROM v$session s WHERE s.type = 'USER' AND s.status = 'ACTIVE' AND (TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24')) < 6 OR TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24')) >= 22)

SELECT c.owner, c.table_name, c.column_name FROM all_tab_columns c LEFT JOIN dba_encrypted_columns ec ON ec.owner = c.owner AND ec.table_name = c.table_name AND ec.column_name = c.column_name WHERE ec.column_name IS NULL AND c.owner NOT IN ('SYS','SYSTEM') AND (LOWER(c.column_name) LIKE '%teudat%zehut%' OR LOWER(c.column_name) = 'tz' OR LOWER(c.column_name) = 'national_id' OR LOWER(c.column_name) = 'israeli_id')

SELECT owner, table_name, column_name FROM all_tab_columns WHERE owner NOT IN ('SYS','SYSTEM') AND (LOWER(column_name) LIKE '%medical%' OR LOWER(column_name) LIKE '%diagnosis%' OR LOWER(column_name) LIKE '%treatment%' OR LOWER(column_name) LIKE '%prescription%' OR LOWER(column_name) LIKE '%health%')

SELECT owner, table_name, column_name FROM all_tab_columns WHERE owner NOT IN ('SYS','SYSTEM') AND (LOWER(column_name) LIKE '%religion%' OR LOWER(column_name) = 'dat' OR LOWER(column_name) LIKE '%political%' OR LOWER(column_name) LIKE '%orientation%' OR LOWER(column_name) LIKE '%ethnic%')

SELECT grantee, privilege FROM dba_sys_privs WHERE privilege LIKE '%ANY%' AND grantee NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'DBA', 'DATAPUMP_EXP_FULL_DATABASE', 'DATAPUMP_IMP_FULL_DATABASE') ORDER BY grantee, privilege

SELECT policy_name, audit_option, audit_option_type FROM audit_unified_policies WHERE audit_option IN ('GRANT', 'REVOKE', 'ALTER USER', 'CREATE USER', 'DROP USER', 'CREATE ROLE', 'ALTER ROLE', 'DROP ROLE') ORDER BY policy_name

SELECT grantee, COUNT(*) AS priv_count FROM dba_sys_privs WHERE grantee NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'DBA', 'DATAPUMP_EXP_FULL_DATABASE', 'DATAPUMP_IMP_FULL_DATABASE') GROUP BY grantee HAVING COUNT(*) > 10 ORDER BY priv_count DESC FETCH FIRST 20 ROWS ONLY

SELECT username, COUNT(DISTINCT machine) AS distinct_machines, COUNT(DISTINCT program) AS distinct_programs, COUNT(*) AS active_sessions FROM v$session WHERE username IN (SELECT grantee FROM dba_role_privs WHERE granted_role = 'DBA' AND grantee NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM')) GROUP BY username HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT machine) > 2 ORDER BY distinct_machines DESC

SELECT u.username, u.account_status, TO_CHAR(u.last_login, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS last_login, TO_CHAR(u.created, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS created, ROUND(SYSDATE - NVL(CAST(u.last_login AS DATE), u.created)) AS days_inactive, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dba_sys_privs WHERE grantee = u.username) AS sys_priv_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dba_role_privs WHERE grantee = u.username) AS role_count FROM dba_users u WHERE u.account_status = 'OPEN' AND NVL(CAST(u.last_login AS DATE), u.created) < SYSDATE - 90 AND u.username NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'DBSNMP', 'OUTLN', 'XDB', 'AUDSYS', 'GSMADMIN_INTERNAL') ORDER BY days_inactive DESC FETCH FIRST 20 ROWS ONLY
SELECT grantee, granted_role, admin_option FROM dba_role_privs WHERE grantee IN (SELECT role FROM dba_roles) AND grantee NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM') ORDER BY grantee, granted_role

SELECT policy_name, audit_option FROM audit_unified_policies WHERE audit_option IN ('GRANT', 'REVOKE', 'ALTER USER', 'CREATE USER', 'DROP USER') AND policy_name IN (SELECT policy_name FROM audit_unified_enabled_policies) ORDER BY policy_name

SELECT grantee, granted_role, admin_option, default_role FROM dba_role_privs WHERE grantee NOT IN (SELECT role FROM dba_roles) AND grantee NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'PUBLIC') AND granted_role IN (SELECT grantee FROM dba_role_privs WHERE granted_role IN ('DBA', 'RESOURCE') OR grantee IN (SELECT grantee FROM dba_sys_privs WHERE privilege LIKE '%ANY%')) ORDER BY grantee
SELECT username FROM dba_users_with_defpwd WHERE username NOT IN ('XS$NULL') ORDER BY username
SELECT name, type, status FROM dba_priv_captures ORDER BY name
SELECT COUNT(*) AS pdb_count FROM v$containers WHERE con_id > 2

SELECT owner, object_name, object_type, status FROM ALL_OBJECTS WHERE object_type LIKE 'JAVA%' AND owner NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'PUBLIC', 'ORDSYS', 'MDSYS', 'XDB', 'WMSYS') ORDER BY owner, object_name FETCH FIRST 20 ROWS ONLY
SELECT TO_CHAR(MAX(action_time), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS last_patch_date, ROUND(SYSDATE - CAST(MAX(action_time) AS DATE)) AS days_since_patch FROM dba_registry_sqlpatch WHERE action = 'APPLY'
SELECT parameter, value FROM v$option WHERE value = 'TRUE' ORDER BY parameter

SELECT GRANTEE, PRIVILEGE FROM DBA_SYS_PRIVS WHERE PRIVILEGE IN ('CREATE ANY PROCEDURE', 'CREATE ANY TRIGGER', 'CREATE ANY TYPE', 'ALTER ANY PROCEDURE', 'ALTER ANY TRIGGER') AND GRANTEE NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'DBA') ORDER BY GRANTEE, PRIVILEGE

SELECT OWNER, OBJECT_TYPE, COUNT(*) AS object_count FROM ALL_OBJECTS WHERE OBJECT_TYPE IN ('PACKAGE', 'PACKAGE BODY', 'PROCEDURE', 'FUNCTION', 'TRIGGER', 'JAVA CLASS', 'JAVA SOURCE') AND OWNER NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'MDSYS', 'CTXSYS', 'XDB', 'WMSYS', 'ORDSYS', 'DBSNMP', 'APPQOSSYS', 'GSMADMIN_INTERNAL', 'AUDSYS', 'OUTLN', 'ORDDATA', 'ORDPLUGINS', 'SI_INFORMTN_SCHEMA', 'DVSYS', 'LBACSYS', 'DVF') GROUP BY OWNER, OBJECT_TYPE ORDER BY OWNER, object_count DESC

SELECT u.USERNAME, u.ACCOUNT_STATUS, u.CREATED, u.DEFAULT_TABLESPACE, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DBA_OBJECTS o WHERE o.OWNER = u.USERNAME) AS object_count FROM DBA_USERS u WHERE u.USERNAME NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'MDSYS', 'CTXSYS', 'XDB', 'WMSYS', 'ORDSYS', 'DBSNMP', 'APPQOSSYS', 'GSMADMIN_INTERNAL', 'AUDSYS', 'OUTLN', 'ORDDATA', 'ORDPLUGINS', 'SI_INFORMTN_SCHEMA', 'DVSYS', 'LBACSYS', 'DVF', 'ANONYMOUS', 'XS$NULL') AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DBA_OBJECTS o WHERE o.OWNER = u.USERNAME) > 0 ORDER BY object_count DESC

SELECT GRANTEE, COUNT(*) AS priv_count FROM DBA_SYS_PRIVS WHERE GRANTEE NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'DBA', 'IMP_FULL_DATABASE', 'EXP_FULL_DATABASE', 'DATAPUMP_IMP_FULL_DATABASE', 'DATAPUMP_EXP_FULL_DATABASE') AND ADMIN_OPTION = 'YES' GROUP BY GRANTEE HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY priv_count DESC

SELECT x.grantee, x.type_name, x.name, x.action
FROM XMLTABLE('/ROWSET/ROW' PASSING
  XMLTYPE(NVL(DBMS_XMLGEN.getxml(
    CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM all_objects WHERE object_name = 'DBA_JAVA_POLICY' AND object_type IN ('VIEW','SYNONYM')) > 0
         THEN q'[SELECT grantee, type_name, name, action FROM dba_java_policy WHERE grantee NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'PUBLIC') AND type_name IN ('java.io.FilePermission', 'java.net.SocketPermission', 'java.lang.RuntimePermission') AND action NOT LIKE '%read%' ORDER BY grantee, type_name]'
         ELSE q'[SELECT NULL AS grantee, NULL AS type_name, NULL AS name, NULL AS action FROM dual WHERE 1=0]'
    END), '<ROWSET/>'))
  COLUMNS grantee   VARCHAR2(128)  PATH 'GRANTEE',
          type_name VARCHAR2(256)  PATH 'TYPE_NAME',
          name      VARCHAR2(4000) PATH 'NAME',
          action    VARCHAR2(256)  PATH 'ACTION') x

SELECT OWNER, NAME, TYPE, TEXT FROM ALL_SOURCE WHERE (UPPER(TEXT) LIKE '%EXECUTE IMMEDIATE%' OR UPPER(TEXT) LIKE '%DBMS_SQL%') AND OWNER NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'MDSYS', 'CTXSYS', 'XDB', 'WMSYS', 'ORDSYS', 'AUDSYS') ORDER BY OWNER, NAME FETCH FIRST 20 ROWS ONLY

SELECT OWNER, OBJECT_NAME, OBJECT_TYPE, CREATED, STATUS FROM ALL_OBJECTS WHERE OBJECT_TYPE IN ('PACKAGE', 'PACKAGE BODY', 'PROCEDURE', 'FUNCTION', 'TRIGGER', 'JAVA CLASS') AND CREATED > SYSDATE - 30 AND OWNER NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'MDSYS', 'CTXSYS', 'XDB', 'WMSYS', 'ORDSYS', 'AUDSYS') ORDER BY CREATED DESC

SELECT OWNER, COUNT(*) AS objects, MAX(LAST_DDL_TIME) AS last_modified FROM ALL_OBJECTS WHERE OBJECT_TYPE IN ('PACKAGE', 'PACKAGE BODY', 'PROCEDURE', 'FUNCTION', 'JAVA CLASS') AND OWNER NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'MDSYS', 'CTXSYS', 'XDB', 'WMSYS', 'ORDSYS', 'AUDSYS', 'DBSNMP') GROUP BY OWNER HAVING MAX(LAST_DDL_TIME) < SYSDATE - 365 ORDER BY last_modified

SELECT OWNER, TRIGGER_NAME, TRIGGER_TYPE, TRIGGERING_EVENT, TABLE_OWNER, BASE_OBJECT_TYPE, STATUS FROM ALL_TRIGGERS WHERE BASE_OBJECT_TYPE = 'DATABASE' AND OWNER NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM') ORDER BY OWNER, TRIGGER_NAME
SELECT POLICY_NAME, ENABLED_OPTION FROM AUDIT_UNIFIED_ENABLED_POLICIES WHERE POLICY_NAME LIKE '%DDL%' OR ENABLED_OPTION LIKE '%CREATE%' OR ENABLED_OPTION LIKE '%ALTER%' ORDER BY POLICY_NAME

SELECT OWNER, OBJECT_NAME, OBJECT_TYPE, AUTHID FROM ALL_PROCEDURES WHERE AUTHID = 'CURRENT_USER' AND OWNER NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM', 'MDSYS', 'CTXSYS', 'XDB', 'WMSYS', 'ORDSYS', 'AUDSYS') ORDER BY OWNER, OBJECT_NAME
SELECT USERNAME, ACCOUNT_STATUS FROM DBA_USERS WHERE USERNAME IN (SELECT USERNAME FROM DBA_USERS_WITH_DEFPWD)
SELECT USERNAME, PASSWORD_VERSIONS FROM DBA_USERS WHERE PASSWORD_VERSIONS LIKE '%10G%' AND ACCOUNT_STATUS = 'OPEN'
SELECT u.USERNAME, u.ACCOUNT_STATUS, u.PROFILE, u.CREATED FROM DBA_USERS u WHERE u.USERNAME IN (SELECT USERNAME FROM DBA_USERS_WITH_DEFPWD) AND u.ACCOUNT_STATUS = 'OPEN'

SELECT PROFILE, RESOURCE_NAME, LIMIT FROM DBA_PROFILES WHERE RESOURCE_TYPE = 'PASSWORD' AND PROFILE IN (SELECT DISTINCT PROFILE FROM DBA_USERS WHERE ACCOUNT_STATUS = 'OPEN') ORDER BY PROFILE, RESOURCE_NAME

SELECT USERNAME, ACCOUNT_STATUS, LOCK_DATE, EXPIRY_DATE, CREATED, DEFAULT_TABLESPACE FROM DBA_USERS WHERE USERNAME IN ('SCOTT', 'HR', 'OE', 'SH', 'PM', 'IX', 'BI', 'OUTLN', 'MDSYS', 'CTXSYS', 'DBSNMP', 'XDB', 'APEX_PUBLIC_USER', 'FLOWS_FILES', 'WMSYS', 'ORDSYS', 'ORDDATA', 'ORDPLUGINS', 'SI_INFORMTN_SCHEMA', 'DIP', 'MGMT_VIEW', 'SYSMAN') AND ACCOUNT_STATUS NOT LIKE '%LOCKED%' AND ACCOUNT_STATUS NOT LIKE '%EXPIRED%'
SELECT PROFILE, RESOURCE_NAME, LIMIT FROM DBA_PROFILES WHERE RESOURCE_NAME = 'PASSWORD_VERIFY_FUNCTION' AND PROFILE IN (SELECT DISTINCT PROFILE FROM DBA_USERS WHERE ACCOUNT_STATUS = 'OPEN')

SELECT u.USERNAME, u.ACCOUNT_STATUS, u.PROFILE FROM DBA_USERS u WHERE u.USERNAME IN (SELECT USERNAME FROM DBA_USERS_WITH_DEFPWD) AND u.ACCOUNT_STATUS = 'OPEN' AND u.USERNAME IN ('DBSNMP', 'SYSMAN', 'APPQOSSYS', 'GSMADMIN_INTERNAL', 'XDB', 'MDSYS', 'CTXSYS')
SELECT USERNAME, ACCOUNT_STATUS, EXPIRY_DATE, LOCK_DATE, PROFILE FROM DBA_USERS WHERE ACCOUNT_STATUS = 'OPEN' AND (EXPIRY_DATE IS NULL OR EXPIRY_DATE > SYSDATE + 365) ORDER BY USERNAME

SELECT u.username, u.account_status, u.created, u.expiry_date, u.last_login, u.profile, ROUND(SYSDATE - u.created) AS account_age_days FROM dba_users u WHERE u.oracle_maintained = 'N' AND u.account_status = 'OPEN' AND (u.expiry_date IS NULL OR u.expiry_date > SYSDATE + 365) ORDER BY u.created
SELECT username, password_versions FROM dba_users WHERE oracle_maintained = 'N' AND account_status = 'OPEN' AND password_versions NOT LIKE '%12C%' ORDER BY username
SELECT username, account_status, profile, created, authentication_type FROM dba_users WHERE oracle_maintained = 'Y' AND account_status NOT IN ('EXPIRED & LOCKED', 'LOCKED') ORDER BY username
SELECT authentication_type, COUNT(*) AS user_count FROM dba_users WHERE oracle_maintained = 'N' AND account_status = 'OPEN' GROUP BY authentication_type ORDER BY user_count DESC
SELECT username, account_status, default_tablespace, created, authentication_type FROM dba_users WHERE oracle_maintained = 'Y' ORDER BY account_status, username

SELECT u.username, u.account_status, u.default_tablespace, u.profile, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dba_role_privs rp WHERE rp.grantee = u.username) AS roles, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dba_sys_privs sp WHERE sp.grantee = u.username) AS sys_privs, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dba_tab_privs tp WHERE tp.grantee = u.username) AS obj_privs FROM dba_users u WHERE u.oracle_maintained = 'Y' AND u.account_status NOT LIKE '%LOCKED%' AND u.username NOT IN ('SYS', 'SYSTEM') ORDER BY u.username
SELECT d.username, d.account_status, d.password_versions FROM dba_users d JOIN dba_users_with_defpwd dp ON d.username = dp.username WHERE d.account_status = 'OPEN' ORDER BY d.username
